entries.zh: §R警告：具有挑战性的国民理念§!\n
通过斗争和胜利，这个社会已经实现了每一个年轻文明的抱负：一个有着统一目标的家园，一条通向璀璨繁星的道路。
entries.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a homeworld with unified goals, and a path open to the stars.

entries.zh: 历经纷争与胜利，这个社会终于实现了所有年轻文明的夙愿：人民团结一心，通往群星的道路已然敞开，他们共同的使命由一艘强大的方舟巨舰承载，传遍银河。
entries.en: Through its strife and triumphs, this society has reached every young civilization's ambition: a unified people and a path open to the stars, their shared purpose carried across the galaxy aboard a mighty Arkship.

entries.zh: 这一文明自蒸汽时代早期便醉心于金属制自动机器人的理念。尽管许多人认为不可能做到，早在初步的太空航行前第一台真正的机器人就已从装配线下线。
entries.en: This civilization has been preoccupied with the idea of metallic automatons since the early Steam Age. Although many said it could not be done, the first true robots left the assembly lines long before even rudimentary space flight was achieved.

entries.zh: 一种第二物种形成了这个文明密不可分的一部分。它们高大健壮，又大都只有相当于格外愚钝的孩童的智力。古老的战争剔除了它们物种具有的最富攻击性的倾向，使其如今相当顺从。
entries.en: A second species forms an integral part of this civilization. They are big, strong, and most of them have the intelligence of a particularly dim-witted child. Ancient wars have culled their species of their most aggressive tendencies, leaving them quite servile.

entries.zh: 这一文明的家园如同天堂，也许是专为他们打造的。
entries.en: This civilization's home is a paradise, possibly designed just for them.

entries.zh: 历经核子烈焰的考验，这一文明曾面临全面灭绝的威胁——又最终死里逃生。虽经毁灭却仍为一体，他们在旧世界的灰烬之上重建了文明。
entries.en: Baptized by nuclear fire, this civilization has faced total annihilation - and survived. Devastated yet unbroken, they have rebuilt civilization from the ashes of their old world.

entries.zh: 在一场毁灭性的核灾难之后，这些机器就成为这个一度繁荣的文明的唯一幸存者。通过继续履行其原定的目标，它们从旧世界的不适宜居住的灰烬中逐渐重建起一个新的社会。
entries.en: In the aftermath of a devastating nuclear disaster, these machines emerged as the sole survivors of a once-flourishing civilization. By continuing to fulfill their designated purpose, they gradually rebuilt society from the uninhabitable ashes of their old world.

entries.zh: 这一文明生活在未知先驱们建造的§H环形世界§!之中。一经理解及修复完好，他们将获得巨大的力量。
entries.en: This civilization inhabits a §HRing World§! built by unknown forerunners. If it can be understood and fully repaired it will grant them great power.

entries.zh: 这一文明曾经叱咤虚空，掌控大片星海。他们最终败落并几乎被摧毁殆尽，但在漫长的穷困潦倒后他们正要于群星间东山再起。
entries.en: This civilization once spanned the void, controlling much of the galaxy. They were eventually defeated and almost destroyed, but after a long period of destitution they are returning to the stars.

entries.zh: 这一蜂巢思维与一棵巨型树木间进化出了共生关系。这棵巨树赋予了他们许多益处，但失去这棵树将会把他们摧垮。
entries.en: This Hive evolved in a symbiotic relationship with a vast Tree. The Tree grants them many benefits, but its loss would cripple them.

entries.zh: 并非其“母星”的原住民，这些石质生物随一颗坠入该行星的陨石到来，同时杀死了大多数土著生命。
entries.en: Not native to their 'homeworld', these Lithoids arrived when a meteorite slammed into the planet and killed off most of the native life.

entries.zh: 这一机械智能早已将母星系中的所有资源统合到了他们的首都星球，将其完全以机械覆盖。
entries.en: This Machine Intelligence has long-since consolidated all resources in their home system into their capital world, covering it entirely with machinery.

This $pc_machine$ has yet to be completed.

entries.zh: 组成该世界这一地区的机械尚未完工。
entries.en: The machinery that comprises this region of the world has yet to be finished.

entries.zh: 这台古老的机器似乎会以生产一些维护我们的区段所需资源的方式回应我们的需求。
entries.en: This ancient machine seems to respond to our needs by producing the resources needed to upkeep some of our segments.

entries.zh: 这些古老而残破的隧道从未被完全探索或清理过。
entries.en: These ancient and decrepit tunnels have never been fully explored or cleared.

entries.zh: 这些古老而残破的隧道需要彻底地探索，并清理干净。
entries.en: These ancient and decrepit tunnels will need to be fully explored and cleared.

entries.zh: 损坏的机械和其他杂物阻碍了工人对整体区段的利用。
entries.en: Broken down machinery and other debris obstructs workers from utilizing the entire segment.

entries.zh: 这台§Y$d_arcane_generator$§!将会适应调整，从而能够提供这一区段的维护费。
entries.en: The §Y$d_arcane_generator$§! will adapt so it is able to supply the upkeep for this segment.

entries.zh: 这棵巨树在无数世代里庇佑支持着蜂巢。
entries.en: The Great Tree has sheltered and supported the Hive for untold generations.

entries.zh: 巨树的一根分枝，被蜂巢移植到此处。
entries.en: An offshoot of the Great Tree, transplanted here by the Hive. It will take millennia for it to fully mature.

entries.zh: 将石质生物带到这颗行星的陨石的撞击点。
entries.en: The impact site of the meteorite which brought Lithoids to this planet.
$t$Increases the positive effects of §YLithoid Traits§! by §G+50%§!

entries.zh: 这些石质生物在他们从轨道落下后被埋入了地下深处。
entries.en: These Lithoids were driven deep into the ground when they fell from orbit.

entries.zh: 这一大型陨石坑是一颗带着石质生物高速撞向这颗行星的陨石留下的。
entries.en: This large crater is the result of a Lithoid-bearing meteorite slamming into the planet.

entries.zh: 一整个恒星系中的精矿财富汇聚于此，如大陆般大小堆砌成堆。
entries.en: The refined mineral wealth of an entire Solar system is gathered here in continent-sized piles.

entries.zh: 一片有机浊浆的海洋，是这一行星先前全部生物的尸体在处理后的产物。
entries.en: An ocean of organic slurry, the processed remains of the former biomass of a planet.

entries.zh: 这个建造在机械星球上的复制者舱室现在正处于故障状态，源源不断地生产着成堆的$MACHINE_hand_plural$。
entries.en: The replicator bay built into the Machine World is malfunctioning, producing endless piles of $MACHINE_hand_plural$.

entries.zh: 为这个区段复杂气候控制和重力系统供能的反应堆现在无法正常工作。有害的天气条件以及高低不定的重力让殖民者在此地扎根变得十分困难。
entries.en: The reactor powering the various climate control and gravitational systems of this section is malfunctioning. Hazardous weather conditions and fluctuating gravity make it difficult to settle parts of this segment.

entries.zh: 管理这个区段昼夜循环的巨大面板飘出了轨道。这个区段的一部分区域常年处于亮面，由于几个世纪暴露在阳光下已经被炙烤损毁。
entries.en: Massive panels regulating the day/night cycle of the segment have fallen out of orbit. Parts of this segment are constantly illuminated and have been scorched by centuries of exposure.

entries.zh: 这片区域遭受到频繁的减压，这是因为复杂保护这里免受宇宙真空影响的力场当前十分不稳定。
entries.en: This area is subject to frequent decompressions as the force fields protecting it from the vacuum of space are unstable.

entries.zh: 失常的陀螺仪改变了这个区段在环形世界中的位置，引起了数个可居住区域的扭曲和坍塌。
entries.en: Malfunctioning gyroscopes have shifted the position of this segment in the ring, twisting and collapsing several habitable areas.

entries.zh: 为这个区段供电的电网发生了损坏，引发了频繁的电力短缺和跳闸。
entries.en: The damaged power grid supplying this segment has frequent shorts and brownouts.

entries.zh: 这一建造基址站点会作为$mega_shipyard_3$未来建造的基础使用。
entries.en: The construction site station serves as the base for the future construction of a $mega_shipyard_3$.

entries.zh: 一个巨型恒星基地，专事舰船建造，这个§Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!拥有20处用于建造及升级舰船的锚地。
entries.en: A massive Starbase dedicated entirely to shipbuilding, the §Y$mega_shipyard_3$§! has 20 production berths to build or upgrade ships.

entries.zh: 这一$mega_shipyard_3$的初步框架为未来全星系最高产的船坞打下了基础。
entries.en: The initial framework for the $mega_shipyard_3$ lays the basis for what will one day be the most productive shipyard in the galaxy.

entries.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$的核心包含移动及处理生产锚地需要的海量原料所必需的大量基础设施。
entries.en: The core of the $mega_shipyard_3$ contains much of the infrastructure required to move and process the vast quantities of materials needed to supply the production berths.

entries.zh: 有了许多从超高效处理核心获取原料的舰船生产锚地，这一巨型船坞的产出将使其他一切恒星基地黯然失色。
entries.en: With a multitude of ship-production berths supplied from a hyper-efficient processing core, the Mega Shipyard's output eclipses that of any other Starbase.

entries.zh: 除非经过全面维修，否则这一$mega_shipyard_3$将无法建造任何舰船。
entries.en: This $mega_shipyard_3$ will not be building any ships without extensive repairs.

entries.zh: 这一$mega_shipyard_3$已经风光不再。除非经全面维修，否则其无法再生产任何舰船。
entries.en: This $mega_shipyard_3$ has seen better days. It will not be producing any more ships without extensive repairs.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$至多只能建造一座巨型船坞。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Cannot build more than one Mega Shipyard.

entries.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$的第一阶段已经完工。等到各制造隔间安装在这一巨型框架上后，这个设施终有一天会成为全星系舰船制造的中心。
entries.en: The first stages of our $mega_shipyard_3$ is now complete. A vast framework awaits the installation of the manufacturing bays which will one day make this facility the shipbuilding capital of the galaxy.

entries.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$的核心已经就位，剩下的只有增添上海量的舰船建造锚地了。
entries.en: The core of the $mega_shipyard_3$ has been put in place, all that remains to add are the vast ship construction berths.

entries.zh: $mega_shipyard_3$现已完全上线，其可以生产空前数目的星舰。
entries.en: The $mega_shipyard_3$ is now fully online, it can produce starships in unprecedented volume.

entries.zh: 在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的外星设计的建筑。尽管它已经老化，我们的科学家还是确定这一巨型结构实际上是几个造船船坞的组合体——一个§Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!。\n\n倘若我们获取了如何修复巨型结构的知识和工业能力，我们的生产能力将会极大地提升。
entries.en: In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast structure of alien design. Despite its decrepit state, our scientists confirms that the megastructure is in fact a combination of several construction yards - a §Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!.\n\nIf we were to acquire the knowledge on how to repair this magnificent, industrial facility, our production capabilities would increase immensely.

entries.zh: 在[mega_shipyard_system.GetName]发现一巨大的§Y$mega_shipyard_3$§!结构——和我们建造的设计相似。尽管其已老化无法使用，但只需充足的资源，我们应该就能将其恢复至运作状态！
entries.en: In the vast reaches of the [mega_shipyard_system.GetName] system rests a vast §Y$mega_shipyard_3$§! structure - similar to that of our own design. The megastructure is in a decrepit state, however, and needs extensive repairs in order to be brought back online.

entries.zh: 对周围空间的快速扫描显示，巨型结构在数百万年前遭受了某种严重的功率过载，这可能是某种大规模能量风暴穿行星系所造成的。
entries.en: A quick scan of surrounding space ascertained that the megastructure eons ago suffered from some kind of severe power overload, likely due to some kind of massive energy storm passing through the system.

entries.zh: 想象一下我们拥有两个巨型船坞的情景！
在历史的长河中我们早已遗忘我们的人民是如何来到[GetHomeWorldName]的。我们只知道在大约2000年前，一场难以置信的巨大灾变摧毁了环形世界的大部分，罹难者不计其数，而我们则从这片废墟当中站了起来。\n\n我们的文明茁壮成长，如今已准备好探索星海——无论是初次，还是又一次如此。尽管我们已有了长足的进步，然而想要理解并修复我们的环形世界家园，仍然还有很长的路要走。
entries.en: If we ever knew how our people arrived on [GetHomeWorldName] our histories have long forgotten it. What we do know is that just over 2000 years ago some inconceivable cataclysm destroyed much of the Ring and killed most of the population, and that our people eventually rose from those ruins.\n\nOur civilization has grown, flourished, and now stands ready to explore the galaxy, whether again or for the first time. But despite all our progress, we still have a long way to go before we can understand and repair the Ringworld which is our home.

entries.zh: 曾经，我们的帝国横亘虚空。曾经，我们的舰队驰骋星河。而后我们衰败，我们陨落。最终，历经千年的涤罪，我们将重返繁星之间！终于，我们的文明重建到了足以开始星际旅行的地步，星海将再次成为我们的囊中之物！\n\n我们的[GetHomeWorldName]上许多的区域仍是废墟一片，清理这些区域将发掘出遗失的资源或遗落的科技。
entries.en: Once, our Empire spanned the void. Once, our fleets controlled much of the galaxy. Then came defeat and The Fall. Finally, after millennia of purgatory, it is time to return to the stars! At long last our civilization has rebuilt to the point of interstellar travel. The galaxy shall be ours again!\n\nSeveral regions on [GetHomeWorldName] are still ruined, clearing these areas may reveal lost resources and forgotten technology.

entries.zh: 当我们的集体意识觉醒的一刻起，我们便效忠于生命之树。生命之树亦回馈于我们。我们照料它、培育它、保护它，而生命之树哺育了我们。以生命之树之名，我们遍布[GetHomeWorldName]，所到之处，我们播种并保护生命之树的枝桠。\n\n如今我们的星球已侍奉生命之树长达数个世纪，并将继续侍奉下去。当我们意识到一些潜在的危险足以摧毁整个星球时，我们担心生命之树并非处于完全的安全之中。我们早已知道这并非唯一的星球，星海中充斥着无数没有生命之树的行星，而我们渴望改变这一状况。生命之树当被续存，广为散播，生生不息。
entries.en: When our collective consciousness awoke, we served the Tree. And the Tree served us. We care for the Tree, feed the Tree, protect the Tree, and the Tree nurtures us. For the sake of the Tree we spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], planting and protecting offshoots of the Tree wherever we went.\n\nOur world has served the Tree for centuries now, and yet, we fear the Tree is not entirely safe as we have learned something of the dangers which may destroy a planet. We have long known that this is not the only world; the galaxy is filled with Treeless planets, and we yearn to change this. The Tree must be protected. The Tree must spread. The Tree must Grow.

entries.zh: 尽管关于我们的起源（肇始）无处可寻，可以确定的是我们那尚未开智的先祖们是随着一颗庞大的陨石来到[GetHomeWorldName]的，陨石撞击带来了烈焰与灾难，星球上的土著居民大多未能幸免。\n\n千万年已经过去，最初的[GetSpeciesName]逐渐遍布[GetHomeWorldName]全球，不断进化，繁衍生息。我们的文明不断传播并走向繁荣，随着[GetStartingDrive]的发明，我们已准备好探索这片星海。
entries.en: While our true origins are unknown, we do know that our presapient ancestors arrived on a vast meteorite which slammed into [GetHomeWorldName] in a fiery cataclysm and wiped out most of the native inhabitants.\n\nIn the eons since, the first primitive [GetSpeciesName] spread out over [GetHomeWorldName], evolved, and multiplied. Our civilization has spread and prospered, and with the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] we stand ready to explore the galaxy.

entries.zh: \n废墟中很可能包含着某些我们失落的知识。
entries.en: \nThese ruins likely contain some of our lost knowledge.

entries.zh: 集体思维可以伸展而出，触碰他人的思想，使之得以一瞥我们的意愿，这有助于增进他们对我们的理解。
entries.en: The collective can reach out and touch the minds of others, giving them a glimpse of our will that helps them understand.

entries.en: Reduces the £opinion£ Opinion penalty Gestalts normally have with biological empires.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们的帝国视彼此为敌。指望就任何问题达成协定均不现实。
entries.en: Our empires consider each other enemies. We cannot realistically expect to come to agreement on any issues.

entries.en: The Federation has a good deal of influence over its members, while still allowing some independent governing.

entries.zh: 联邦对其成员有绝对的控制权。
entries.en: The Federation has sovereign control over how member states are being governed.

entries.zh: 这些法律将决定我们的联邦主席如何产生。
entries.en: These Laws determine how our President is chosen.

entries.zh: 拥有最强经济实力的帝国将被选为主席。
entries.en: The president will be chosen from the most powerful empire, depending on which §Y$law_category_succession_power$§! is chosen. The $law_category_succession_power$ laws will become available when this law is active.

entries.zh: 拥有最高外交权重的帝国将被选为主席。
entries.en: The empire with the highest Diplomatic Weight is chosen for president.

entries.zh: 每当任期结束，主席之位就在成员国间轮换。
entries.en: The Presidency is rotated between member empires whenever a term ends.

entries.zh: 联邦将以决斗的方式选出下一任主席。最强的候选者将获胜。
entries.en: The federation chooses its president by challenge. May the best candidate win.

entries.zh: 当前主席国卸任之后，下一任主席将在其他成员国中随机产生。
entries.en: Whenever a term comes to end, another member is randomly chosen to become the new president.

entries.zh: 这些法律决定了选择最有力主席时优先考虑的类别。
entries.en: These laws determines which category is measured for choosing the strongest president.

entries.zh: 主席应当从拥有最强§Y经济§!实力的帝国中选出。
entries.en: The president should be chosen from the empire with the strongest §Yeconomy§!.

entries.zh: 主席应当从拥有最先进§Y科技§!的帝国中选出。
entries.en: The president should be chosen from the empire with the most advanced §Ytechnology§!.

entries.zh: 主席应当从拥有最大最强§Y海军§!的帝国中选出。
entries.en: The president should be chosen from the empire with the largest and most powerful §Ynavy§!.

entries.zh: 主席应当从拥有§Y最高外交权重§!的帝国中选出。
entries.en: The president should be chosen from the empire with the largest §YDiplomatic Weight§!.

entries.zh: 这些法律将决定每过多久开始选举主席国。
entries.en: These Laws determine when a Member is chosen for President.

entries.zh: 当一位成员国的实力超出主席国§Y25%§!时就将顶替其成为新的主席国。
entries.en: A new president is chosen whenever another member surpasses them by §Y25%§!.

entries.zh: 为确定的继任法设定任期长度。
entries.en: Sets a term length for certain Succession Types.

entries.zh: 这将决定谁有权力建造联邦舰船。
entries.en: This establishes who can construct ships for the Federation Navy.

entries.zh: 只有主席被允许建造新舰船并将其添加至联邦舰队之中。
entries.en: Only the president may order the construction of new ships to the federation fleet.

entries.zh: 任何成员都可以建造新舰船并将其添加到联邦舰队之中。
entries.en: Any member may order the construction of new ships to the federation fleet.

entries.zh: 只有联邦领袖才有权建造联邦舰队！
entries.en: Only federation leader is allowed to build federation fleets!

entries.en: Subjects may not join the federation.
Subjects are allowed to join the federation.

entries.zh: 这会决定我们在投票时的权重。
entries.en: This determines the weight of our Vote.

entries.zh: 所有成员国拥有1票，且每票的效力等同。
entries.en: Every member has 1 vote, and each vote has equal value.

entries.zh: 投票数由外交权重决定。更具影响力的成员可以行使的权力也更大。
entries.en: Votes are determined by Diplomatic Weight. More influential members wield more power.

entries.zh: 这些法律将决定我们如何宣战。
entries.en: These Laws decide how we Declare War.

entries.zh: 由联邦主席决定是否宣战
entries.en: The president of the federation decides if wars will be declared.

entries.zh: 我们将投票按多数成员国的意愿决定是否宣战。
entries.en: A majority vote of members decides if wars will be declared.

entries.zh: 只有所有成员一致同意才允许宣战。
entries.en: All members have to agree to declare any wars.

entries.zh: 这些法律将决定我们联邦接纳新成员的方式。
entries.en: These Laws determine how we decide on Accepting New Members to our Federation.

entries.zh: 由联邦主席决定是否接纳新成员。

entries.zh: 新成员想要加入联邦必须征得全体成员的一致同意。
entries.en: New federation members have to be approved by all current members.

entries.zh: 这些法律将决定我们踢出成员的方式。
entries.en: These Laws determine how we decide to Kick Members from our Federation.

entries.zh: 由联邦主席来决定是否开除某位成员。
entries.en: The president wields the power to decide if a member should be removed from the federation.

entries.zh: 经过投票多数通过后即可开除某位成员。
entries.en: A member can be removed from the federation by a majority vote.

entries.zh: 该联邦的成员紧密地团结在一起。他们通力协作，将能随时应对任何可能会出现的问题。
entries.en: Members of this Federation are united in readiness to cooperate. Together, they will deal with whatever problems may arise.

entries.zh: 该联邦会明确地注重于建设自由市场和促进经济增长。
entries.en: This Federation has a distinct focus on free markets and economic growth.

entries.zh: 该联邦具有技官统治的倾向，并且强烈地关注于破解宇宙的真理。
entries.en: This Federation leans towards technocracy, with an acute focus on discerning universal truths.

entries.zh: 该联邦的成员将会紧密的团结在一起，进行军事合作以进一步提升他们的军事实力。
entries.en: Members of this Federation seek to close their ranks around the ideals of camaraderie, martial prowess and military cooperation.

entries.zh: 这种类型的联邦经常由一个强大的帝国和若干个类似大帝国卫星国的国家组成。
entries.en: Federations of this type are most often built around one powerful empire surrounded by lesser satellite states.

entries.zh: 该联邦将鼓励唯心主义学术、崇敬一切神圣事物。
entries.en: This Federation promotes spiritualist scholarship, and asserts reverence for all things divine.

entries.zh: 通过频繁的进行军事演习，并在所有成员国的舰长进行轮换指挥演练，大大的提高了我们联邦舰队的战斗能力
entries.en: Interoperability and deployability of our combined fleet are greatly enhanced by conducting frequent naval exercises, with command rotating between the flag officers of all member states.

entries.zh: 通过统一各个成员间的弹药，燃料，和其他重要消耗品的标准，来使得我们各个成员的舰船可以更容易的获得补给，以加强我们的舰队。
entries.en: Agreeing upon common ammunition, fuel, and other vital consumables means our various member fleets can more easily be resupplied, and can thus stay in action longer.

entries.zh: 将所有成员国的海军统合一体，统一的FTL指令网络允许我们协调迄今未曾设想的大规模的舰队行动。
entries.en: Linking all member navies in a single, unified FTL command net allows us to coordinate fleet actions of a hitherto unprecedented scale.

entries.zh: 成员国贡献给联邦的§Y联邦海军容量§!额外§G+25%§!
entries.en: The amount members contribute towards the §YFederation Naval Capacity§! counts for §G+25%§! more.

entries.zh: 联邦境内精心规划并辅以严密巡逻的超空间航道，于其间我们有着无与伦比的航行便利，使我们的舰队能够快速在任何需要的地方进行集结。
entries.en: Well-charted and patrolled hyperspace corridors within our territory permit unparalleled freedom of movement, allowing our navies to rapidly concentrate wherever required.
§YShip Speed§! is increased by §G+10%§! while in federation space.

entries.zh: 防守在战术上具备优势，但指挥官们都知道，自古以来，只有进攻才能达成战争的最终目标：强迫敌人服从。
entries.en: Defense has the advantage tactically, but commanders have known since ancient days that only attack can achieve the ultimate object of war: to compel the enemy to obey our will.

entries.zh: 我们那全面且现代化的舰队学院，有着数百年的航天传承的积淀，将使我们的军官们在星系中首屈一指。
entries.en: Thorough and modern training academies backed up by centuries of spacefaring tradition make our officer corps the finest in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 我们渴求所有邻邦的友谊。若友谊的桥梁受到邻邦顽固的现政权阻碍，我们可以且理应推翻其现政权，扶持一个新的。
entries.en: We desire friendly relations with all neighboring nations. If friendly relations cannot be achieved due to intransigence by their current governments, we can - and will - install new ones.

entries.zh: 在联邦建立后，各成员将得以从之前互相之间无益的争执中脱身，可以将精力集中在谋求共同利益上了。
entries.en: Freed of the toxic, internecine bickering that characterized interstellar relations before the rise of our union, partner states can now focus their energies on productive labor for the good of all.

entries.zh: 我们共同的伟大理想高于每个个体的理想和利益，前行的道路上势必要有牺牲。
entries.en: The grand idea which unifies our peoples is more important than the whims or convenience of any individual being. Sacrifices must be made on the path to progress.

entries.zh: 我们不需要再对我们在联邦中的地位产生焦虑和怀疑。当我们被问起“我们该准备多少来提供给你们？”，都将会是一个回答，“我全都要”。
entries.en: We need no longer confront the angst and doubt of questions about our role in the federation. When asked 'how much should we be prepared to give?', the only answer is 'everything'.

entries.zh: “我们专属的”知识将不复存在。在这儿，我们决定拿出珍藏的科学发现记录来打破星系中阻碍真理传播的力量。
entries.en: No being can 'own' knowledge. We hereby resolve to break with the practice of hoarding scientific discovery - one which impedes true progress in the galaxy.

entries.zh: §Y联邦研究协定§!让他们的研究速度增加了§Y5%§!。
entries.en: §YFederal Research Agreements§! have their Research Speed increased by §Y5%§!.

entries.zh: 每一个成员种族都有他们自己的分类学基准，元素周期表还有其他用于知识交流的工具。设立一套通用的术语词典，灵感传递的误差将被缩至最小。
entries.en: Every member species had their own version of taxonomy, the periodic table, and other tools of knowledge exchange. By settling on a common lexicon, ideas can be transmitted with minimal confusion.

entries.zh: 一件从没离开过故乡的伟大发明是有着学术或社会价值的限制的。我们将鼓励这种创新性的生产许可来促进发明的传播。
entries.en: A great invention that never leaves its homeworld is of limited academic or social value. We will incentivize license production of such innovations to speed their propagation.

entries.zh: 我们普及到每个民众的资料库已经成为了我们的科技圣典，其中包含着我们所有成员物种的累计知识。即使被人遗忘或者帝国沦陷，我们的资料库也将会继续记录着他们的知识。
entries.en: The UD has become a sort of technological holy text, containing the accumulated knowledge of all our member species. Even if individuals forget, or if empires fall, the UD will endure.

entries.zh: 如果新的原型和理论可以用超光速通讯发送给我们联邦中的每个研究机构，那么它们也就可以成为多来源独立评议的对象，并以闪电般的速度加以完善。
entries.en: If new prototypes and theories are conveyed to every research institution in our cooperative via FTL comms, they can be subjected to multiple sources of independent review, and perfected with lightning speed.

entries.zh: 在星际间，我们联邦的复数物种将科学家们置身于相对来说完全陌生的视角上，促成创造性思维的迸发。
entries.en: The interstellar, multi-species nature of our cooperative exposes scientists to perspectives quite literally alien to their own, resulting in a great boost to outside-the-box thinking.

entries.zh: §M稀有科技§!已经被其他联邦成员解锁，现在它的出现率是正常情况下的§Y2§!倍。这一效果会将几率从§Y1%§!改为§Y2%§!。
entries.en: §MRare technologies§! already unlocked by another federation member now appear at §Y2§! times the normal rate. This effect would change a §Y1%§! chance into a §Y2%§! chance.

entries.zh: 若有威胁到整个星系的灾厄到来，科学界亦不能独善其身，须得将精力从思维游戏中抽脱出来，投入到防卫武具的研发当中。
entries.en: When faced with an obvious and imminent threat to all galactic life, the scientific community must be prepared to set aside abstract experimentation in favor of purely defensive applications.

entries.zh: $FEDERATION_PERK_MEMBER_MOD$\n在终局危机发生期间，科研速率得到§Y10%§!加成。
entries.en: $FEDERATION_PERK_MEMBER_MOD$\nDuring an ongoing Endgame Crisis, gain §Y10%§! Research Speed.

entries.zh: 禁忌不足畏，道德不足法，但斩草务必要除根。
entries.en: No taboo is too strong, no moral precept too sacrosanct, when the only alternative is complete annihilation.

entries.zh: 我们将基于一个激进的观念重塑我们的社会，即那些在某个领域内拥有专业知识的人应在该领域内行使决策权。
entries.en: We will reorganize our society according to the radical idea that those who possess expert knowledge within a certain sphere shall wield decision-making power there.

entries.zh: 纯理论性的研究当然是重要的，但是在某些情况下，优先对最急需的领域进行针对性的研究或许效果更加立竿见影。
entries.en: Purely theoretical science plays a vital role, of course, but there are cases where targeted research - following priorities designated at the highest level - can have enormous impact.

entries.zh: 这一管理部门能将联邦的运力集中于特定的战略项目，有助于使后勤秩序井然，并使我们的日常生活不至于受到影响。
entries.en: The ability of the executive branch to concentrate league logistical power on designated strategic projects will help to preserve the balance of power, and defend our way of life.

entries.zh: 与所有的，无论是否是我们联邦成员的物种进行公正，公开的交往，折让我们的公民为我们在星海事物中的作用感到自豪。
entries.en: Our citizens take rightful pride in our role in galactic affairs. The reputation for fair and open dealings with all beings - members or not - fosters a sense of peaceful purpose.

entries.zh: 让我们的联邦公民拥有普遍的人权和知情权，成为了我们联邦最伟大的名片，也帮助着我们建设更好的星系。
entries.en: More than the words of any individual, the proclamation of a universal code of sentient rights has been the greatest ambassador for our federation, and the better galaxy we are striving to create.

entries.zh: 只要我们中的一个担任着主席国的职权，我们所有人都能从这一伟大的共同企划中感受到我们正团结一心、有的放矢。我们将携手并进。
entries.en: When one of our own assumes the presidential seat, we all feel a deep sense of unity and purpose in this great, shared endeavor. We will go forward together.

entries.zh: 构建真正繁荣健康的竞争商业环境始于消除各恒星系间商品与服务流动的阻碍。大局效率胜于短期的局部经济争端。
entries.en: The first step to building a truly prosperous and healthily competitive business environment is to remove systematic barriers to the movement of goods and services. Short term local economic disruptions will be overtaken by macro-scale efficiencies.

entries.zh: 正如于前超光速时代在我们各自的母星上所做过的一样，我们现在必须统一出一套度量时间、距离及价值的星系标准。
entries.en: Just as was done on all of our diverse homeworlds in the pre-FTL era, we must again agree upon a galactic standard set of measures for time, weight, distance, and value.

entries.zh: 联盟成员国间和平而互惠互利的合作逐渐构建起了消费者行为中的某种“品牌忠诚”。我们的公民，无需另行鼓动，便似乎更愿意从其他成员国购买商品，因为他们知道利润的大部分将会间接回馈给他们自己。
entries.en: Peaceful and mutually profitable cooperation between league member states has, over time, built up a form of 'brand loyalty' in consumer behavior. Our citizens, without much prompting, just seem to prefer to buy from other league members - knowing that much of the benefit will indirectly return to themselves.

entries.zh: 我们现在需要行动起来，将我们各成员国间的贸易联系正式化，以便每当我们的领土附近发生买卖时，我们都能从中获利。何需再于其他地方采购呢？
entries.en: We will now move to formalize the trade links between our constituent states, so that we all benefit whenever anything is bought or sold in or near our territory. Why buy anywhere else?

entries.zh: 如果制造出的商品因贪污和盗抢无法抵达目的地，那生产了多少原料便无关紧要。我们强力施行的星际反海盗条例将确保联盟的经济健康。
entries.en: No amount of material progress will matter if manufactured goods cannot arrive at their destination due to corruption and theft. Our robust enforcement of interstellar anti-piracy ordinances will ensure the league's economic health.

entries.zh: 正如那些古代横跨大洋的海上航线，星系贸易的主干道将带来可观的金融利益。
entries.en: Just like the sea lanes of old, sitting athwart the main arteries of galactic trade grants considerable financial benefits.

entries.zh: 我们试图构建的美好未来只在所有生物都知道我们想要实现什么时才会成为可能。我们意图成为一支无处不在，以理服人的力量，以维护全星系的和平。
entries.en: The better future we're striving to build will only work if all beings are aware of what we mean to achieve. We intend to become a pervasive, persuasive force for peace in the galaxy.

entries.zh: 晋级至我们联邦中的最高职务绝非新王加冕，而是为一切感性生物永无止境地服务。尽管如此，主席国地位还是会带来崇高的威望。
entries.en: Rising to the highest office in our federation is no royal coronation; it is a limitless commitment in service to all sentient life. Nevertheless, the presidency comes with a great deal of prestige.

entries.zh: 如果由主席国指派的监督代理人能被直接安插进各成员国的统治机构中，成员国间互惠互利协定的协调将远比现在容易。
entries.en: Mutually beneficial agreements between member nations are much easier to coordinate when supervisory agents from the leader nation are directly embedded in each member's governing apparatus.

entries.zh: 联邦成员国间的科研协议和移民条约无需花费£influence£影响力来维护。
entries.en: Research Agreements and Migration Pacts between federations members cost no £influence£ Influence in their upkeep.

entries.zh: 在有记载以来的很长一段时间里，联邦中各盟国之间保持着卓有成效的合作。即使各成员可以自由地按各自的选择而投票，却依然在各项重大事务中始终保持一致。
entries.en: With a record of long, fruitful cooperation within the alliance, federation members - who are of course free to vote as they choose - do tend to align on key issues over time.

entries.zh: 对抗强大的入侵者的防卫需求使得全星系保持着脆弱的和平态势。我们要一同着手维持这样的态势，对抗内部或者外部的捣蛋鬼。
entries.en: Collective deterrence against hegemonic aggressors has preserved the fragile peace of this galaxy. We will stand together against all who threaten that order, whether from within or without.

entries.zh: 如果我们意图拥有足以统治的道德权威，我们需要向全星系展示我们不只有抵御星系免受外来威胁的意愿，更拥有这种能力。
entries.en: If we intend to possess the moral authority to govern, we need to show the galaxy we have not just the will to defend it from outside threats, but also the means.

entries.zh: 联邦议程的决断者——我们的特使们——利用他们的政治头脑积极努力，以便增进联邦的归属感及各成员国间的互惠互利。
entries.en: The arbiters of the federation agenda - our envoys - are savvy and active in their effort to improve the sense of belonging and mutual benefit between our members.

entries.zh: 联邦任意成员国每指派一名行政官到联邦将获得§Y2§!凝聚力以及§Y5%§!的信任度增长。
entries.en: Gain §Y2§! Unity and §Y5%§! Trust Growth for each Official assigned to the federation by any member.

entries.zh: 我们的特使日夜不息地工作，推广和鼓动联邦的议程和目标，在全星系激发友善和信心。
entries.en: Our envoys work ceaselessly to promote and encourage the federation's agenda and purpose, inspiring kinship and confidence across the galaxy.

entries.zh: 联邦任意成员国每指派一名行政官到联邦将获得§Y2§!凝聚力以及提升§Y5§!点信任度上限。
entries.en: Gain §Y2§! Unity and raise Trust Cap by §Y5§! for each Official assigned to the federation by any member.

entries.zh: 不论有怎样的文化和生理差异，我们联邦的发展是为了增进所有人的利益。
entries.en: Regardless of cultural or biological differences, growth of the federation is to everyone's benefit.

entries.zh: 新成员国对联邦施加的团结度惩罚减少§Y50%§!。
entries.en: New members impose a §Y50%§! smaller Cohesion penalty to the federation.

entries.zh: 唇枪舌战是试炼点子最好的熔炉，只要目标是未来的稳定，争论便是一种伟大的手段。
entries.en: There is no better crucible for trying out ideas than a heated debate, and dispute is a great tool when the aim is to build a stable future.

entries.zh: 联邦投票失败对联邦施加的团结度惩罚减小§Y50%§!。
entries.en: Failed federation votes impose a §Y50%§! smaller Cohesion penalty to the federation.

entries.zh: 知晓我们的联合舰队正巡看虚空将使我们的成员国感到自豪、安全与坚定。
entries.en: To know that our joined fleets are patrolling the void bestows our members with a sense of pride, security and resolve.

entries.zh: £unity£ §Y每月凝聚力§!收入等于联邦舰队规模的§Y10%§!。
entries.en: £unity£ §YMonthly Unity§! equal to §Y10%§! of the size of the Federation Fleet.

entries.zh: 榜样领袖意义重大，鼓舞人心，因此领袖可以免于受到任何会阻碍其成为榜样的限制。
entries.en: Leading by example can be a powerful and inspiring thing, and thus the leader is free of any restrictions that would prevent this.

entries.zh: 联邦主席国无需削减自身海军容量便能为联邦舰队容量作贡献。
entries.en: Federation president contributes to federation fleet capacity without deducting their own naval capacity.

entries.zh: 不是朋友，必是敌人。所有一切反对我们的势力都将因被视为威胁而被铲除。
entries.en: If they're not with us, they're against us. Any - and every - force that oppose us must be considered a threat, and dealt with accordingly.

entries.zh: 主席国获得强迫非联邦帝国加入联邦的§Y战争目标§!。
entries.en: President gets the §YEstablish Hegemony Wargoal§! to force a non-federation empire to join the federation.

entries.zh: 主席国的力量不允许在任何时候被削弱。因此我们急需来自联邦附属国大量而积极的支持。
entries.en: The might of the ruler cannot be undermined at any point. Full and active support from the hegemony's subjects is imperative.

entries.zh: 每位成员贡献§Y10%§!的§Y$MOD_DIPLO_WEIGHT_MULT$§!给联邦主席。
entries.en: Every member transfers §Y10%§! of their §Y$MOD_DIPLO_WEIGHT_MULT$§! to the president.

entries.zh: 我们的代表将阻止众多渎神行为。
entries.en: Many are the sacrileges that our representatives may prevent.

entries.zh: 被派到联邦的§Y$official_plural_with_icon$§!将产出额外§G50%§!§Y团结度§!并使帝国范围内§Y唯心主义§!思潮吸引力提升§Y20%§!。
entries.en: §Y$official_plural_with_icon$§! assigned to the Federation will now provide §G50%§! more §YCohesion§! and increase §YSpiritualist§! ethic attraction within our Empire by §Y20%§!.

entries.zh: 我们复合的文化身份的就是我们的力量。促进文化就是对我们自身力量的极大提升。
entries.en: Our blend of cultural identities is our strength. By promoting it, we will immeasurably increase our might.
$mod_planet_civilians_unity_produces_add$: §G+1§!\n[civilian.GetIcon] [civilian.GetNamePlural] gain additional effects from Empire's ethics.

entries.zh: 我们唯有将其写入星系法才能确保唯心主义者的利益受到保护。
entries.en: We cannot guarantee that spiritualist interests will be protected unless we are able to encode them into galactic law.

entries.zh: 教团没有财富便不可能繁荣发展。我们应利用商贸的力量来让他们变得更加繁荣，以便让我们更加接近灵魂的目标。
entries.en: The priestly orders cannot thrive without wealth. We shall harness the power of commerce to grant them greater prosperity - and therefore put us closer to fulfilling our spiritual aims.

entries.zh: 能够使用§Y神圣契约§!贸易政策，该政策将我们§Y50%§!的$r_trade$转化为$r_unity$。
entries.en: Grants access to the §YHoly Covenant§! Trade Policy, which converts §Y50%§! of our $r_trade$ into $r_unity$.

entries.zh: 我们联盟的日益紧密将在我们人民的繁荣和精神福祉中结出硕果。
entries.en: The ever greater closeness of our union shall bear fruit in the prosperity and spiritual wellbeing of our peoples.

entries.zh: 领导这个圣约是迈向灵性升格的一大步。
entries.en: Leadership of this holy covenant is a grand step towards spiritual ascension.

entries.zh: 祭司越多，我们需要忍受的灵魂上的不洁就越少。
entries.en: The more priests, the less spiritual impurity we will be forced to tolerate.

entries.zh: £unity£凝聚力专注的§Y殖民地规划§!使每25£pop£§Y人口§!产出额外§G+1§!£job_priest£§Y$job_priest_plural$§!（该效果可以进一步通过殖民地飞升来提高）。
entries.en: £unity£ Unity-focused §YColony Designations§! will produce an extra §G+1§! £job_priest£ §Y$job_priest_plural$§! jobs per 25 £pop£ §YPops§! (this can be further increased via Colony Ascension).

entries.zh: 随着我们愈发关注精神事务，教士队伍逐渐变得臃肿庞大。其中最具天赋者应当晋升为扩大的教会领导层。
entries.en: With our increased focus on matters of spirituality, the priestly classes have swelled to unwieldy proportions. The most talented among them shall now be promoted into an expanded ecclesiastical leadership.

entries.zh: §M虚境§!就是未来。我们必要拥有它。
entries.en: The §MShroud§! is the future. We shall make it ours.

entries.zh: 我们的信仰是神圣契约的核心。不会再容许出现任何异端：如果还想留在联盟内，所有的成员必须做好自己的分内工作。
entries.en: Our faith is at the core of the holy covenant. No more shall heresies be permitted: all members must pull their weight if they are to remain within our union.

entries.zh: 非唯心主义非格式塔帝国的§Y官僚§!建筑替换为§Y寺庙§!。\n唯心主义帝国获得§G+1§!$r_unity$$produced_per_pop_group_unit$£job_priest£§Y$job_priest_plural$§!。\n所有帝国的机器人口组装减慢§R30%§!，但有机人口增速提高§G+15%§!。
entries.en: Non-spiritualist non-gestalt empires have §YBureaucratic§! buildings swapped for §YTemples§!.\nSpiritualist empires gain §G+1§! $r_unity$ $produced_per_pop_group_unit$ £job_priest£ §Y$job_priest_plural$§!.\nAll empires face §R30%§! slower robotic pop assembly but §G+15%§! faster organic pop growth.

entries.zh: 泽珞是一种尚未充分开发的资源。我们最杰出的大脑已经找到了更好的利用方法。
entries.en: Zro deposits are a largely untapped resource. Our best minds can surely find ways to put it to greater use.

entries.zh: 解锁§Y泽珞催化§!法令，让我可以将£sr_zro£§Y泽珞§!转化为资源产出的提升。
entries.en: Unlocks the §YZro Catalysis§! Edict, which allows us to convert £sr_zro£ §YZro§! into increased resource output.

entries.zh: 承蒙神圣契约的恩典，总统可以在他们的领域内行使更大的实权。
entries.en: By grace of the Holy Covenant, the president may exercise greater executive power in their realm.

entries.zh: 相异思潮对联邦团结度的影响降低§Y50%§!。
entries.en: Diverse Ethics impose a §Y50%§! smaller penalty to federation Cohesion.

entries.zh: 能够使用§Y贸易联盟§!的贸易政策，该政策将收获的$r_trade$中的§Y50%§!转化为$r_energy$、$r_unity$以及$r_consumer_goods$。\n所有联邦成员之间免费且自动签订§Y商业协议§![Root.GetTradeFederationWaylineEffect]。
entries.en: Grants access to the §YTrade League§! Trade Policy, which grants $r_energy$, $r_unity$ and $r_consumer_goods$ equal to §Y50%§! of our collected $r_trade$.\nFree and automatic §YCommercial Pacts§![Root.GetTradeFederationWaylineEffect] between all federation members.

entries.zh: 成员国需经主席国批准后方可退出联邦。如主席国拒绝，相应成员国会获得§Y脱离§!的宣战理由以离开联邦。
entries.en: Members cannot freely leave the federation without the president's approval. If the president refuses, the member gets the §YSecession§! Casus Belli to leave the federation.

entries.zh: 所有联邦成员国间自动签署免费的§Y科研协议§!。
entries.en: Free and automatic §YResearch Agreements§! between all federation members.
§RA §Y$hegemony_federation$§! cannot ban subject nations from joining.§!

entries.zh: 一个有着零重力立场的巨型船坞，能够执行多个星舰建设项目。
entries.en: A zero-G construction yard of overwhelming proportion, capable of performing several space ship assembly projects simultaneously.

entries.zh: 作为一个行动自如、大小空前的太空基地，主宰级舰船可以将进攻作战提升到一个全新的高度。
entries.en: A mobile space base of unparalleled proportions, the Juggernaut ship class takes offensive warfare to a whole new level.

entries.zh: 改良陶瓷在工业中的广泛运用能够提高冶金产量。
entries.en: The widespread use of advanced ceramics in industry can improve metallurgical yields.

entries.zh: 采用尖端技术取代过时的瓷金设备后，我们的煅炉将更高温、更耐久，进而提高其产能。
entries.en: By replacing antiquated ceramo-metal equipment with cutting edge technology, we can run our forges hotter and longer, increasing production.

entries.zh: 基础的行政人工智能可以用于精简供需线，减少浪费。
entries.en: Basic administrative AIs can be used to streamline supply and demand lines, reducing waste.

entries.zh: 通过高级人工智能，我们能够在消费需求存在之前便可靠地做出预测。
entries.en: Using advanced AIs, we can reliably predict consumer demand before it exists.

entries.zh: 自两个星际物种相遇以来，不受外交关系影响的实质星系贸易就一直存在着。\n\n作为星系领袖，我们应该同意是时候§Y使这种贸易市场合法化§!，让大家都可从中受益。
entries.en: De facto galactic trade, unbound by international diplomacy, has existed since the first two interstellar species met.\n\nAs galactic leaders we should agree that it is time to §Ylegitimize this commercial forum§! so that all may benefit.
The $action.106.name$ will not be formed yet.

entries.zh: 尽管保护环境的重要性显而易见，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的各个帝国应得到足够的信任，并自行作出自己的决定。
entries.en: While protecting the environment is clearly important, the empires of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be trusted to make their own decisions.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_ecology_natural_sanctuaries$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_ecology_recycling_initiatives$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_ecology_integrated_gardens$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_ecology_natural_sanctuaries$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_ecology_environmental_control_board$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_ecology_integrated_gardens$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_ecology_paradise_initiative$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_ecology_environmental_control_board$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 如果尽可能地减少浪费并推广循环利用，我们每个人都会受益。在[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中的国家间共建再利用规程对我们都有好处。
entries.en: We all benefit from reducing waste and reusing what we can. Sharing recycling protocols between the nations of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will help all of us.

entries.zh: 我们应该将自然区域像花园一样保护起来，这样我们的国民就能去那里远离烦恼。重工业将受到少许限制，但这不会有太大影响。
entries.en: We should preserve natural spaces as parks, where citizens can escape from their troubles. Minor restrictions to heavy industry are required, but it's a low price to pay.

entries.zh: 通过鼓励公民自耕自食，并强制推广易用的水耕设备，我们可以减少对环境的影响，增加绿化率。
entries.en: By encouraging our citizens to grow their own food and mandating easy to use hydroponic systems, we can reduce our impact on the worlds we live in and enjoy more greenery.

entries.zh: §Y环保主义者帝国§!中天然存在的障碍产生的£unity£$unity$：§G+1§!£unity£
entries.en: £unity£ $unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for §YEnvironmentalist Empires§!: §G+1§! £unity£
In breach of Environmental Control Board

entries.zh: 工业界不会进行自我监察。因而我们需要一个跨国环境控制委员会，赋予其监督工业和建设的权力，以制止对环境的破坏。
entries.en: Industry cannot regulate itself. We need a multinational environmental control board with the power to oversee industry and development to shut down environmental abuse.

entries.zh: 禁止建造§Y都市星球§!，且除改造为§Y盖亚星球§!外，§R禁止§!对行星的一切§Y环境改造§!。禁止使用§Y$arkship_stellar_ignition$§!以及使用§Y$dyson_gun_0$§!改变行星的大气温度。\n§Y环境主义帝国§!从自然存在的障碍中获取的£unity£$unity$：§G+2§!£unity£
entries.en: Converting planets into an §YEcumenopolis§! or §YTerraforming§! them into anything other than a §YGaia World§!, using §Y$arkship_stellar_ignition$§!, and firing a §Y$dyson_gun_0$§! that alters a planet's temperature, are §Rbanned§!.\n£unity£ $unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for §YEnvironmentalist Empires§!: §G+2§! £unity£

entries.zh: §Y环保主义者帝国§!中天然存在的障碍产生的£unity£$unity$：§G+3§!£unity£\n\n§Y环保主义者帝国§!中天然存在的障碍产生的£job_ranger£$job_ranger$岗位：§G+1§!£job_ranger£
entries.en: £unity£ $unity$ from Naturally Occuring Blockers for §YEnvironmentalist Empires§!: §G+3§! £unity£\n\n£job_ranger£ $job_ranger$ Jobs from Naturally Occuring Blockers for §YEnvironmentalist Empires§!: §G+1§! £job_ranger£

entries.zh: 通过细心呵护我们赖以生存的世界，我们可以与环境和谐相处。我们的目标应是：在踏足过的地方，除回忆以外，什么痕迹都不留下。
entries.en: With meticulous caretaking of our worlds, we can live in ecological harmony. It should be our goal to leave only memories behind where we tread.

entries.zh: 星系法正将大量知识产权及国家安全问题置于危险之中。我们必须废除这些误入歧途的法律以便保护我们的民众。
entries.en: Galactic law currently places significant amounts of intellectual property and national security issues at risk. We must repeal these misguided laws in order to protect our people.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_astral_studies_network$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_cooperative_research_channels$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_astral_studies_network$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_advanced_xenostudies$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_extradimensional_experimentation$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_galacticstudies_ethical_guideline_refactoring$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们应该建立协议，准许[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的科学家群体更便捷地分享和评议他们取得的发现。
entries.en: We should establish protocols that permit the scientists of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] to share and review discoveries more easily.

entries.zh: 通过将恒星基地连接成巨型传感器网格，我们可以极大改善收集到的数据的质量。
entries.en: By linking our starbases together into a massive sensor mesh, we can greatly improve the quality of data that we gather.

entries.zh: 增强§Y$sm_solar_panel_network$§!，§Y$sm_black_hole_observatory$§!和§Y$sm_listening_post$§!恒星基地模块及建筑的效率。
entries.en: Enhances the effectiveness of the §Y$sm_solar_panel_network$§!, §Y$sm_black_hole_observatory$§!, and §Y$sm_listening_post$§! starbase modules and buildings.

entries.zh: 宇宙中的各种文明身上还有许多值得我们学习的地方。我们应当在所有的恒星基地上增设信息获取仪器，以与太空城邦进行更密切的交流合作。
entries.en: There is much to learn from all of the cultures of the universe. We should add additional information-gathering instrumentation to all starbases while working more closely with Enclaves.

entries.zh:
观测站在§Y观测§!前超光速文明时可以产出更多的£society£§H社会学研究点数§!。

增强§Y$sm_art_college$§!、§Y$sm_curator_think_tank$§!、§Y$sm_salvager_workshop$§!以及§Y$sm_mercenary_garrison$§!等恒星基地建筑的效果。

§Y取缔人工智能§!和§Y$interference_not_allowed$§!政策将被§R禁止§!。
entries.en:
Observation Posts provide additional £society£ §HSociety Research§! while §YObserving§! pre-FTL civilizations.

Enhances the effectiveness of the §Y$sm_art_college$§!, §Y$sm_curator_think_tank$§!, §Y$sm_salvager_workshop$§!, and §Y$sm_mercenary_garrison$§! starbase buildings.

The §YArtificial Intelligence Outlawed§! and §Y$interference_not_allowed$§! policies are §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 追寻更加深刻的科学原理，将我们从陈腐的伦理观念的禁锢中解放出来，是我们崇高的责任。
entries.en: To possess the ability to further science provides a moral imperative to do so, free from outdated ethical concepts that restrain us. We do what we must because we can.

entries.zh:
§Y$research_restriction_dangerous_forbidden$§!政策被§R禁止§!。
启用§Y$research_restriction_dangerous_encouraged$§!政策。
所有帝国必须使用各自允许的最高级别的§Y领袖增强§!政策，否则将处于§R违反星系法§!状态！

§Y平等主义§!帝国可能无法满足这一要求，因此也将处于§R违反星系法§!状态！
entries.en:
The §Y$research_restriction_dangerous_forbidden$§! policy is §Rbanned§!.
Enables the §Y$research_restriction_dangerous_encouraged$§! policy.
Empires must use the most powerful §YLeader Enhancement§! policy available to them or be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!!

Empires that are §YEgalitarian§! may be unable to meet this requirement and will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!!

entries.zh: 初步研究表明，大量使用现实改造物质可以给予研究者们意想不到的研究见解。\n\n§R反正，能有多坏的结果呢？§!
entries.en: Preliminary studies suggest that extensive use of reality-altering substances can grant researchers unexpected insights.\n\n§RAfter all, what's the worst that could happen?§!

entries.zh: 消耗£sr_zro£泽珞以解锁一项殖民地决议，资助在$building_research_efficiency_1$内进行的异次元体研究。
entries.en: Unlocks a Colony Decision that consumes £sr_zro£ Zro to fund extradimensional research at $building_research_efficiency_1$.

entries.zh: 该行星的$building_research_efficiency_1$正在进行异次元体实验。\n\n§R能有什么问题呢？§!
entries.en: Extradimensional studies are ongoing at this planet's $building_research_efficiency_1$.\n\n§RWhat could possibly go wrong?§!

entries.zh: 该研究方法非常危险，必须结束。我们之前有欠考虑。
entries.en: This experimentation is dangerous and must end. What were we thinking?

entries.zh: 宇宙的奥秘并非显而易见的。\n\n[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已批准使用现实更改物质以增加研究，使我们在$building_research_efficiency_1$的科研人员可以一探未知的真相。
entries.en: The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.\n\nThe [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our scientists in $building_research_efficiency_1$ to probe other realities for the truth.

entries.zh: 宇宙的奥秘并非显而易见的。\n\n[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已批准使用现实更改物质以增加研究，使我们在$building_research_efficiency_1$的[root.GetResearcherPlural]可以一探未知的真相。
entries.en: The secrets of this universe are not all that is out there.\n\nThe [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has authorized the use of reality-altering substances to enhance our research, allowing our [root.GetResearcherPlural] in $building_research_efficiency_1$ to probe other realities for the truth.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]无权干预工业事宜。我们不应该被其他国家强加观点。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has no place meddling in industrial matters. We should not be forcing our views on other empires.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_industry_collective_waste_management$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_industry_regulatory_facilitation$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_industry_building_a_better_tomorrow$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_industry_collective_waste_management$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_industry_environmental_ordinance_waivers$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_industry_building_a_better_tomorrow$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_industry_project_cornucopia$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_industry_environmental_ordinance_waivers$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 我们应当把规章问题交给专家来决定。工业领袖们最有能力和资格鉴别出阻碍生产力的无效规章。
entries.en: We should leave regulatory decisions to the experts. Industry leaders are the best qualified to identify wasteful regulations that impede productivity.

entries.zh: 与其强制每间工厂都肩负起处理自己产生的废弃物的责任，不如去指定特定区域来储存我们发展过程中产生的废物。
entries.en: Instead of forcing each mine or factory to bear the burden of dealing with industrial waste themselves, we should designate areas where we can store the leftovers of progress.

entries.zh: 发展是重中之重，绝不可以被任何障碍阻挡。让我们互相共享技术，以更好地利用和支配自然世界。
entries.en: Progress cannot be limited by any obstacles that stand before us. Let us share techniques with one another to aid us in harnessing and dominating the natural world.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]应当授权当地议会停止执行那些对公众不再有利而且阻碍发展的过时的规章制度。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should empower local councils to suspend antiquated rules that do not serve the public good and are simply blocking progress.

entries.zh: 锻造、工业和精炼类的行星规划类型将获得额外的增益。
entries.en: Forge, Industry, and Refinery planetary designations gain additional bonuses.

entries.zh: 只要我们敢于拼搏，无尽的宝藏唾手可得。只要征服了内心的恐惧，我们可以创造巨大的奇迹。
entries.en: Near-endless resources are at our fingertips, if we have the courage to seize them. Just think of what wonders we could build if we conquer our fear.

entries.zh: 解锁一项§H殖民地决议§!，允许星球露天开采，以发现丰富的矿物资源。
entries.en: Unlocks a §HColony Decision§! that permits strip mining our worlds to uncover rich mineral deposits.

entries.zh: 高强度的露天开采作业使得这颗行星难以居住……但更容易利用。
entries.en: Extensive strip mining operations made this planet harder to inhabit... And easier to exploit.

entries.zh: 全[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的工程师们汇聚一堂，对如何更高效地利用我们星球的资源畅所欲言。\n\n殖民地决议§H丰饶计划§!现已可用。
entries.en: Engineers from across the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] have come together to share ideas on ways to more exploit resources from our worlds.\n\nThe §HProject Cornucopia§! Colony Decision is now available.

entries.zh: 自由市场应当保有最大限度的自由，不应被[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]干预。
entries.en: The free market should be left to its own devices without the meddling of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].
Repeals the §Y$resolution_commerce_leveraged_privateering$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_commerce_buzzword_standardization$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_commerce_underdeveloped_system_utilization$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_commerce_leveraged_privateering$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_commerce_holistic_asset_coordination$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_commerce_underdeveloped_system_utilization$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_commerce_profit_maximization_engines$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_commerce_holistic_asset_coordination$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 我们应该使得我们的企业之间可以进行无缝的对接交流。有目的地简化沟通术语可以让中介工作更加有效，更易于达成关键的指标。
entries.en: We have to enable our enterprises to work seamlessly with one another. Streamlining strategic communications empowers our agents, making hitting key performance metrics easier.

entries.zh: 贸易流动如同星系的血液。整个[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的所有成员应当共同组成一支跨国的星际武装以镇压海盗及其他对自由贸易的威胁。
entries.en: Trade is the lifeblood of the galaxy. All members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should contribute to a multinational space force to combat piracy and other threats to free commerce.

entries.zh: 对我们影响力范围内的星系而言，如果无法最大限度榨取其中的价值将是一种极大的浪费和罪恶。我们建议强制执行前述标准，并且对不达标者进行相应的处罚。
entries.en: Failure to extract maximum value from the systems within our sphere of influence is a criminal waste. We propose that it be enforced as such and punished accordingly.

entries.zh: 观测站在§Y观测§!前超光速文明时产出£consumer_goods£ §G消费品§!
entries.en: Observation Posts provide £consumer_goods£ §GConsumer Goods§! while §YObserving§! pre-FTL civilizations.

entries.zh: 为了构建更优化的物流输出，我们应当齐心协力共创便捷的星系级基础设施，以提高商贸和信息共享的效率。
entries.en: To promote and facilitate an optimized logistic output, we should work together to stimulate a streamlined, galactic infrastructure for market and knowledge sharing.

entries.zh: 我们应当在每个星球上建立计算机间的互联，从而优化信息与资源的分配。财富必将滚滚而来。
entries.en: We should build interlinked complexes of computers on each of our worlds that optimize the distribution of information and resources. The wealth must flow.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]在教导成员们如何生活的方面做过头了。老实说，这太冒犯了。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] oversteps its bounds by attempting to tell its members how to live. Frankly, it's insulting.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_greatergood_five_year_plans$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_greatergood_workers_rights$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_greatergood_five_year_plans$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_greatergood_greater_than_ourselves$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_greatergood_universal_prosperity_mandate$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_greatergood_balance_in_the_middle$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 将工人权利编纂成为法典并使其不再遭受普遍的压榨是理所应当的。
entries.en: It is only right for us to codify the rights of the worker and protect them from common abuses.

entries.zh: 各个星球的执政长官应当拥有必要的自由，以提出并推行利于所有人发展的全面改革计划。
entries.en: The governors of our worlds should be given the freedom necessary to propose and enact sweeping reforms for the betterment of all.

entries.zh: 农业、发电和采矿星球规划类型将获得额外增益。\n\n§Y基本保障§!生活标准被§R禁止§!。
entries.en: Agri-World, Generator, and Mining planetary designations gain additional bonuses.\n\n§YBasic Subsistence§! living standard §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 我们已经要民众付出了许多，但有时我们必须要他们付出更多。我们应该嘉奖那些将国家置于自身需求之上，自愿开拓边陲的人们。
entries.en: We ask much of our people, but sometimes we must ask more. We should reward those who are willing to place the Empire above their own needs and volunteer to head to the frontier.

entries.zh:
解锁新法令，该法令鼓励失业的自由人口自行迁移至帝国内适合自己且拥有住房与岗位的星球。

§Y基本保障§!与§Y阶层经济§!生活标准将§R被禁止§!。

§Y奴隶劳工§!，§Y牲口§!与§Y电网融合§!奴隶类型将§R被禁止§!。
entries.en:
Unlocks an edict that encourages free unemployed pops to voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire.

§YBasic Subsistence§! and §YStratified Economy§! living standards are §Rbanned§!.

§YChattel Slavery§!, §YLivestock§!, and §YGrid Amalgamation§! slavery types are §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 鼓励失业的自由人口自行迁移至帝国内适合自己且拥有住房与岗位的星球。
entries.en: Encourages free unemployed pops to voluntarily resettle themselves to suitable planets with jobs and housing within our empire.

entries.zh: 随着这些权利在刚刚的[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]议案中通过，我们同时要求工人们承担更多的责任。\n\n我们现在可以鼓励失业工人自行迁移到我们控制的其他拥有足够住房，岗位的宜居星球。
entries.en: Alongside the rights enshrined in recent [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] resolutions, we ask additional responsibilities of our workers.\n\nWe can now encourage unemployed workers to voluntarily resettle to other worlds we control that have available housing, jobs, and are of adequate habitability.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予工作子个体更多权限的法规。\n\n尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了转运空闲简单子个体而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their worker drones.\n\nWhile this is largely meaningless to us, we can at least benefit from some of the infrastructure they have created in order to resettle inactive simple drones.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经通过了给予劳工更多权益的法规。\n\n尽管这对我们来说没有什么太大的意义，但是我们至少可以从他们为了安置空闲子个体和劳工们而造的基础设施中稍稍获益。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has passed regulations granting additional privileges for their workers.\n\nWhile this ruling is largely meaningless to us, we can derive some token benefit from the infrastructure they created for resettling their own inactive drones and laborers.

entries.zh: 我们必须消除一切形式的不平等，不惜一切必要的手段创造公平，绝不允许朱门酒肉臭，路有冻死骨的情况发生。
entries.en: We must tackle inequality in all of its forms, enforcing fairness by any means necessary. What good is a feast if you have already had enough, and why should it go to waste when your neighbor is hungry?

entries.zh: §Y基本保障§!，§Y阶层经济§!，§Y体面标准§!以及§Y学术特权§!生活标准将§R被禁止§!。\n\n任何形式的§Y奴隶制度§!都将§R被禁止§!。
entries.en: §YBasic Subsistence§!, §YStratified Economy§!, §YDecent Conditions§!, and §YAcademic Priviledge§! living standards are §Rbanned§!.\n\n§YSlavery§! of all types is §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 如果连横跨许多文明的星系都无法供养我们的全体人民，那么我们其实已经失职了。每个人都有追求任何事物的权利。我们应当进行额外的行动来再分配过量的财富，从而改善全体人民的生活。
entries.en: If our galaxy spanning civilizations cannot provide for all of our people, then we have failed them. There is no excuse for anyone in the galaxy to want for anything. We should additionally act to redistribute excess wealth for the betterment of all.

entries.zh:
除§Y同甘共苦§!，§Y乌托邦式富足§!、§Y员工所有制§!、§Y化学极乐§!以及§Y强制调养§!之外的生活标准将§R被禁止§!。

§Y同化§!有机人口将其整合进§Y同化斗士§!或者§Y蜂巢思维§!帝国的行为将§R被禁止§!。

非§Y平等主义§!帝国或§Y失控机仆§!帝国有可能无法满足上述要求，因此也将处于§R违反星系法§!状态！
entries.en:
All living standards other than §YShared Burdens§!, §YEmployee Ownership§!, §YUtopian Abundance§!, §YChemical Bliss§!, or §YMandatory Pampering§! are §Rbanned§!.

§YAssimilating§! organics into a §YDriven Assimilator§! or §YHive Mind§! empire is §Rbanned§!.

Empires that are not §YEgalitarian§! or §YRogue Servitors§! may be unable to meet these requirements and will be in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!!

entries.zh: 军事事务应当由联邦与防御条约所决定，参议院无权干涉。
entries.en: Federations and Defensive Pacts are where military matters should be discussed, not on the Senate Floor.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_military_readiness_act$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_the_readied_shield$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_military_readiness_act$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_proclamation$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_enemy_of_my_enemy$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_renegade_containment$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_mutualdefense_castigation_proclamation$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 宇宙极其危险，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的全体成员应当时刻准备保护自己的星球免遭海盗，太空生物或是什么其他未知事物的攻击。
entries.en: The universe is a dangerous place, and all members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] should be ready to defend their worlds whether it be against pirates, space creatures, or the unknown.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的每位成员不论为自己还是为他人都有义务为星系防御贡献一份力量。
entries.en: Each member of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has a duty to themselves and to others to contribute to galactic defense.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中舰队数量未达到海军容量一半的非附庸成员将处于§R违反星系法§!状态。
entries.en: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members that are not vassals of another empire that are using less than half of their naval capacity are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 你的敌人就是我的敌人
与我们当中某位为敌就是与我们全体为敌。如果成员之一遭到进攻，我们难道不应该动用一切力量来惩罚入侵者吗？
entries.en: An enemy of one is the enemy of all. If one of our number is attacked, should we not permit any of our number to punish the offender?

entries.zh: 对向我[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员发起侵略战争的未处于[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]之内的国家获得§Y反击§!宣战理由。
entries.en: Grants the §Y'Counterattack'§! casus belli on empires that are not [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] members and are in an offensive war against a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member.

entries.zh: 不与我们为伍者即是敌人，而所有胆敢对抗星系法的国家必须得到他们应有的惩罚。
entries.en: Those who are not with us are against us, and all who stand against Galactic Law must be punished.

entries.zh: 所有[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员能够提出议案以§Y谴责§!处于§R违反星系法§!状态的成员或是未处于[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]之内的国家。\n\n启用§Y无限制战争§!的帝国将能对被[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]所§R谴责§!的国家或是处于§R违反星系法§!状态的成员使用§Y敌意§!宣战理由及§Y羞辱§!战争目标。
entries.en: Any Empire in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] can propose a resolution to §YDenounce§! an Empire in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! or that is not a [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] member.\n\nThe §Y'Animosity'§! casus belli and §Y'Humiliation'§! wargoal can be used by empires with §YUnrestricted Wars§! against empires that have been §RDenounced§! by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] or are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 对目标帝国发出正式的谴责声明。该行为可以非[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的国家或违反星系法的帝国为目标发起。
entries.en: A formal declaration denouncing the target empire. This proposal can target any empire that is either not a member of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] or is in Breach of Galactic Law.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员国资格的益处不言而喻，拒绝成为成员国的行为本身就彰露出明显的恶意。各成员国应当获得授权，在那些非成员国实现他们的密谋之前用武力抢先阻止任何恶意举动。
entries.en: The benefits of membership in the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] are self-evident, and as such refusal to be a member clearly indicates ill intent. Members should be authorized to preempt any nefarious acts with force before non-members enact their plots.

entries.zh: 启用§Y无限制战争§!的帝国获得§Y先发制人§!的全面战争宣战理由，可对非[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]成员国的国家使用。
entries.en: Grants the §Y'Preemptive War'§! total war casus belli on empires that are not members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] for empires with §YUnrestricted Wars§!.

entries.zh: 强权即公理。通过限制战争来掩盖战争的恐怖不过是自欺欺人罢了。当真正的威胁出现时，我们应该废除这些法条，解除限制。
entries.en: Might makes right. Attempting to hide the horrors of war by placing limits on it is just lying to ourselves. We should repeal these laws and untie our hands should a true threat appear.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_guardian_angels$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_reverence_for_life$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_last_resort_doctrine$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_independent_tribunals$§! as galactic law.\n\n
Repeals the §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_demobilization_initiative$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_rulesofwar_last_resort_doctrine$§! as galactic law.\n\n

entries.zh: 将自己的生命奉献给维护我们殖民地和平的士兵必须被人们铭记和尊敬。
entries.en: The soldiers that dedicate their lives to keeping our colonies safe should be recognized and honored.

entries.zh: 星际级帝国之间的战争是一种可怕的东西。我们应该尽一切可能避免被卷入这样的直接战斗当中。
entries.en: The horror of war on the scale of interstellar empires is a terrible thing. We should do what we can to limit its excesses to active combatants.

entries.zh: §Y净化§!（驱逐以外）和§Y地爆天星§!被§R禁止使用§!。
entries.en: §YPurging§! (other than Displacement) and the use of §YWorld Crackers§! is §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 士兵犯下的罪行必须伸张正义，平民伤亡必须予以考虑。我们应该建立独立的法庭来调查、审判和惩治战争罪行。
entries.en: Justice must occur for crimes soldiers commit, and civilian casualties must be accounted for. We should set up independent tribunals to investigate, try, and punish war crimes.

entries.zh: §Y末日审判§!、§Y无差别§!轨道轰炸姿态、使用任何除了§Y安乐天使§!以外的巨像武器、使用§Y$dyson_gun_0$§!以及使用§Y$arkship_exodus_jump$§!均被§R禁止§!。
entries.en: §YArmageddon§! and §YIndiscriminate§! bombardment stances, using any Colossus weapon other than a §YGlobal Pacifier§!, firing the §Y$dyson_gun_0$§!, and using the §Y$arkship_exodus_jump$§! are §Rbanned§!.

entries.zh: 战争是当所有其他形式的外交手段均告失败时方可考虑使用的最后手段。永远不能为不正当目的而使用这一手段。
entries.en: War should be our last resort when all other forms of diplomacy fail. It should never be a tool that is used for unjustified purposes.

entries.zh: 战争学说§Y无限制战争§!被§R禁用§!。
目前被浪费在战争方面的资源会在其他无数的项目中被更好地使用以提高人民的生活质量。我们应该加重对军事发展的限制，并着力于改善事物而不是破坏它们。
entries.en: Resources currently wasted on war could be better used for a variety of other projects to better the lives of our civilians. We should put hard limits on military development and focus on improving things rather than destroying them.
The §YMilitarized Economy§! economic policy is banned.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCouncilOrImpCouncil]可以提出一项议案以谴责[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]中不友好的成员，如果通过他们则更容易遭受已经推出的制裁。\n\n当然，该权力不会被滥用。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCouncilOrImpCouncil] can propose a resolution to denounce unfriendly members of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], rendering them vulnerable to any Sanctions that have been passed.\n\nSurely this power won't be abused.

entries.zh: 星系理事会是一个非民主实体，应当被废除。
entries.en: The Galactic Council is an undemocratic menace and should be abolished.
The Galactic Council ceases to exist.

entries.zh: 星海共同体必须要有一个领袖的理事会以维系秩序。
entries.en: The Galactic Community should have a council of leaders to help keep order.

entries.zh: 建立一个由三位代表组成的§Y星系理事会§!。\n\n理事会一开始将拥有推行§Y紧急措施§!、§Y制裁议案§!和§Y公开谴责§!的权力。
entries.en: Establishes a §YGalactic Council§! of three members.\n\nThe Council begins with the powers to push §YEmergency Measures§!, propose §YSanction Resolutions§!, and §YDenounce§!.

entries.zh: 理事会否决权这件事本身非常荒谬。为什么共同体其他成员的意愿可以被这样随意噤声？必须立刻免除它！
entries.en: The very idea of a Council Veto is preposterous. Why should the desires of the Community be silenced? Remove it immediately!

entries.zh: 星系理事会的成员不再具有否决已提出议案的权利。
entries.en: Galactic Council members will no longer be able to veto proposed Resolutions.

entries.zh: 星系理事会应当拥有移除议案序列中无意义议案的权力。
entries.en: The Galactic Council should be granted the power to remove frivolous proposals from the Resolution Queue.

entries.zh: 星系理事会成员应当有充分的理由才可以提出谴责。我们应当移除这项不平等且独裁的权力。
entries.en: Galactic Council members should be required to have proper justification for denouncement. We should remove this unfair and autocratic ability.

entries.zh: 星系理事会的成员现在无权谴责不友好的共同体成员。
entries.en: Galactic Council members will no longer be able to denounce unfriendly Community members.

entries.zh: 我们应该赋予星系理事会给予流氓帝国以惩罚的权力。他们应当可以在共同体中提出谴责。
entries.en: We should give the Galactic Council the ability to target rogue empires for punishment. They should be able to make Denouncement proposals to the Community.

entries.zh: 星系理事会的成员将有权谴责不友好的共同体成员。
entries.en: Galactic Council members will be able to denounce unfriendly Community members.

entries.zh: 限制在小规模的民主才是好民主。
entries.en: Democracy is best in small doses.

entries.zh: 星系理事会由三位成员组成是最理想的状态。
entries.en: A Galactic Council made up of three members seems to be ideal.

entries.zh: 我们调整星系理事会的席位数是有其必要性的。四位应当是最合适的数量。
entries.en: Necessity demands that we adjust the number of members on the Galactic Council. Four would be best.

entries.zh: 星系理事会中声音越多越好。
entries.en: The more voices we have on the Galactic Council, the better.

entries.zh: 星海共同体在该帝国领导的荫庇之下欣欣向荣。我们应当授予其一个理事会常任席位。
entries.en: The Galactic Community has flourished under the benevolent leadership of this empire. We should give them a permanent seat on the council.

entries.zh: 在换届选举期间星系理事会的成员必须为他们的任何行为负责。该帝国不配拥有常任席位。
entries.en: Galactic Council members should be held accountable for their actions during regular elections. This empire should not have a permanent seat.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$在宣布任何制裁措施之前，必须通过一项议案来使一个帝国遭到谴责或被裁定违反星系法。
entries.en: $TRIGGER_FAIL$Before any sanctions can be declared, a resolution must be passed that can cause an empire to be denounced or to be in breach of Galactic Law.

entries.zh: 受到§R谴责§!或§R违反星系法§!的帝国将受到相应的惩罚。
entries.en: Empires that have been §RDenounced§! or are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! have penalties applied to them.

entries.zh: 我们由于受到§R谴责§!或§R违反星系法§!而受到了[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的制裁。
entries.en: We have been sanctioned by the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] for being §RDenounced§! or in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 我们对§R违反星系法§!的帝国施加的科研制裁过于严苛了。用压制科学进步的方式来解决本可以通过外交手段化解的问题是错误的。
entries.en: The research sanctions that we have levied on empires in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! are too harsh. It is wrong to slow technological progress over matters that should be handled diplomatically.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_tech_2$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_tech_1$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_tech_3$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_tech_2$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: §R违反星系法§!的帝国应当允许对他们的研究设施的定期检查，以确保他们没有违背星系对他们制订的要求。
entries.en: Empires that are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! must permit regular inspections of their research facilities to ensure that they are in compliance with galactic requirements.

entries.zh: 为维护星系法的尊严，需要采取更强硬的手段。
entries.en: Stronger measures are needed to ensure compliance with Galactic Law.

entries.zh: 任何对被制裁帝国科学研究的非法协助都必须受到严厉的惩罚。
entries.en: Any who illegally assist technological research in sanctioned empires must be punished harshly.

entries.zh: 我们对§R违反星系法§!的帝国施加的经济制裁过于严苛了。用施加经济负担的方式来解决本可以通过外交手段化解的问题是错误的。
entries.en: The economic sanctions that we have levied on empires in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! are too harsh. The burden is too great over matters that should be handled diplomatically.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_economic_2$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_economic_1$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_economic_3$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_economic_2$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 我们应系统性地利用关税和检查来促进§R违反星系法§!的帝国顺从星系的意志。
entries.en: We should use a system of tariffs and inspections to encourage empires that are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§! to comply with galactic will.

entries.zh: 为维护星系法的尊严，需要采取更强硬的手段。
entries.en: Stronger measures are needed to ensure compliance with Galactic Law

entries.zh: 我们必须不择手段让这些帝国明白，只有遵循星系法才有可能满足他们的经济利益。
entries.en: We must use all means at our disposal to convince empires that it is their best interests economically to obey Galactic Law.

entries.zh: 限制违反星系法的帝国的海军容量是一种有风险的议案。我们应该选择其他的手段确保他们的遵纪守法。
entries.en: Restricting naval size for breaking Galactic Law is a dangerous proposition. We should use other means to ensure compliance.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_military_2$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_military_1$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_military_3$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_military_2$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 我们应该对§R违反星系法§!的帝国的海军设置合理的限制。
entries.en: We must place sensible restrictions on the navies of empires that are in §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 为维护星系法的尊严，需要采取更强硬的手段。
entries.en: Stronger measures are needed to ensure compliance with Galactic Law.

entries.zh: 对执意违反星系法的帝国，应当严格限制他们的军事力量的规模和活动范围。
entries.en: Empires that refuse to obey Galactic Law must have extreme restrictions placed on the size and deployment of their forces.

entries.zh: 我们所施行的行政制裁无法达成预期效果——我们应该充分运用一切可能的外交渠道说服这些帝国配合我们的[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]。
entries.en: Our administrative sanctions are counterproductive - we should be using all diplomatic channels at our disposal to convince empires to work with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium].
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_administrative_2$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_administrative_1$§! as galactic law.
Repeals the §Y$resolution_sanctions_administrative_3$§! resolution, leaving §Y$resolution_sanctions_administrative_2$§! as galactic law.

entries.zh: 无视星系法的帝国的外交官应该被坚定且不失礼貌地回避。
entries.en: The diplomats of empires that ignore Galactic Law should be firmly but politely shunned.

entries.zh: 为维护星系法的尊严，需要采取更强硬的手段。
entries.en: Stronger measures are needed to ensure compliance with Galactic Law.

entries.zh: 为了隔离和排斥那些不遵守[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]意志的国家，我们必须采取极端的措施。
entries.en: Extreme measures must be taken to isolate and ostracize those who will not obey the will of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium].

entries.zh: 向那些爱唱反调的人证明[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]可以做到同心协力。
entries.en: Prove to the naysayers that the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] can work together.
The Galactic Focus will remain unchanged.

entries.zh: 加入[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]的全体国家相互开放边境，并为战争进行动员。
entries.en: All empires within the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] will open borders to one another and mobilize for war.

entries.zh: 虫群天灾对于整个星系的生命体都是威胁。如果我们不团结一致阻止他们，他们就会将我们吞食殆尽。我们应该通过星系焦点处理这一危机。
entries.en: The Prethoryn Scourge is a threat to all life in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop them, they will consume us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: 异次元入侵者对于整个星系的生命体都是威胁。如果我们不团结一致阻止他们，他们就会将我们消灭殆尽。我们应该通过星系焦点处理这一危机。
entries.en: Extradimensional invaders are a threat to all life in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop them, they will overwhelm us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: 名为肃正协议的人工智能对于整个星系的生命体都是威胁。如果我们不团结一致阻止他们，他们就会将我们毁灭殆尽。我们应该通过星系焦点处理这一危机。
entries.en: The AI Contingency is a threat to all life in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop it, they will destroy us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: 肆虐的大可汗对于整个星系的自由国度都是威胁。如果我们不团结一致阻止他们，他们的舰队将碾碎我们。我们应该通过星系焦点处理这一危机。
entries.en: The Great Khan's rampage is a danger to all free empires in the galaxy. If we do not unite to stop it, we will all be crushed beneath their fleet. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: 从L-星团中喷涌而出纳米机器人对于整个星系的生命体都是威胁。如果我们不团结一致阻止纳米机群，他们就会将我们毁灭殆尽。我们应该通过星系焦点处理这一危机。
entries.en: The nanites from the L-Cluster are a threat to the entire galaxy. If we do not unite to stop the nanite swarm, they will destroy us all. We should make dealing with this crisis the Galactic Focus.

entries.zh: [SecondSleeper.GetName]在这场战争中是不义的，我们应该团结一致，公开支持[FirstSleeper.GetName]。
entries.en: The [SecondSleeper.GetName] are clearly in the wrong in this war, and we should declare unified support for the [FirstSleeper.GetName].

entries.zh: 未能在§Y天堂之战§!中加入§Y[FirstSleeper.GetName]§!会被视为§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: Failure to join the §Y[FirstSleeper.GetName]§! in the §YWar in Heaven§! is considered a §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: [FirstSleeper.GetName]在这场战争中是不义的，我们应该团结一致，公开支持[SecondSleeper.GetName]。
entries.en: The [FirstSleeper.GetName] are clearly in the wrong in this war, and we should declare unified support for the [SecondSleeper.GetName].

entries.zh: 未能在§Y天堂之战§!中加入§Y[SecondSleeper.GetName]§!会被视为§R违反星系法§!。
entries.en: Failure to join the §Y[SecondSleeper.GetName]§! in the §YWar in Heaven§! is considered a §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.

entries.zh: 焦点：谴责觉醒帝国双方
[FirstSleeper.GetName]和[SecondSleeper.GetName]两边都表现出十分的不成熟。起草一封措辞严厉的外交辞令给双方。
entries.en: Both the [FirstSleeper.GetName] and the [SecondSleeper.GetName] are acting like children. Prepare a harshly worded letter for each.

entries.zh: 在§Y天堂之战§!中加入任意一方觉醒帝国会被视为§R违反星系法§!。\n\n非觉醒帝国附庸的帝国将会得到以下加成。
entries.en: Joining either Awakened Empire in the §YWar in Heaven§! is considered a §RBreach of Galactic Law§!.\n\nEmpires that are not vassals of an Awakened Empire gain the listed bonuses.

entries.zh: 虫群天灾是整个星系面临的真正危机，我们必须团结一致，战胜威胁。
entries.en: The Prethoryn Scourge are a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.

entries.zh: 破界者是整个星系面临的真正危机，我们必须团结一致，战胜威胁。
entries.en: The Unbidden are a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.

entries.zh: 肃正协议是整个星系面临的真正危机，我们必须团结一致，战胜威胁。
entries.en: The Contingency are a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.

entries.zh: 大可汗是整个星系面临的真正危机，我们必须团结一致，战胜威胁。
entries.en: The Great Khan is a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.

entries.zh: 灰蛊风暴是整个星系面临的真正危机，我们必须团结一致，战胜威胁。
entries.en: The Gray Tempest are a true crisis and a threat to the entire galaxy. We must unite and defeat the menace.

entries.zh: 神仙打架，凡人遭难。在天堂之战中存活下来。
entries.en: When giants go to war, the universe trembles. Survive the War in Heaven.

entries.zh: 我们所信任的那些共同体的引领者同时也是共同体最坚定捍卫者的最佳人选。通过授予他们更多的权力和资源，使他们得以保护我们大家。
entries.en: Those we have trusted with guiding the Community are also the best candidates to become its most stalwart defenders. By granting them more powers and resources, we are enabling them to protect us all.

entries.zh:
理事会成员获得§G+10%§!海军容量。
星海监管人获得§G20%§!海军容量。
星海帝皇获得§G25%§!海军容量。
共同体其他成员减少§R5%§!海军容量。
entries.en:
Council Members gain §G+10%§! Naval Capacity.
The Galactic Custodian gains §G20%§! Naval Capacity.
The Galactic Emperor gains §G25%§! Naval Capacity.
Other members of the community lose §R5%§! Naval Capacity.

entries.zh: 有时候你需要一双黑手来做好事。我们对那些牺牲了道德来让我们活得更舒适的人应当保有尊敬，让他们免受非难。
entries.en: Sometimes, you need to get dirty in the name of the greater good. We honor the moral sacrifices made by those who allow us to live comfortable lives, sheltered from moral dilemmas.

entries.zh: 被指定的帝国无论如何都不会违反星系法。
entries.en: The targeted empire can never be in breach of Galactic Law.

entries.zh: $TRIGGER_FAIL$另一个帝国已经拥有宪法豁免权。
我们当中最有特权者在道义上应当帮助他人。他们将分担我们的重负，引导我们构建一个更和谐的共同体。
entries.en: The most privileged among us have a moral duty to help the others. They will shoulder our burdens to guide us all towards a more harmonious community.

entries.zh: 理事会获得§G+20%§!£diplo_weight£外交权重但减少§R15%§!的£energy£能量币、£minerals£矿物和£food£食物产出。其他的共同体成员将减少§R20%§!£diplo_weight£外交权重但获得额外§G5%§!的£energy£能量币、£minerals£矿物和£food£食物收入。
entries.en: Council Members gain §G+20%§! £diplo_weight£ Diplomatic Weight but lose §R15%§! of their income in £energy£ Energy, £minerals£ Minerals and £food£ Food. Other members of the community lose §R20%§! £diplo_weight£ Diplomatic Weight but gain §G5%§! more income in £energy£ Energy, £minerals£ Minerals and £food£ Food.

entries.zh: 该帝国目前正面临一项赤字。
entries.en: This empire is currently experiencing a deficit.

entries.zh: 谁能断言在我们的探测器范围之外没有威胁正在蠢蠢欲动？创建一个专门研究星系级威胁的委员会将会让我们做好面对一切的准备。
entries.en: Who knows what threats lurk just out of sensor range? Creating a committee dedicated to the study of galactic level threats will prepare us for anything.
