entries.en:
Another energy surge has flared out from the gateway in our home system. Unlike previous energy pulses, this one was devastating.

As the electromagnetic field swept over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] it overloaded every energy grid on the planet, frying every electrical system - some beyond repair.

For some reason the gateway flare also shook the climate, as heavy rainfalls began in several places momentarily after the incident. Most major habitations are now completely dark, their units caught in a rainfall colored blue as dying energy sparks light up the heavy drops in the sky.
The Black Crown Yields its Secrets

entries.zh: 我们的科学家最终成功地打开了黑王冠，让我们的船通过另一边那个相同的装置。作为这个神秘星门的最后礼物，当它激活时，一股数据流被传输到我们的系统，揭示了其构造背后的原理，使得之前神秘的东西突然变得非常清晰易懂。现在，我们的科学家相信，在短短几年内，我们也将能够建造新的通道，将我们帝国内的旅行时间减少到几乎为零。
entries.en: Our scientists have finally succeeded in opening the Black Crown, allowing our ships to cross to a second, identical device on the other side. As a final gift from the gateway's enigmatic builders, as it was activated, a data stream was transmitted to our systems revealing the principles behind its construction, making what had previously been mysterious suddenly seem blindingly obvious. Our scientists are now confident that, within a few short years, we too will be able to build new gateways, cutting travel times within our empire to virtually zero.
The galaxy is at our doorstep.

entries.zh: 我们的科学家已经到达星门物体以不可置信的速度坠毁到[From.Planet.GetName]上的撞击地点。\n\n毫无疑问，从撞击点的外表来看，这绝不是一次普通的坠毁着陆，我们的科学家期待进行进一步调查。
entries.en: Our scientist have reached the impact site of the object from the gateway that crashed into [From.Planet.GetName] at incredible speed.\n\nIt's clear from the look of the impact site that this was no ordinary crash landing, and our scientists are eager to investigate further.

entries.zh:
我们从[From.Planet.GetName]的挖掘地点发回来的初步报告十分令人振奋，但又有点瘆人。

我们对撞击坑和其周边的地表残骸进行了分析，结果出人意料；显然那个未知物体在撞击发生的时候，既没有减速，也没有损坏。那个物体不知以什么方式击穿了泥土层，现在正停在地底深处。

我们随时可以进行进一步挖掘。
entries.en:
Initial reports from our excavation on [From.Planet.GetName] are both extraordinary and a bit unnerving.

Analysis of the surface debris in the impact crater and its immediate surrounding revealed a surprise; apparently the unknown object did neither break, nor brake, upon impact. Somehow the object managed to pierce through the soil, and is now resting deep in the ground.

Further excavations is ready to begin.

entries.zh: 随着在[From.Planet.GetName]上的发掘工作不断接近那个深藏在地下的物体，我们的科学家开始体验到了奇怪的现象。一眨眼间数个小时的时光便已流逝，崭新的设备突然就因磨损而报废，许多区域突然遍布残骸却没人知道怎么回事，如此等等。\n\n科学团体对此无法做出确定的解释，但有一种理论声称撞击的物体由于穿透的星球的表层，因此便留下了能够扭曲时间的残留物。
entries.en: As the excavation project on [From.Planet.GetName] got closer to the object resting deep in the ground, our scientists started to experience strange phenomena. Hours were lost in the blink of an eye, new equipment suddenly breaking due to wear and tear, areas cleared of debris and no one remembers how, and so on.\n\nThe scientific community can offer no real explanation, but one theory is that the crashed object left some kind of temporal-altering residue as it impaled the planet's crust.

entries.zh:
我们的发掘小组最后终于抵达了坠落在[From.Planet.GetName]上未知物体最后停下的位置。

结果我们发现，这个东西看上去没什么大不了的，和一个华丽的炮弹没什么区别。不过随后其所处的空间就震撼了我们的科学家们。

这里是一个巨大的穴室，除了最开始这个物体降临而在天花板上撞破的一个洞之外，整个穴室没有一处出入口，是完全密封的。穴室的墙壁由一层半透明的奇怪镀层覆盖，我们的科学家现在迫切想要对其进行进一步的调查。
entries.en:
Our excavation team finally reached the final resting place for the unknown object that crashed on [From.Planet.GetName].

As it turned out, the object was of minor interest - being little more than a glorified cannonball - but the location quickly astonished the scientists.

It was a huge chamber, hermetically sealed with no entry points other than the smashed hole in the ceiling where the object had come down. The walls were covered with strange, translucent plates that our scientists are now eager to scrutinize further.

entries.zh:
覆盖在位于[From.Planet.GetName]神秘穴室墙壁上的半透明镀层似乎毫无意义，直到一位队员用手轻轻触碰了一下。

整个穴室迅速被全息投影生成文字的光芒填充，发光的符号一行接一行地悬浮在半空。这些符号被迅速翻译后，穴室中镀层的意义终于显现出来，这是一个外星构件的详细蓝图。

一个也许能打开星门的外星构件。
entries.en:
The translucent plates covering the walls of the mysterious chamber found on [From.Planet.GetName] made little sense until one team member reached out and gently touched one:

The room exploded in light as holographic glyphs appeared out of nowhere - row after row of glowing symbols hovering in mid-air. The symbols were deftly translated and purpose of the plates in the chamber became clear: they contained detailed blueprints of an alien construction.

A construction that would open the gateway.

entries.zh: 我们应该对之前从星门中射出来的未知物体造成的坠毁点进行一番更加细致的考察。
entries.en: We should take a closer look at the crash site of the unidentified object that was expelled from the gateway a while ago.

entries.zh: 根据之前在一次考古发掘中发现的外星人蓝图，我们可以组装一个构件，稍微地打开位于我们母星系的星门，我们的一艘科研船可以从中穿过。
entries.en: Following the alien blueprint found in a previous archaeological excavation, we can assemble a construction that will briefly open the gateway in our home system allow a Science Ship to pass through.

entries.zh:
最近的考古发现能够让我们建造一个构件，这能够稍稍打开神秘星门，并允许一艘科研船通过。

§R警告§!

这是一个高风险任务！你无法保证§Y科学官§!或§Y科研船§!能从这场致命的冒险中平安归来。谨慎准备。
entries.en:
Recent archaeological findings have revealed a way to build a construct that can briefly open the mysterious gateway and allow a Science Ship to pass through.

 §RWarning!§!

This is a high risk mission! There is no guarantee that either §YScientist§! or §YScience Ship§! will return from such a perilous journey. Prepare accordingly.

entries.zh: 这个社会流传着古老的传说，人们曾经一分为众，离开这颗行星去殖民这个恒星系的其他星球。
entries.en: This society has an old legend about splinter groups of the population who left the planet in search for other planets to colonize in the solar system.

entries.zh: —游戏开始时你的母星系有§Y另外两个土著文明§!。
entries.en: - Start with §Ytwo other primitive civilizations§! in your home system.

entries.zh:
我们知道，我们的种族在我们这一代之前就发展出了灿烂而辉煌的文明。但他们在故事的最后有着什么样的结局，仅剩只言片语，以及一片谜团。

其中一个流传下来的故事，说的是§Y摘星者§!中的一位——那些一度离开家园，前方附近行星定居的先驱。毫无以闻，这是一个十分精彩动人的故事。情节恢弘，充满冒险精神，然后却缺乏事实的佐证来证实这样的壮举。

现在，我们已经处于星际旅行的时代。科技的发展让我们可以离开母星的大气层，以及——可以说再一次——探索无垠的太虚。让我们揭晓吧，藏匿于古老传说之后的，终极的事实。
entries.en:
We know that our species cultivated rich and advanced civilizations before ours, but the story of what happened to them is mostly myth and speculation.

One legend that has survived is the one of the §YStar Reachers§! - pioneers that somehow managed to leave the homeworld, and supposedly settled on nearby planets. A thrilling legend, no doubt. One which breathtaking scope and adventurous spirit is matched only by its glaring lack of evidence.

We are now in a time of interstellar flight. Technology allows us to leave the atmosphere of our homeworld to - perhaps once again - explore space. Let's see how well the old legend holds up.

entries.zh: 在不知名的过去，有一位神秘的施恩者为这个文明在他们的恒星系藏了一点惊喜。
entries.en: This civilization has hidden boons in their solar system, placed there in a distant past by a mysterious benefactor.

entries.zh: —$HOME_SYSTEM$一个与神秘的施恩者相关的['concept_ex_gravitas']['concept_archaeology_site']
—在该秘密被揭示前先驱者事件链将被屏蔽
entries.en: - Precursor Event Chains blocked until this mystery is solved

entries.zh:
我们的历史处处有着古怪和不协调。我们发现一些远古城市的遗址，其年代比一些原始时代村庄的考古遗迹还要久远。我们从地下发掘出了锯子、斧头甚至步枪，它们的历史却比石矛和弓箭还要久远。

这样古怪的历史并没有阻止我们着眼于太空，并稳步迈入一个翱翔宇宙的纪元。现在我们能够脱离母星重力的束缚，着眼于恒星系里的其他行星和天体——以及除此之外广袤无垠的地方。

然而，当诡异的事情再出现之前，我们还没有离开大气层；然而有关外星起源的奇怪信号，却从我们的母星系传达了过来。
entries.en:
Ours is a history of oddities and inconsistencies. We've found ancient city ruins older than some archaeological excavations of primitive villages. We have unearthed saws, axes and even rifles which far pre-date stone-tipped spears and bows.

A peculiar history did not, however, prevent us from stepping readily into a futuristic era of spaceflight. We have now managed to escape the gravity of our home planet, aiming for other planets and bodies in our solar system - and beyond.

We had scarcely left the atmosphere before the oddities emerged anew; strange signals of alien origin coming from within our own solar system.

entries.zh: 一系列奇特的异常读数从[From.Planet.GetName]的地表源源不断地传来。我们需要启动一次地表探查以了解更多情报。
entries.en: A string of strange anomaly readings is emanating from the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We need to launch a surface excursion to find out more.

entries.zh: 我们在卫星的表面设置了一个行动基地，并派出了数个小队前往之前我们在扫描器上捕捉到的异常现象地点。\n\n这一神秘现象的重要意义非比寻常，科学界也对于考察队可能发现什么提出了诸多理论和设想。
entries.en: A base of operations has been set up on the surface of the moon, and several teams are now en route to the various anomaly sites that our scanners picked up.\n\nThe significance of this mystery is simply unparalleled, and the scientific community is absolutely buzzing with theories and anticipation over what will be uncovered by the excursion teams.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的表面设置了一个行动基地，并派出了数个小队前往之前我们在扫描器上捕捉到的异常现象地点。\n\n这一神秘现象的重要意义非比寻常，科学界也对于考察队可能发现什么提出了诸多理论和设想。
entries.en: A base of operations has been set up on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName], and several teams are now en route to the various anomaly sites that our scanners picked up.\n\nThe significance of this mystery is simply unparalleled, and the scientific community is absolutely buzzing with theories and anticipation over what will be uncovered by the excursion teams.

entries.zh:
大多数考察队都到达了目的地，并发回了报告。

埋在地底的文物被发掘出来。首席科学官[Leader.GetName]将它们形容为§Y十分精准的，星系级激光指向器§!——一种远古的机器，其作用是向太空发射高强度的、密实的紫外线射束，目的未知。

这真是一个喜忧参半的发现；外星文物的发现有着深远、令人振奋的重要性，然而它们的意图却看上去毫无章法。
entries.en:
Most excursion teams have reached their destinations and reported back.

Artifacts buried in the ground have been uncovered. Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] describes them as §Yhighly accurate, galactic laser pointers§! - ancient machines that are emitting a strong, tight ultraviolet beam out into space for purposes unknown.

It's a bittersweet discovery; the profound, exhilarating importance of alien artifacts countered by their seemingly arbitrary purpose.

entries.zh:
尽管我们尽了最大的努力，对在地表上的外星指示器的发掘和分析并没有带来任何有关联的结果。

考古队对外星信号射束进行了计算，并沿途一路追到头，但除了虚空什么也没有发现。

科学官[Leader.GetName]要求给予更多的时间；坚信科学团队可能错过了什么重要的东西。
entries.en:
Despite our best efforts the excavation and analysis of the alien indicators on the surface have failed to deliver any relevant result.

The archaeological teams have calculated and followed the paths of the alien signal beams, but nothing is being pointed at other than empty space.

Scientist [Leader.GetName] have requested more time; convinced that something has been missed by the science teams.

entries.zh:
突破性进展！

对地表的研究揭示了该卫星在几个纪元前曾经被一颗小行星撞击过。撞击并不足以摧毁这颗卫星，不过将其稍稍推出了原来的轨道。通过分析这次撞击，科学家们成功地推演出了这颗卫星最初的位置和自转，并用这些数据进行“倒带”，重演了外星指示器原本所指的位置。

于是乎，这个外星指示器的光束突然开始汇聚到恒星系内的另一颗行星上。
entries.en:
Breakthrough!

Study of the surface revealed that the moon was hit eons ago by a small asteroid. The impact was not enough to obliterate the moon but did nudge it a fraction out of its original orbit. By analyzing the impact, the scientists managed to calculate the moon's initial position and rotation, and used that data to 'rewind' the alien indicators to their original position.

And there it was: the alien indicator beams suddenly began converging on another planet in the system!

entries.zh:
突破性进展！

对地表的研究揭示了[From.Planet.GetName]在几个纪元前曾经被一颗小行星撞击过。撞击并不足以摧毁这颗卫星，不过将其稍稍推出了原来的轨道。通过分析这次撞击，科学家们成功地推演出了[From.Planet.GetName]最初的位置和自转，并用这些数据进行“倒带”，重演了外星指示器原本所指的位置。

于是乎，这个外星指示器的光束突然开始汇聚到恒星系内的另一颗行星上。
entries.en:
Breakthrough!

Study of the surface revealed that [From.Planet.GetName] was hit eons ago by a small asteroid. The impact was not enough to obliterate the planet but did nudge it a fraction out of its original orbit. By analyzing the impact, the scientists managed to calculate [From.Planet.GetName]'s initial position and rotation, and used that data to 'rewind' the alien indicators to their original position.

And there it was: the alien indicator beams suddenly began converging on another planet in the system!

entries.zh: 此前发现的外星指示器指向了这颗行星，我们应该下到其表面进行进一步的调查。
entries.en: The previously discovered alien indicators are pointing at this planet, and we should go down on the surface and investigate further.

entries.zh: 我们的考古学家已经开始了在[From.Planet.GetName]地表的工作。地震学勘测很快就在此前指示器指向的位置附近的地下发现了空洞区域。\n\n地下的空穴非常巨大而且神秘，尽管如此有一件事情我们的专家们可以肯定：它绝非天然形成的。它一定是被人出于一定的目的建造出来的。
entries.en: Our archaeological team have started their work down on [From.Planet.GetName]. Seismographic readings quickly isolated a hollow area underground on the rough location indicated by the alien indicators previously discovered.\n\nThe underground expanse is vast, and despite its mysterious nature one thing is beyond doubt amongst the experts: It's not natural. Someone built it with a specific purpose in mind.

entries.zh:
挖掘小队终于来到了地下结构。规模庞大，棱角分明的厅堂由隧道相连。由于几乎没看到任何装饰，要鉴别建立这个结构的目的很困难。

当[Leader.GetName]进入主室的时候，一阵低沉的声音突然回荡起来。起初这只是雷鸣般地噪声，但这声音逐渐扭变，直到变成一股空洞的人声，不断用我们的语言重复单一的句子：

§Y“你们准备好了吗？”§!

雷鸣般地人声伴随着一阵低沉的轰隆声，一座巨墙突然缓慢移开，一条黑暗的走廊显现出来。我们的考古学家迫切地想进一步深入。
entries.en:
The excavation crew has finally reached the underground structure. Vast, angular halls and tunnels were explored. A complete lack of adornment made it difficult to establish the purpose of the structure.

When [Leader.GetName] entered the main chamber a deep sound suddenly reverberated. Initially just thundering noise, the sound slowly contorted until an incorporeal voice spoke a single sentence in our language:

§Y'Are you ready?'§!

The booming voice was followed by deep rumble as one of the giant walls slowly slid away to reveal a dark corridor. Our archaeologists eagerly went inside.

entries.zh:
黑暗走廊的末端是一个空的、圆形的房室。刚一走进，那股回荡的人声再一次说话，表示§Y只有有资格之人才能继续§!。

短小的走廊从圆形房室引向了三个更小的房间——每一个房间里都包含某种物理学相关的谜题。

[Leader.GetName]相信这是一些科学谜题——只要能解开——能够引起整个结构触发特定的反应，但这全都是推测。
entries.en:
The dark corridor led to an empty, round chamber. Stepping inside, the disembodied voice spoke yet again, saying that §Yonly the deserving may continue§!.

Short corridors connected the round chamber to three other, small rooms - each containing some kind of physics-oriented problem.

[Leader.GetName] believes that these are scientific riddles that - once solved - may provoke some reaction in the structure, but it's all speculation.

entries.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]地下深处的神秘房间中的全部三个科学谜题都已被解答。

正如[Leader.GetName]先前怀疑的一样，这一结构对外星试炼的正确解答作出了反应。在最后一个谜团得到解决的同时，一个云状全息投影在主室中乍然突现。那是对我们恒星系的高分辨率描写，附有多种外星科技的滚动说明。

明亮的光点标明了星系中的另一处位置。搜索还将继续。
entries.en:
All three science puzzles have been completed in the mysterious chambers deep underground the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

Just as [Leader.GetName] suspected, the structure responded to the correct solutions for the alien trials. As the last riddle was solved, a cloudy holographic projection exploded to life in the main chamber. It was a fine-resolution depiction of our solar system, along with scrolling instructions for various alien technologies.

Another galactic position was indicated by a bright point of light. The search continues.

entries.zh: 我们的扫描仪侦测到有东西在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表深处。
entries.en: Our scanners have picked up something deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName].

entries.zh:
在一段漫长而艰难的[From.Planet.GetName]地表深挖以后，挖掘队进入了另一个底下结构中。

尽管数据表明这个结构是个洞，但是我们并没有找到可以进入的入口。它似乎被完全地封闭了，其保护墙采用了某种未知的具有难以置信的结构强度的金属——实际上我们的传统挖掘设备都没法把它划个印！

我们需要付出大量的努力来进入这里，好消息是我们将会一直努力。
entries.en:
After a long, arduous period of digging deep into the crust of [From.Planet.GetName] the excavation team reached another underground structure.

Despite readings indicating that the building is hollow, no entry point can be found. It appears to be hermetically sealed, and the protective walls are made of some unknown material with extreme structural integrity. Conventional digging equipment doesn't even scratch it!

It will require some serious effort to get through, but the project is already underway.

entries.zh:
在几个月的艰苦努力下，使用一种强大的高频高温激光，挖掘队终于撬开了这个地下建筑。

在地下室被打开后，那个无源的声音又响了起来，表达出对我们对于解决这个挑战决心的赞许，因此我们将会得到奖励。

所以就是这样。地下室埋藏着各种各样的珍宝，数不尽的财宝、某种未来可以被研究的未知科技······
entries.en:
After months of hard work, using a powerful beam which combines intense fusion heat with high-frequency vibration, the excavation team has finally managed to crack the underground structure.

As soon as the vault was cracked, the disembodied voice-recording spoke again. It declared that our determination had been proven, that another trial had been completed, and that we were to be rewarded accordingly.

And so we were. The bunker contained all sort of valuables, not least of which: hitherto unknown technologies which can be investigated further.

entries.zh: 显然，我们的神秘施恩者觉得地下结构是个很时髦的概念。
entries.en: Underground structures are apparently a popular motif amongst our mysterious Benefactors.

entries.zh:
大量的地震学读数经汇总分析形成了[From.Planet.GetName]地下结构的高度准确的视觉模型。

这似乎是一个由棱角分明的走廊连成的网络，每条走廊均达数千米长。整个结构主要由走廊构成，只有位于建筑底部的一处开放空间例外。

在我们抵达站点并对其进行适当的调查之前，无法再诠释出更多内容。
entries.en:
Extensive seismographic readings have been compiled into a highly accurate, visual model of the underground structure on [From.Planet.GetName].

It appears to be a vast network of angular corridors, each several kilometers long. The entire structure is mostly corridors, with the exception of one open space at the bottom of the building.

More than that cannot be interpreted until we reach and investigate the site properly.

entries.zh:
考古队终于在这个地下工事上打开了通道，进入了空荡荡的走廊。

走廊完全是空的。仔细检查后，能发现墙壁上刻着小且奇怪的铭文。对该外星文字的翻译结果令人困惑，后来才发现这些都是外星人的名字。为数多达百万的名字。

考古学家现在正朝着最深处的房间前进，但时不时出现的坍塌走廊段阻碍着他们的前进。
entries.en:
The science team finally breached the underground complex, and entered the empty corridors.

The long tunnels were completely empty. On closer inspection the walls appeared to be covered in small, strange inscriptions. Translation of the alien language was a highly confusing process, until it was discovered that the writing consisted of nothing but alien names, numbering in the millions.

Archaeologists are now pressing onwards to the bottom chamber, but their effort is hindered by caved-in corridors which need to be cleared.

entries.zh:
我们投放到[From.Planet.GetName]科学小队已经抵达了房间的最低处。他们在那里发现了一份古老的档案：某种个人汇报。

§Y“我们失败了，无情者撕裂了我们的整只舰队而没有丝毫拖泥带水。什么也没剩下。我们终将死在这里，死在我们纪念阵亡将士的厅堂里。

我们为那些躺在病房里的伤员而感到担心，无情者会找到他们，然后……”§!

这里没有任何打斗的迹象，没有尸体，只剩下空旷的纪念堂与死一般的寂静。
entries.en:
Our science team down on [From.Planet.GetName] has reached the bottom chamber of the memorial structure. There they found an ancient recorded message; some kind of personal debriefing:

§Y'We failed. The Relentless cut through our entire navy without even slowing down. All is lost now. We will die here, in these halls of tribute to fallen brethren.

We fear for the lives of our wards. The Relentless will find them, and then they...'§!

There's no sign of a struggle. No bodies. Only empty halls and the silence of the ones who perished.

entries.zh:
首席科学官[Leader.GetName]想要彻底的搜寻纪念堂，不放过每个角落。他是对的。在其中的一个回廊里，一个小设备被找到了。在这个设备上，我们抢救出了一段小信息碎片。

§Y“成···！它们的精神能力被关闭了，它们的聪明才智被移除了——它们不构成威胁了。

这应该够了。我们只剩下这一件事可以做。”§!

这个设备同时储存了一些新坐标。[Leader.GetName]希望尽快对这些坐标进行探查。
entries.en:
Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] wanted to comb through every nook and cranny of the memorial site. It paid off: a small device was discovered in one of the corridors. A small fragment of information could be salvaged from it:

§Y'...ould work! With their mental faculties shut off - their very intellect removed - they would pose no threat.

It must be enough. It's the only thing left that we can do.'§!

The device also included some new coordinates. [Leader.GetName] would like to investigate these as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 扫描仪从轨道上读取的数据表明下方的行星上存在一个人工构造。但与以前的不同，该构造并未埋于地下。
entries.en: Scanner readings from orbit indicate that there is a structure down on the planet. Unlike the previous ones, this one is not buried underground.

entries.zh:
这次的任务用不上铲子或钻孔激光。首席科学官[Leader.GetName]和考古团队径直走进了外星人的废墟。

这处遗址非常古老——已有一千多年的历史，但保存完好。它似乎是为某一特定目的而建造的一种集散地。能看到几个实验室，还有几个规模庞大的储藏库。

考古团队发现了一个数字档案服务器。它已停止运转，但看起来很完整。希望它能填补失落的施恩者相关线索的空白之处。
entries.en:
There was no need for shovels or drilling lasers this time around. Head Scientist [Leader.GetName] and the archaeology team simply walked into the alien ruin.

The site is very old - more than a thousand years, but fairly well kept. It appears to be some kind of staging area, built for a specific purpose. There are several laboratories and large storage hangars.

The team have found a digital archive server. It's offline, but appears fairly intact. Hopefully it will fill in the blanks regarding our lost Benefactors.

entries.zh: 考古团队成功获取了外星人数字档案，并设法使其运行。该档案里包含一些内容混乱的日志，需进行进一步解读。\n\n日志中反复出现名为§Y意识抹除方案§!的术语，它似乎是这里的研究工作的重点。施恩者显然开发了神智操纵技术，但是该技术的实现方式或开发该技术的目的仍然未知。
entries.en: The science team managed to get the alien digital archives up and running. They exclusively contained arbitrary logs, which require some liberal interpretation.\n\nThe phrase '§YMind-Wipe Initiative§!' occurs frequently throughout the logs, and it appears to have been the specific focus of research at this location. Apparently the Benefactors developed the technology by which they could manipulate the effectiveness of mental faculties, but how or for what purpose remains unknown.

entries.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上的考古团队发现了另一个古老的数字档案。该档案也包含很多流水账式的日志，但是有一条值得关注：

§Y“飞船已经起飞。我们知道他们会成功，但他们离开时没有任何希望和兴致。我们知道这个任务，以及我们在这里所做的工作，是不正当的……甚至称得上是卑劣的。

但是替代方案……替代方案更糟。”§!

这是在这个古老的设施中发现的最后一个条目之一。虽然算不上了结，但至少有了很多技术上的发现。
entries.en:
The archaeology team on [From.Planet.GetName] has found another ancient digital archive. This too consisted mostly of logs, but there was one journal entry of particular interest:

§Y'The ship has taken off. We know they'll succeed, but there was no sense of hope or high spirits as they left. We know that the mission and the work we've done here are wrong... Despicable.

But the alternative... The alternative is worse.'§!

That is one of the last entries found at the ancient facility. Not much of a closure, but at least plenty of technological discoveries were made.

entries.zh:
在清扫存储区域期间，一名工作人员发现了一个来源不明的小型设备，它被带到[Leader.GetName]面前，并被查明是一种记录设备。它已严重破损，但其中一小段对话仍可读取：

§Y“……不应被遗忘——应当有人来澄清事实，为他们发声。历史或许会容忍这一切，但我的良心不能。”§!

进一步对当初作为噪声丢弃的一串数据进行研究后。发现那原来是加密的坐标。
entries.en:
Clearing out the storage areas, one of the workers found a small device of unknown origin. It was brought to [Leader.GetName] and turned out to be a recording device. It was badly damaged, but a small snippet of dialog was saved:

§Y'...houldn't be forgotten - someone has to come clean and speak up for them. History may endure, but my conscience cannot.'§!

A string of data first discarded as noise was investigated further. It turned out to be encrypted coordinates.

entries.zh: 坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]上的某处，但进一步的扫描没有发现任何异常。
entries.en: The coordinates point to an arbitrary spot down on the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Closer scans indicate nothing out of the ordinary.

entries.zh:
被派到[From.Planet.GetName]表面的团队遇到了比预期多得多的困难。

在古老的外星人研究基地中找到的坐标指向[From.Planet.GetName]的一片异常崎岖的区域，那里到处都是悬崖和裂谷。

不过，他们依然在继续前进，最终到达了指定的地点——一个自然形成的洞穴。已无需发令让他们抵近观察，洞穴探险已经开始了。
entries.en:
The team we sent down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName] encountered far more obstacles than anticipated.

The coordinates we received in the ancient alien research base pointed to an exceptionally craggy part of [From.Planet.GetName], where the landscape was filled with vertical stone surfaces and deep fissures.

The team pressed on, and eventually reached the indicated location: a natural cave formation. No need to ask them to take a closer look; the spelunking is already afoot.

entries.zh: 考古队正在调查[From.Planet.GetName]上的自然洞穴。他们发现了一个废弃的大仓库，储存着一些有价值的原料。没有门，没有锁，也没有陷阱——单纯的一个装满了贵重工业品的洞穴。\n\n首席科学官[Leader.GetName]希望进一步调查。这些东西摆放实在过于显眼，以至于让人怀疑这是一个骗局，即这批藏品只是用来掩饰另一个尚未发现的宝藏的幌子。
entries.en: The archaeology team that was investigating the natural cave down on [From.Planet.GetName] have reported back. They found a tremendous, abandoned stockpile of valuable resources. There were no doors, no locks and no traps - just a cave full of industrial valuables.\n\nHead Scientist [Leader.GetName] would like to investigate further still. Plentiful as it may be, the obviousness of the booty has evoked a theory that the hidden cache is merely a ruse - that another type of treasure is yet to be found.

entries.zh:
资源仓库确实是一个骗局——真正的宝藏被发现于一扇隐藏的门后面：一个施恩者种族的人最后录制的信息。

很久以前，他们与凶残的外星种族§S无情者§!交战。无数的文明在无情者的猎杀中被灭亡，而施恩者们也将成为下一个。绝望的施恩者想尽一切来阻止末日到来。他们成功了：一种破坏无情者的神智的设备，瞬间将整个无情者种族变成了原始人。

无情者被剥夺了理智，变得服从无害。施恩者将他们集中捕获，放逐到我们的家乡。

无情者是我们的祖先。
entries.en:
The resource cache was indeed a deception. The real treasure lay behind a hidden door: a final message, recorded by one of the Benefactor aliens.

Eons ago they were at war with a merciless alien race known as §SThe Relentless§!. Entire civilizations had already perished in the Relentless' wake, and the Benefactors were next. The desperate Benefactors sought their last resort, before all would be lost. They succeeded with a device that ravaged The Relentless' neurological physique, instantaneously primitivizing an entire race.

Robbed of their bloodthirsty intellect, The Relentless became docile and harmless. The Benefactors rounded them up and exiled them to our home world.

The Relentless are our ancestors.

entries.zh: 这故事的高潮，真不知是何滋味。

资源仓库是一个骗局。最终我们在山洞中发现了一个隐藏的录音设备：

§Y“很久以前，我的种族——当时被称作§S无情者§!，在整个星系中掀起战乱，任何挡在我们面前的感性外星人都会被我们的舰队无情地碾碎。

最终我们脱离了作为战争贩子的生存之道。我们看着残酷的历史，不再感到骄傲，只感到羞耻和悲哀。

我们追寻祖先的赎……”§!

其余的内容乱七八糟。科学官[Leader.GetName]确信可以恢复失真内容，但这需要时间。
entries.en:
The resource cache was a deception. A hidden recording device was eventually found within the cave:

§Y'Eons ago, my species - known at the time as §SThe Relentless§! - laid waste to the galaxy. Any sentient alien that crossed our path was engaged by our fleets without hesitation or mercy.

Eventually we evolved beyond our warmonger ways. We looked at our savage history and no longer felt pride - only shame and regret.

Retracing our ancestor's ste...'§!

The rest is scrambled. Scientist [Leader.GetName] is convinced that distortion can be restored, but it will take some time.

entries.zh:
[Leader.GetName]已成功修复了外星人录音中损坏的部分：

§Y“我们追寻祖先的赎罪步伐，来到了这个星系。我们的祖先在这里灭亡了$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$种族。那时我们不知道$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$通过使[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]变成对我们无害的原始人，将[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]从我们眼皮底下掩藏起来。

这种效果是不可逆的。[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]仍然只是原始人。现在，我们希望有一天他们能够重返太空，并希望他们找到我们留下的赎罪标记。”§!

就这样，我们的历史得到了解释。现在，让我们关注未来。
entries.en:
[Leader.GetName] has successfully restored the scrambled alien recording:

'§YRetracing our ancestor's steps on a quest for redemption, we reached this system. Here our predecessors annihilated the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ race. We didn't know then that the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ had concealed another species - the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] - by using a procedure which suppressed the intellectual capacity of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], rendering them harmless to us.

This effect is irreversible. The [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] are still mere savages. Now we hope that one day they'll find their way back to the stars, and that they find our tokens of atonement.'§!

And there it is: our history explained. Now let's focus on the future.

entries.zh: 接受这一切，并迈步向前。

在一堵假石洞墙后面，考古团队发现了一系列数据片段。它们揭示了这样一个故事：

很久以前，两个主要阵营之间发生了主权的争夺战，施恩者一方陷入了僵局。为了取得优势，一方发起了一场假旗行动，冒充另一方攻击了一个弱小的种族——也就是我们的祖先。

名为“突触阻尼炸弹”的装置在我们曾经的母星上爆炸。它未对环境产生破坏，但其脉冲影响了我们祖先的大脑，使他们退化了。

留给我们的赠礼表明，施恩者最终寻求赎罪。
entries.en:
The archaeology team found a collection of data snippets behind a fake cave wall. As we scrutinized them, a theme began to emerge.

Eons ago the Benefactors were locked in stalemate as two major factions wrestled for sovereignty. In an effort to gain advantage, one side executed a false flag operation: posing as their own opposition, they attacked a lesser species - our ancestors.

A 'synaptic dampener bomb' was triggered on our home planet. It did nothing to the ecology, but the pulse affected our ancestor's brains, causing them to regress.

The tokens left behind for us indicate that the Benefactors eventually sought redemption.

entries.zh: 我们不要被利用了！睁大眼睛看清楚！
entries.en: We are not pawns! Just watch!

entries.zh:
挖掘队在一堵假墙后面发现了一个记录装置，里面是一位施恩者的自白。

很久以前，施恩者通过技术手段使我们的物种“失了智”，以躲避某种迫在眉睫的星系级威胁。尽管这可能出于好心，但威胁过去后，施恩者并未恢复我们祖先的神智，他们抛弃了我们。

在这里发现的设备和技术是一个独立团体留下的恩惠，这个团体同情我们那已陷于蒙昧的前辈。
entries.en:
Hidden behind a fake wall, the excavation team found a single recording device containing the confessions of one of the Benefactors.

Eons ago, the Benefactors 'dumbed down' our species by technological intervention, in order to hide us from some kind of impending galactic threat. Benevolent as that may have seemed, once the threat had passed the Benefactors spent no effort in trying to restore our ancestors' faculties - they simply abandoned us.

The sites and technology discovered in our home system are boons, left by an independent group which took pity on our diminished predecessors.

entries.zh: 看看我们！我们不需要施舍。
entries.en: Witness us! We don't need any charity.

entries.zh:
在假墙的后面，发掘队发现了一个录音设备，其中包含神秘的施恩者留下的消息。

他们正在与一些恶毒、令人作呕的外星人种族进行一场绝望的战争。为了使我们远离敌人的进攻，他们使用技术破坏了我们祖先的思维能力，希望敌人不要理会一个孤立的星球上的[Owner.GetPreFTLLower]物种。

这对我们是有用的，但最终施恩者们的命运却走到了尽头。他们给我们留下了这些隐藏的资源库存和技术，希望有一天我们能找到它们。
entries.en:
Secreted behind a fake wall, the excavation team found a single recording device containing a message left by the mysterious Benefactors.

They were fighting a desperate war against an unnamed, malevolent and warmongering alien race. In an effort to hide us from the enemy's advance they used technology to suppress the intellectual capacity of our ancestors, hoping that the enemy would bear no heed to the [Owner.GetPreFTLLower] species of a single, isolated planet.

It worked for us, but the fate of the Benefactors was forfeit. They left us these hidden caches of resources and technology, hoping that one day we'd find them.

entries.zh:
最终，我们真实历史中遗失的片段解释清楚了我们历史记载中的冲突之处。我们一直以为，我们文明的进步靠的是我们自己，孤独和独立。现在我们知道了，我们一直§L站在巨人的肩膀上§!。

我们无法改变过去。我们应当释然并继续前进——接受过去不是沉重的负担，而是迈向未来之路的垫脚石。

§Y是我们成为巨人的时候了。§!
entries.en:
Finally, the inconsistencies in our history have been explained, using these lost chapters from our true heritage. We had once believed that the advancement of our civilization came of our own accord - solitary and independent. Now we know that in all this time, we had been standing §Lon the shoulders of giants§!.

We cannot change the past. We reconcile and we move on - accepting our past not as a dark burden, but as a stepping stone on our path forward into the future.

§YIt is our time to become giants.§!

entries.zh: 一张古老的恒星系地图上指明了一处遗址。
entries.en: One of sites indicated by an ancient solar system map.

entries.zh: 我们一族过往的真实被揭示，这激发了我们整个物种的动力和目标感。
entries.en: The revelation of our true past sparks motivation and a sense of purpose in our entire species.

entries.zh: 我们已经发现了我们过去的施恩者的蛛丝马迹。这条线索的末路会通往什么样的结局呢？
entries.en: We've found a trail that could belong to the Benefactors of our past. What will we find at the end of this trail?

entries.zh: 在例行的星系扫描中，我们的一个传感器接收到了一条微弱且奇特的能量信号。很有可能是聚变引擎或类似设备留下的痕迹，但其特征与我们迄今为止遇到的任何东西都不匹配，而且它似乎太过古旧-信号已发出几千年了！我们的科学家中有人提出了一种理论，认为该聚变引擎的痕迹是“施恩者”留下的。\n\n我们应该尽快将我们的深空探测部门的工作重心转移到该研究项目上。
entries.en: During a routine system scan one of our sensors picked up a small - but strange - energy signature. It's quite likely trace exhaust from a fusion drive or something similar, but the signature doesn't match anything we've encountered so far, and it appears to be remarkably old - several thousands of years! One theory amongst our scientists is that the fusion drive trail might belong to the Benefactors.\n\nWe should assign our astro-science department to this research project as soon as we can.

entries.zh: 这条由聚变引擎留下的古老痕迹由于年代过于久远而难以分析。最终科学机构终于设法计算出了一条可能的航行轨迹，轨迹通向一个不过几跳之内但迄今为止无人发现的未知恒星系。\n\n目标星系确认开放，我们应该考虑派出一艘科研船来做进一步的调查。
entries.en: The old fusion drive trail turned out be quite challenging to analyze due to its considerable age. Eventually the science department managed to calculate a likely navigation vector, and establish that the trail was pointing to a hitherto unknown system not many jumps away.\n\nThe destination has been made available, and we should consider sending a science vessel there to investigate further.

entries.zh:
在传感器对[From.solar_system.GetName]进行了第一次全面扫描之后，显而易见的是很久以前在这片恒星系中发生过大规模极具破坏性的暴力冲突。

损坏的舰船碎片与残骸散布在恒星系的四处，虚空中充满着由激光武器与聚变炸弹产生的残留能量.

在这片寂静的墓地中一个单一的信号被分离了出来，它来自附近的一个小型空间站。
entries.en:
Even after the first, broad sensor reading of the [From.solar_system.GetName] system it became clear that something very violent and destructive occurred here eons ago.

Broken spaceship parts and debris are scattered throughout the system, and the local void is teeming with energy residue from weaponized lasers and fusion explosions.

In this silent graveyard a single signal has been isolated, and it's coming from a small space station nearby.

entries.zh:
被截获的信号来源于空间站上的某个紧急弹射舱。由于毁坏极为严重，这座损毁的空间站没有留下太多能告诉我们这里发生过什么的线索。我们的科学家设法将数据片段整合到一起以拼凑出事件经过。

这座空间站就是发明意识抹除科技（就是那个让我们祖先变得愚笨的科技）的科研设施。这座空间及其防御舰队被某支未知力量所控制，而这项科技也大概率被其盗取。

有一段尤为有趣的文本被翻译完毕，那是来自敌军舰队的无线电对话。

§Y“他们正试图逃跑！跟上他们，用他们自己的武器攻击他们，看看他们会怎么享受这些炮火”§!

我们检测到了一道新的聚变引擎航迹，并基于航迹确定了一条离开的航道。
entries.en:
The signal we picked up originated from an emergency pod aboard the space station. Due to severe damage, the dead station left few clues to what happened here. Our scientists have managed to piece together snippets of data, in order to form a narrative.

This station was a research facility, and is where the Mind-Wipe technology was invented - the same technology used to diminish our ancestors. The station and its protective fleet were engaged by some unknown force, after which the technology was most likely stolen.

One particularly interesting message has been translated - radio chatter from the enemy fleet:

§Y'They're trying to escape! Follow them. Use their own weapon against them. See how they like it.'§!

We've picked up a new fusion drive trail and established an exit vector based on it.

entries.zh: 在这个未经探索的星系中，施恩者的航迹消失了。我们的远程传感器没有发现任何异常，但我们应该对星系进行适当的调查，看看我们能找到什么。
entries.en: The trail of the Benefactors ends in this unexplored system. Our long range sensor doesn't pick up anything unusual, but we should survey the system properly to see what we can find.

entries.zh:
在这个恒星系中发现的[GetPreFTLLower]物种不是别的，正是§Y$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$§!——在我们的文化中，更常用的称呼是§L施恩者§!。

我们的异种学家对细节还不确定，但一切都表明，不知何故，他们成了自己的神智抹除技术的牺牲品，被留在这个星球上自生自灭。没有人比我们更清楚这种命运的含义。

我们应该仔细考虑接下来的行动。
entries.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] species found in this system is none other than the §Y$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$§! - known more commonly in our culture as the §LBenefactors§!.

Our xenologists are unsure of the details, but everything indicates that they somehow fell victim to their own mind-wiping technology, and were left on this planet to fend for themselves. No one knows the implications of this fate better than we do.

We should consider our next step carefully.

entries.zh:
有时宇宙中的事件会以最诗意的方式展开。我们祖先曾经无可争议的主人，$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$，最终与我们的祖先遭受了同样的命运。

无论他们的本意如何，我们都必须承认，他们在某种程度上试图挽回他们绝望和过激的行为。

世世代代过去了，双方地位颠倒了过来，我们还了他们的恩惠。

就像[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]物种曾经经历过的那样，现在是时候让$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$体验站在巨人肩膀上的感受了。
entries.en:
Sometimes the events of the universe unfold in a most poetic fashion. Once the undisputable masters of our ancestors, the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ species eventually found themselves struck by the same fate as our ancestors.

Whatever their intention might have been, we must acknowledge the fact that to some degree, they tried to redeem their desperate and excessive act.

Now that eons have passed, the sides have been reversed, and we have returned their favor.

Just as the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species once did, now it's time for the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ to experience what it means to stand on the shoulders of giants.

entries.zh: 古代聚变推进器航迹有待进一步研究。有可能从这里分析出留下这样的能量排放痕迹的船只的目的地。
entries.en: The ancient fusion drive trail should be studied further. It may be possible to isolate the destination of whatever vessel left this energy exhaust.

entries.zh: 尽管存在明显的损坏，但这个神秘的空间站仍可能包含古代信息或数据碎片，我们或许能将这些信息或数据碎片拼接在一起，对千百年前这里发生的事情做一个连贯的解释。
entries.en: Despite the obvious devastation, the enigmatic space station may contain old messages or data fragments that can be puzzled together into a coherent explanation for what happened here, eons ago.

entries.zh: 我们发现了曾经造就我们祖先的物种的后代……原始人。这些人现在已陷入蒙昧。看来，宇宙中并不缺乏滑稽剧。但不管好坏，他们确实帮助过我们。我们应想办法做些什么来报答这份恩惠。
entries.en: We have found the descendants of the species that once rendered our ancestors... lesser. These descendants are now the diminished ones. The universe, it seems, is not without a sense of irony. But for better or worse, they did help us. We should investigate what we can do to repay the favor.

entries.zh: 一道年代久远的能量追迹，由星际聚变引擎产生。
entries.en: An old energy trail left by an interstellar fusion drive.

entries.zh: 一道年代久远的能量追迹，由星际聚变引擎产生。
entries.en: An old energy trail left by an interstellar fusion drive.

entries.zh: 这里就是在我们母星系发现的聚变引擎航迹所指向的目的地。
entries.en: This is the destination indicated by the fusion drive trail found in our home system.

entries.zh: 这个恒星系似乎就是某艘舰船离开先前我们所发现的废弃空间站后所前往的目的地。
entries.en: This system seems to be the destination for whatever vessel left the dead space station, which we encountered earlier.

entries.zh: 我们应该派出科研船仔细地调查这个恒星系以找到施恩者的痕迹。
entries.en: This system should be properly surveyed by a Science Ship in order to find traces of the Benefactors.

entries.zh: 数以百万计的残骸和碎片，很久以前这里曾发生过一场惨烈的太空战。
entries.en: Millions of pieces and parts scattered in some violent space battle eons ago.

entries.zh: 数以百万计的残骸和碎片，很久以前这里曾发生过一场惨烈的太空战。
entries.en: Millions of pieces and parts scattered in some violent space battle eons ago.

entries.zh: 外表严重损坏，但内核几乎没有破损的空间站，用于某种研发目的。
entries.en: Severely damaged, but generally intact space station used for some kind of research and development.

entries.zh: 外表严重损坏，但内核几乎没有破损的空间站，用于某种研发目的。
entries.en: Severely damaged, but generally intact space station used for some kind of research and development.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国将永远铭记此刻因为回馈了我们的施恩者而带来的使命感和团结感。
entries.en: Our empire may forever enjoy the sense of purpose and closure we acquired by helping the Benefactors of our past.

entries.zh: 我们找了个合适的位置为未来某天重返星空的特瓦'菲亚埋下了这些储备。一份前往未来的礼物，送给过去的巨人。
entries.en: We have found a good location to bury the cache intended for the Thwaa'Phyr as they one day take to the stars anew. A gift in the future, to giants of the past.

entries.zh: 所有的人力物力都被集中到了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面。下一步就是将其埋入足够深的地下，使得它能够经受得住时间和气候的考验。
entries.en: All the materiel and manpower has been sent down to the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. Next step is to bury it deep enough that it will stand the tests of both time and weather.

entries.zh: 我们在[From.Planet.GetName]的地表之下深埋了大量的资源和科技蓝图。我们也设下了一个信标，希望假以时日$NAME_ThwaaPhyr$能够发现它。
entries.en: A generous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried deep beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. A beacon was placed as well, and in time we can only hope that the $NAME_ThwaaPhyr$ will find it.

entries.zh: 希望他们能够找到自己的生存之道。
我们或许可以追踪到那场远古灾厄的元凶——无情者。不过时间过了这么久，我们真的能推算出具体位置吗？
entries.en: We may be able to track the legendary scourge of the past - the Relentless. Will there be a reckoning, long since overdue?

entries.zh:
我们的传感器在母星系捕捉到了一股奇怪的能量信号。这股信号十分强大，一开始人们还以为是仪器出了问题，但进一步的检查表明这个读数是由一个聚变推进器在久远之前造成的能量轨迹。

为了了解更多情况我们需要更深层次的分析，但是有可能这道追迹是无情者千年之前离开我们星系的时候留下的。

我们应该进一步调查。
entries.en:
One of our sensors recently picked up a strange energy signature in our home system. It was almost dismissed as a glitch at first; upon closer inspection the reading turned out to be an ancient energy trail from a fusion-based propulsion drive.

Deeper analysis is needed to know more, but it is possible that this trail was left by the Relentless when they left our system thousands of years ago.

We should investigate this further.

entries.zh: 尽管年代久远，我们的科学部门还是设法分析了引擎追迹，并得到了它的退出矢量。这意味着我们可以追踪那个我们在上古年代遇到的那个恶魔了。\n\n时间能否完全抹平他们狂躁的天性，抑或是我们发现了一个新的威胁？新的航线已经绘制完毕，只要我们愿意，随时可以开始追踪。
entries.en: Despite its remarkable age, our science department have managed to analyze the drive trail sufficient to ascertain its exit vector. This effectively means that we can pursue the demons of our past.\n\nHas enough time passed to quell their violent nature completely, or are we to discover a new threat? A new route has been plotted, and we can pursue it whenever we want.

entries.zh:
一进入恒星系，我们的探测器就发现了许多异常现象。

最明显的信号是一个硕大无比的能量云，靠近一看则会发现它是有数百条与之前所发现相类似的更小的聚变推进航迹组成的。必然有一支很庞大的舰队处于某种原因在此处逗留过。

在这个“舰队停泊处”边上，我们的探测器发现了另一种信号。那是一艘被遗弃的运输船。这艘飞船应该与边上的能量信号一样古老，不过它所带的航迹信号与航迹团并不相同。

我们应该靠近一些观察这艘废弃的舰船。
entries.en:
On entering the system, our sensors immediately picked up multiple anomalies.

The most prominent reading was a gigantic energy cloud which - upon closer inspection - turned out to be hundreds of smaller fusion drive trails like the one previously discovered. An absolutely massive fleet must've come to a halt here for some reason.

Next to this 'fleet parking lot' our scans picked up another kind of reading: a derelict transport ship. This freighter appears to be as old as the energy signatures, but traces of its own signature differs from that of the lost fleet.

We should inspect the abandoned ship closer.

entries.zh:
这艘运输船里有一份日志。虽然因时间流逝而老化，但仍可以恢复出不少数据。

这艘运输船被那支巨大的舰队拦截。由于尚不明确的原因及方式，这艘运输船的船长最终与无情舰队的指挥官进行了谈话。他们的谈话似乎持续了数周，虽然不知道他们具体谈了什么，但是“力量的本质”这个说法被反复地提到。

那支舰队突然离去，而留下的那艘运输船则安然无恙。日志的最后一行援引自指挥官：§Y“算了，放了他们吧。毁灭是很容易的事情，真正的力量是创造的能力。”§!

我们已经分析了舰队的航迹，并可以重新起程追赶我们的目标。
entries.en:
The freighter contained a log. Though damaged by time, some data could still be recovered.

The freighter had been intercepted by the massive fleet. Unclear as to how or why, the Captain of the freighter ended up conversing with the Commander of the Relentless fleet. Apparently they spoke for weeks, but what they spoke of remains unknown - although the phrase 'nature of power' recurs frequently.

The fleet suddenly departed, leaving the freighter unscathed. The last entry in the log was a quote from the Commander: §Y'No, leave them. Destruction is easy. Real power is the ability to create.'§!

We have analyzed the fleet trails and may take up our pursuit again.

entries.zh:
这里就是聚变引擎航迹的终点。如果有任何可能存在的无情舰队的遗留物应该能在这里找到。

目前为止探测器所发现的信号中唯一一个值得关注的似乎是源自某种小型的太空站。它以一定的间隔向外辐射着能量脉冲，然而除此之外它似乎没有任何其他的活动迹象。

我们可以立刻对其展开调查。
entries.en:
This is where the fusion drive trail ends. It's quite likely that any remnants of the Relentless species - if there are any - will be found here.

So far the only sensor reading of any particular interest comes from what appears to be some kind of small space station. An energy pulse radiates from it at set intervals, but apart from that there's no sign of any activity.

We can proceed to investigate immediately.

entries.zh: 通过分析聚变引擎航迹，我们的研究部门可以确定我们的老客人究竟去了哪里，另一方面而言也就意味着我们可以开始追踪了。
entries.en: By analyzing the fusion drive trail our science department may figure out where our old visitors went, which in turn means that we can initiate a pursuit.

entries.zh: 一艘废弃的货用太空船静静地停在冰冷的太空中。它年代很久，但看上去没有损伤。我们应该派遣一支登陆队进行进一步调查。
entries.en: A derelict freighter ship is waiting in the cold of space. It is very old, but seemingly undamaged. We should send a boarding party to investigate closer.

entries.zh: 这个古老结构在有规律地放出能量震荡，期待着有人发现它。为了找出原因，我们必须允许我们的科学家在更近的距离调查。
entries.en: Based on the frequent energy pulse emanating from it, this old space structure wants to be found. In order to figure out why we must allow our scientist to take a closer look.

entries.zh: 根据位于我们母星系的聚变引擎追迹的分析，此处便是古代无情者所在的最终目的地。
entries.en: According to the analysis of the fusion drive trail in our home system, this is the destination of Relentless visitors of old.

entries.zh: 在远古的年代，无情者庞大的舰队在遇到一艘民用货船之后离开了这个恒星系。
entries.en: The destination of the massive Relentless fleet which left this system many eons ago, after a strange run-in with a civilian freighter.

entries.zh:
科学家们对古旧空间站的调查已经结束。这整个结构是个某种类型的大炮。很久以前，这门大炮开火了，向无情者的母星发射了一股脉冲。那股脉冲我们——[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]一族——十分清楚作用是什么：§Y心智抹除脉冲§!。

为了补偿他们曾经犯下的罪愆，无情者——现在名为§Y$NAME_Vemetosha$§!——对自己使用了这门武器，让他们的整个文明在心智上退回到了土著时代。

这一决定的规模——还有造成的后果——清楚地说明了无情者对于赎罪是多么的严肃。我们能够原谅他们吗？
entries.en:
The scientists have finished their investigation of the old space station. The entire structure is a big cannon of sorts. Eons ago it triggered and fired a pulse at the Relentless homeworld - a pulse that we, the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName], know full well: a §YMind-Wipe pulse§!.

In a quest to redeem themselves from their past sins, the Relentless - now known as the §Y$NAME_Vemetosha$§! - used the weapon on themselves, effectively diminishing their entire civilization.

The magnitude of such a decision - and the follow-through - stands as testament to how very seriously the Relentless wanted to atone. Can we forgive them?

entries.zh: 考古部门将这里作为一个完美的地址，用于埋藏资料，以供给将来“迈入太空时代”的无情者后裔。
entries.en: This spot has been chosen by the archaeology department as a perfect site to bury assets for the Relentless descendants when they 'come of space age'.

entries.zh: 将资源和工业装备运送到[From.Planet.GetName]的庞大任务已经结束。接下来就是向地底深处挖掘，建造一个坚固的，能够经历上千年地址变动和岁月风霜侵蚀的构造。
entries.en: The massive undertaking to transport resources and industrial equipment to [From.Planet.GetName] has been completed. Next step is to dig deep into the ground and build a structure strong enough to withstand eons of crude weather and tectonic shifts.

entries.zh: 一个装着资源和科技蓝图的巨大宝箱被埋藏在了[From.Planet.GetName]的表面之下。我们不清楚$NAME_Vemetosha$的子孙们能不能、会在什么时候以及如何发现我们的宝藏，不过我们可以寄与最大的希望。谁知道呢？或许千年之后他们会发现我们太空船的推进航迹，并找到我们。
entries.en: A tremendous cache of resources and technology blueprints has been buried beneath the surface of [From.Planet.GetName]. We have no idea if, when or how our treasure will be discovered by the $NAME_Vemetosha$ descendants, but we can hope for the best. Who knows? Maybe in a thousand years they will find our space ship propulsion trails and come visit us.

entries.zh: 宇宙历史中黑暗的一章已经翻过，崭新而光明的篇章则由我们来谱写完成。我们的德政工程仿佛在我们的社会中投下了一颗石子，每一个人的心中都激起了使命感和道德感的涟漪。尽管漆黑的深空仍然深不可测，但也许这个宇宙并非完全是那么地漆黑冰冷。
entries.en: A dark chapter of in the history of the universe has ended, and we have written a new one - a brighter chapter. Our benevolent project initiated a ripple effect in our society, each member feeling a sense of purpose and good intent. Maybe space isn't such a dark place after all - the unfathomably vast darkness of the void notwithstanding.

entries.zh: 我们的帝国正享有帮助并原谅旧敌的积极影响。
entries.en: Our empire is enjoying positive effects from helping and forgiving an enemy of the past.

entries.zh: 一艘静默但似乎完好无损的外星货物运输船。
entries.en: A silent, but seemingly intact alien cargo freighter.

entries.zh: 一艘废弃的外星货物运输船。
该废弃空间站正发射出一道能量脉冲。
entries.en: An energy pulse is emanating from this abandoned space station.

entries.zh: 功能未知的外星空间站。
entries.en: Alien space station of unknown function.
$FEDERATION|Y$ does NOT have the setting $SETTING|Y$ activated

entries.zh:
威震寰宇的主宰已经建成。

这艘行动自如的庞然巨舰将彻底改变进攻作战的范式。它可以在前线建造和维修舰船，并配有足以摧枯拉朽的火力，使我们得以不间断地攻击那些敢与我们作对的人。

如今只有蠢货才会对抗[Owner.GetName]。
entries.en:
The construction of the impressive Juggernaut has been completed.

This mobile behemoth changes the paradigm of offensive warfare entirely. It can construct and repair ships on the frontline, and is equipped with devastating firepower, allowing for a ceaseless assault of those who dare stand against us.

Only fools will oppose [Owner.GetName] now.

entries.zh: 经确认，§H[From.Owner.GetName]§!已经完成了巨型主宰舰的建造。这一行动自如的太空基地装配了海量火力，并能在作战前线建造和维护舰船，使其在任何作战场景下都是更严峻的威胁。\n\n这真的是太空战里的尖端军备。
entries.en: It has been verified that §H[From.Owner.GetName]§! has finished the construction of a massive Juggernaut ship. This mobile space base packs extensive firepower and is able to build and maintain ships at the frontline of battle, making it a superior threat in any combat scenario.\n\nIt is truly the apex armament of space war.

entries.zh: 有点改变战争规则的意思了。
entries.en: Bit of a game changer, that one.

entries.zh: 随着越来越多的太空文明彼此间建立了正式的关系，星系之中愈发生机盎然。为了避免国家间出现悲剧性的误解，越来越多的外交人士呼吁设立一个新的泛星系组织——如果愿意的话也可以称为共同体，在那里星系中的各帝国可以召开会议，共商星系大事。\n\n[Root.GetName]应该承诺支持§H星海共同体§!的创立吗？
entries.en: As more and more spacefaring civilizations establish formal relations with one another, the galaxy is becoming a vibrant and lively place. To avoid tragic misunderstandings between nations, an increasing number of diplomats have called for the establishment of a new pan-galactic organization - a community, if you will, where the empires of the galaxy can meet to discuss important matters.\n\nShould the [Root.GetName] pledge its support for the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!?

entries.zh: 让我们再试一次。我们应该组建星海共同体吗？
entries.en: Let's try again. Should we form a Galactic Community?

entries.zh: 是的，值得进行这样的尝试。
entries.en: Yes, this is a worthy endeavor.

entries.zh: 不，我们没时间做这种毫无意义的事情。
entries.en: No, we have no time for this nonsense.
The Birth of the Galactic Community

entries.zh: 这是历史性的一天。星系中数个重要的太空帝国，包括[Root.GetName]，宣布了§H星海共同体§!的创立。这一国家间组织会作为一个论坛，整个星系的事务都可以在此讨论和决定。\n\n作为其创始成员国之一，我们可以为星系历史的这一里程碑感到骄傲。
entries.en: This is a historic day. Several of the galaxy's prominent spacefaring empires, including the [Root.GetName], have announced the creation of the §HGalactic Community§!. This supranational organization will serve as a forum where matters involving the entire galaxy can be discussed and decided upon.\n\nAs one of its founding members, we can take pride in this milestone of galactic history.
A great day for the galaxy!

entries.zh: 尽管我们决定不为建立某种国家间星系机构提供帮助，若干其他帝国已经联合创立了这种东西。在他们“历史性的”联合声明中，他们向全星系宣布了§H星海共同体§!的创立。这一组织的目的是作为一个论坛，会影响星系整体的重要事务可以在那里讨论。\n\n由于我们拒绝参与这一星海共同体的创立，[Root.GetName]将不被算作成员国。
entries.en: Despite our decision not to lend our support behind the founding of some sort of supranational galactic institution, several other empires have banded together to create just such a thing. In their "historic" joint announcement, they declared the creation of the §HGalactic Community§! to the galaxy. This organization is to serve as a forum where important matters that affect the galaxy as a whole can be discussed.\n\nAs we refused to take part in the creation of this Galactic Community, the [Root.GetName] is not yet considered a member.

entries.zh: 组建一个超国家的“§H星海共同体§!”的提议已经失败。并没有足够的帝国承诺会支持这种机构的创立。
entries.en: The initiative to form a supranational "§HGalactic Community§!" has failed. Not enough empires pledged their support to the creation of such an institution.
The other fools were not ready.

entries.zh: 数个太空帝国，其中一些我们尚不清楚，已经联合组建了一个“§H星海共同体§!”。这一国家间机构的目的是作为一个论坛，在那里可以共商重要事务。\n\n虽然我们并不曾参与其建立，那些成员国已经向[Root.GetName]发出了邀请，请求我们成为正式的成员国。我们应该接受邀请吗？
entries.en: Several spacefaring empires, some of them unknown to us, have banded together to form a "§HGalactic Community§!." This supranational institution is to serve as a forum where important matters can be discussed.\n\nAlthough we were not involved in its founding, the other members have extended an invitation to the [Root.GetName] for formal membership. Should we accept?

entries.zh: 好的，让我们加入这一组织。
entries.en: Yes, let us join this community.

entries.zh: 不，我们不会参与这种事。
entries.en: No, we will take no part in this.

entries.zh: 我们不关心什么“共同体”
entries.en: We do not care for this "Community."

entries.zh: 不久后他们也将臣服于我们的大可汗。
entries.en: Soon they too will bow to our great Khan.

entries.zh: 星海共同体的各个成员国已经投票决定设立星系理事会。这一受人尊敬的实体只允许社群中三个实力最强、最具影响力的帝国成为其成员。到下一轮议会被选出为止，这三个国家将是§H[council_member_1.GetName]§!，§H[council_member_2.GetName]§!和§H[council_member_3.GetName]§!。\n\n共同体期望理事会成员国可以领导和保卫整个星海共同体。他们获得了提权，可以跳过那些时常在大型政治机构中阻碍决策流程的繁文缛节。
entries.en: The members of the Galactic Community have voted to establish a Galactic Council. Membership in this august body will be limited to representatives from the three most powerful and influential empires in the Community. Until a new Council is elected, these are the §H[council_member_1.GetName]§!, the §H[council_member_2.GetName]§!, and the §H[council_member_3.GetName]§!.\n\nThe members of the Council are expected to lead and safeguard the Galactic Community. Their increased powers allow them to cut through some of the red tape that so often inhibits the decision-making process in large political institutions.

entries.zh: 希望他们有能力完成任务……
entries.en: Hopefully they are up to the task...

entries.zh: 现在我们终于可以大有作为了！
entries.en: Now we can finally get things done!

entries.zh: 啊，看来那些幕后操纵者总算露出了真容！
entries.en: Ah, so the puppeteers finally reveal themselves!

entries.zh: [galactic_market_station_system.GetName]泛星系贸易市场总部被拆除

根据[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]宪章第19条C款，只有一个会员国可以主办泛星系贸易市场。$galcom.62.base$[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的贸易董事会已提出陈词对该事态表示遗憾。他们允诺，在[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]内新主办国的选举将会很快开始。
entries.en: According to article 19C of the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s charter, only a member state may host the Galactic Market. $galcom.62.base$ The [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce has issued a statement expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that nominations for a new host within the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium] will commence immediately.

entries.zh: 因此，市场在[galactic_market_station_system.GetName]星系的总部已经被拆除。最后一位交易员在今天不情愿地放弃了他们的岗位，哀叹这一戏剧性的——在他们看来——不必要的步骤对星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。
entries.en: As such, the market's headquarters in the [galactic_market_station_system.GetName] system has been dismantled. The last traders reluctantly abandoned their posts today, bemoaning the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has caused.
It is a price worth paying.

entries.zh: 挑选泛星系贸易市场新总部
entries.en: New Headquarters for Galactic Market Sought

entries.zh: 随着[From.GetName]选择离开[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]，我们不得不执行[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]宪章中的一项晦涩难懂的条款，其大意是只有成员国才能主导泛星系贸易市场。$galcom.62.base$对新总部的选址提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商务董事会发布生命对当前形势表示遗憾。他们保障将尽快找到新的主办国。
entries.en: With the [From.GetName] opting to leave the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium], an obscure article of the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s charter must be applied, to the effect that only a member state may host the Galactic Market. $galcom.62.base$ Nominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce expressing regret for this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

entries.zh: 也许这对我们而言是一次机会……
entries.en: Perhaps this represents an opportunity for us...

entries.zh: 那我们只能嘲笑他们的愚蠢了。
entries.en: We can only laugh at their foolishness.

entries.zh: [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]已经表态，迁移泛星系贸易市场的新一轮竞争由此展开。位于[market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系的的市场总部已经开始收尾工作，交易员的关注都集中在未来几年的预测上。他们哀叹这一戏剧性的——且在他们看来并不必要的决定对泛星系贸易造成了巨大的破坏。\n\n总部新址的提名已经开始，[global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]的商业委员会发表了一份声明，对这种状况表示遗憾。他们承诺将尽快找到一个新的星系。
entries.en: The [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] has spoken, and a new competition has begun to relocate the Galactic Market. The market's headquarters in the [market_founder_planet.solar_system.GetName] system has begun wind-down operations, with traders focusing solely on forecasts for the next few years. They bemoan the massive disruption to galactic trade that this dramatic and - in their view - needless step has already caused.\n\nNominations for the headquarters' new location have already opened, with the [global_event_country.GetCommunityOrImperium]'s Board of Commerce issuing a statement expressing regret at this state of affairs. They promise that a new host will be found swiftly.

entries.zh: 泛星系贸易市场留在原址
我们迁移泛星系贸易市场的动议不幸失败。尽管我们的努力争取到了大量口头支持，却没有转化为新地点的足够提名。\n\n这一意见原则上仍然合理：[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]今后还是可以再次提出迁移市场。然而就目前而言，这个商业机构仍然由获利丰厚的[market_founder.GetName]进行管理。
entries.en: Our motion to relocate the Galactic Market has unfortunately failed. While we mustered significant vocal support for the endeavor, this did not translate into enough valid nominations for a new host site.\n\nThe idea remains sound in principle: the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium] may propose moving the Market again in future, if it so desires. For now though, this commercial institution remains in the lucrative care of the [market_founder.GetName].

entries.zh: 泛星系商业最近经历了一次短暂而混乱的复苏，有消息称迁移泛星系市场的努力已经失败。尽管[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]声明希望迁移这一机构，但他们没有收到任何替代东道主的可靠提名。因此，[market_founder.GetName]将继续担任其东道主，直到政治变革的风向再次转向，通过投票寻找到替代。
entries.en: Galactic commerce experienced a brief and confusing resurgence recently, with news that the effort to relocate the Galactic Market has failed. Despite the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s stated desire to move this institution, they received no valid nominations for a replacement host. As a result, the [market_founder.GetName] shall remain its hosts until the winds of political change swing back to polling for a replacement.

entries.zh: 泛星系的政治意愿显然与其市场的意愿不一致。在引起了广泛的金融混乱之后，[global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]想要取消我们作为其专属交易中心东道主的努力已经失败，因为没有其他帝国给出有效的东道主提名。\n\n这项动议的支持者们不为所动，断言泛星系市场随时可能根据商业需要进行迁移到别处。不过就目前而言，在经历了这么多忙乱之后，泛星系最重要的商人们还是更愿意相信我们。
entries.en: The galaxy's political will is clearly not aligned with that of its markets. After having caused widespread financial upset, the [global_event_country.GetGalCommunityOrGalImperium]'s effort to remove us as hosts to its dedicated trading hub has failed, with no other empires putting forward a valid nomination for a host site.\n\nProponents of this motion are unfazed, affirming that the Galactic Market may yet move wherever and whenever commercial needs dictate. For now though, it would seem that after all that fuss, the galaxy's foremost merchants prefer to keep their trust in us.

entries.zh: 这一文明的诞生远早于星系中的当代列强。亿万年的停滞使他们的帝国逐步沦为昔日辉煌的些微阴影。
entries.en: This civilization greatly predates the current generation of galactic powers. Eons of stagnation gradually reduced their empire to a mere shadow of what it once was.

entries.zh: 这一文明的自然发展因另一方的介入而极大加速，这帮助其成了一个星际国家。
entries.en: The natural development of this civilization was greatly accelerated by the interference of another party, who helped them become a spacefaring culture.

entries.zh: 该文明还未能进行太空航行，然而只需稍加鼓励或是等待足够长的时间，他们可能就会登上星系舞台了。
entries.en: This civilization has yet to become spacefaring, however with a little encouragement or a great deal of time they may yet become an actor on the galactic stage.

entries.zh: 这一文明自有记录以来便以太空为家——其对典型行星环境下的生活深恶痛绝。他们生活在几个轨道居住站上，直至近期才联合一统。
entries.en: This civilization has made its home in space for as long as it has maintained records - life in a typical planetary environment is anathema to them. They live in several orbital habitats that were only recently united.

entries.en: §LThis species thrives in orbital habitats, with an inherent ability to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. They are at ease in zero gravity but do not respond well to a planetary environment.§!

起初，这个机器文明的创造者是将它们设计用于外太空旅行的、完全按照在零重力环境下流畅工作进行的优化。在经历数个纪元的孤立之后，这些机器最近重新在散布于它们母星系的数个轨道居住站之间团结了起来。
entries.en: At first, the creators of this machine civilization designed them for eternal space travel, fully optimizing them to function seamlessly in zero gravity environments. After enduring eons of isolation, these machines have recently restored unity among the orbital habitats scattered throughout their home system.

entries.en: §LThese machines thrive in orbital habitats, programmed with algorithms to efficiently navigate their maze-like corridors and complicated architecture. However, their optimized construction is poorly suited to a planetary environment.§!

entries.zh: 居住站区划产生的住房
居住站区划产生的岗位
这台古代机器深藏于居住站之内，嵌入主反应堆内部并从中汲取能量。这是此居住站原本的建造者留下的遗珍，其物质复制技术对我们而言完全无法理解。
entries.en: This ancient machine is nestled deep within the habitat's interior, built into its main reactor from where it also draws its power. A relic of whomever originally built this habitat, its matter replication technology is utterly incomprehensible to us.

entries.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空是一种需要专门征服或攻克的不利环境。而对我们而言，这就是家园。

千百年来，我们的物种栖息在数座独立围绕我们三星系统内恒星的空间站之上。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站不得而知。

一些人猜测与我们一同围绕着恒星的破碎行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相仍然扑朔迷离。

自我们发明，又或者叫发现，可以跨越空间站之间虚空的太空航行能力才过去了几个世纪。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。随着第一台装有[GetStartingDrivePlural]的舰船竣工，我们的这些居住站就团结在了同一面旗帜之下。
entries.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting the suns in our trinary system. Whether our predecessors or someone else built them, we do not know.

Some speculate that the shattered planetary remnants orbiting the stars alongside us are remnants of our creators' homeworld, but the truth remains elusive.

Only a few centuries have passed since the invention, or rediscovery, of spaceflight capable of bridging the gap between our stations. Suspicion and mistrust gradually yielded to trade and cooperation. With the construction of our first[GetStartingDrivePlural]-capable ship, the habitats had united under one flag.

entries.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们的物种分别栖息在围绕我们恒星的数座空间站之上。究竟是我们的先行者还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的身体结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，有记录的历史却完全没有提到这一点。有些人推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

只在几个世纪前，我们才发明了足以在我们空间站之间往来的太空旅行方式——又或者叫再发明，取决于你问的人是谁。怀疑和猜忌逐渐让位于贸易和相互合作。在我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]发明之时，这些居住站已经团结在了同一面旗帜之下。
entries.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, our kind has resided on several separate space stations orbiting our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our physical features indicate we originated on a planet, but recorded history makes no mention of it. Some speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet found beneath one of our stations is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

It has only been a few centuries since spaceflight allowing travel between our stations was invented - or rediscovered, depending on who you ask. Suspicion and mistrust gradually gave way to trade and mutual cooperation. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], the habitats had united under one flag.

entries.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，意识统一的我们栖息在数座空间站之上，每座都各自环绕着三星系统中的一颗恒星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了这些空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的其中一座空间站之下找到的破碎的行星遗迹就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这些分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。
entries.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we resided on several space stations with a single mind, in orbit of the suns in our trinary system. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the shattered planetary remnants in orbit with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

After rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

entries.zh:
对于大多数生物，太空中的真空环境不适于生存，需要专门征服或攻克。而对我们而言，虚空就是家园。

千百年来，我们统一的意识被分割在数座空间站之中，每个都各自环绕着一颗不同的行星。究竟是我们的祖先还是什么其他人建造了空间站，我们不得而知。

尽管我们的生物学结构暗示我们物种起源于一颗行星，但共有记忆却没能提供任何答案。我们推测，从我们的一个空间站之下找到的剧毒废土行星就是我们物种失落的家园，但真相或许永远不得而知。

在重新发现了太空航行技术之后，这几个分离的蜂巢终于可以重新交融。到我们第一台[GetStartingDrive]完成时，终于得以融为一体。
entries.en:
To most, the vacuum of space is a hostile environment to be conquered or overcome. To us, it is home.

For thousands of years, we existed as a single mind, separated by several space stations in orbit of our star. Whether they were built by our predecessors or someone else, we do not know.

Our biology indicates our species originated on a planet, but collective memory provides no answers. We speculate that the toxic wasteland of a planet in orbit along with us is the lost homeworld of our species, but the truth may never be known.

After rediscovering space flight, the separate hives were free to intermingle. By the time of our first [GetStartingDrive], we were fully integrated.

To us, it is home.\n\nFor thousands of years, we have resided on several space stations in orbit of our trinary star system. We have yet to solve if we built them or if we are the abandoned machines of their original builders.$START_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_MACHINE_END$

We have yet to solve if we built them or if we are the abandoned machines of their original builders.$START_SCREEN_VOID_DWELLERS_MACHINE_END$

entries.zh:
我们的物质组成表明我们的设计起源于一颗行星上，但我们的数据库中没有任何答案。只能假定在空我们空间站下方的破碎行星体就是我们文明失落的家乡。

无论我们的虚空文明存在有何意义，[GetStartingDrive]的发明都让一切起了变化。我们现在已经做好了准备征服虚空本身。
entries.en:
Our material makeup indicates that our model originated on a planet, but our data banks provide no answers. We can only speculate that the shattered planet body that our station orbits is our civilization's lost homeworld.

Whatever the reason for our voidbound existence, the invention of the [GetStartingDrive] changes everything. We are now ready to conquer the void itself.

entries.zh: 非人工星球人口资源产出
人工星球人口资源产出
建造开采站的£unity£凝聚力花费
建造研究站的£unity£凝聚力花费

在我们历史的早期，在技术尚未有多少发展之时，我们的外星善主向我们告知了他们的存在。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。\n\n曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途，他们改正了我们前进的方向——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的科学家掌握了电力、原子能，然后是初步太空航行。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们如今造出了我们的第一台[GetStartingDrive]。
entries.en: Early in our history, before we had developed much technology, our alien benefactors made themselves known to us. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.\n\nOn those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our scientists had mastered electricity, atomic power, and then crude spaceflight. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

entries.zh: 远在我们学会解读星辰之前，我们的外星善主便找到了我们——一个年轻而流浪的族群，勇气有余而知识不足，乘着方舟在黑暗中漂泊。他们以我们那不知所措的先祖们能理解的方式解释给我们听，说我们物种的未来不可限量。依靠极大的耐心，他们引领我们走上正途，帮助我们文明发挥出自身的全部潜力。\n\n曾有少数几次，我们偏离了这条正途——如同监护人一般坚决——很快，我们的工程师便学会了从方舟中获取到远比先祖所能想象的更多的能量。在我们监督者的谆谆教诲下，我们现在已经建造了第一台 [GetStartingDrive]。
entries.en: Long before we had learned to read the stars, our alien benefactors found us - a young, wandering people with more courage than knowledge, drifting through the dark aboard our arkship. In terms our bewildered ancestors could understand, they explained that our species showed great promise. With much patience, they guided us onto a path that would help our civilization reach its full potential.\n\nOn those few occasions when we strayed from this path, they corrected our course - firmly, as a caregiver would - but in short order, our engineers had learned to coax far more from our vessel than our ancestors had ever thought possible. Under the tutelage of our overseers, we have now constructed our first [GetStartingDrive].

entries.zh: 一个失落帝国在数千年间干预了这一文明的发展进程，引领他们走上了失落帝国所选择的道路。
entries.en: A Fallen Empire has meddled in the development of this civilization for thousands of years, guiding them onto a path of their choosing.

entries.zh: 你们好，忠诚的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们做的很不错。在我们的引领下，你们已经掌握了超空间旅行的科技，第一次准备好要探索群星……正如我们曾经所做的一般，那是无数纪元以前了。\n\n不要害怕——如果我们不觉得你们已经准备好了，我们是不会任已经发生的事件带领你们一路走到这里的。现在就出发，成为我们的骄傲吧。
entries.en: Hello, faithful [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. You have done well for yourselves. With our guidance, you have mastered the technology of hyperspace travel and are now ready to set off into the stars for the first time... much as we once did, countless eons ago.\n\nHave no fear - if we did not think you ready, we would not have allowed events to carry you as far as they have. Go now, and make us proud.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。实验的第一阶段成功完成——我们已经指引你们发展出了你们文明的第一台[GetStartingDrivePlural]，现在你们已经准备好了探索群星。

放心吧，要知道第二阶段已经开始，我们会继续监督你们的进展。迄今为止，你们已经证明了自己格外机敏。和其他生物完全不同。

观察你们能用这一机会做到什么将会很有意思。
entries.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The first phase of the experiment has successfully concluded - we have guided you towards the development of your civilization's first [GetStartingDrivePlural], and you are now ready to take to the stars.

Rest assured in the knowledge that we will continue to monitor your progress now that the second phase has begun. Thus far, you have proven remarkably adroit. Not at all like the others.

It will be interesting to see what you make of this opportunity.

entries.zh:
发动战争，以强迫敌人成为我们失落帝国宗主的附庸。



若是通过“维持现状”结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放为我们宗主国的新附庸。
entries.en:
War is waged to vassalize the enemy under our Fallen Empire overlord.



In the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new Vassal of our overlord if they include at least one planet.

entries.zh:
发动战争，以强迫敌人成为我们霸权联邦的一员。



若是通过“维持现状”结束战争的话，我们所占据的恒星系如果包含至少一个行星则将会被释放成为我们霸权联邦的新成员。
entries.en:
War is waged to force the enemy to become a member of our Hegemony.



In the event of a Status Quo peace, systems we occupy will be released as a new member of our Hegemony if they include at least one planet.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以脱离霸权的控制。其他同样拥有该战争目标的成员国能被邀请成为盟友。
entries.en: War is waged to secede from the Hegemony. Other federation members who share this war goal can be invited as attackers.

entries.zh: 发动战争，以阻止成员国脱离霸权控制。
entries.en: War is waged to prevent a member of the Hegemony from seceding.

entries.zh: §Y[Root.GetName]§!脱离§Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!的控制\n§Y[From.GetName]§!撤回一切在§Y[Root.GetAdj]§!星系的宣称。
entries.en: §Y[Root.GetName]§! secedes from the §Y[From.GetAllianceName]§!\n§Y[From.GetName]§! revokes all claims on §Y[Root.GetAdj]§! systems.

entries.zh: 预兆判定你们应当因一直为我们服务接受这份礼物。不要浪费这份赠礼。
entries.en: The Augurs have decreed that you should receive this gift for your continued service to us. Do not squander it.

entries.zh: 仔细考虑过后，我们决定为实验引入另一个变量。请接受这份赠礼。随你们的意愿自行处理即可。
entries.en: After much deliberation, we have decided to introduce another variable to the experiment. Please accept this gift. Do with it as you will.

entries.zh: 你们好，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。我们早就知道你们是特别的。
entries.en: Hello, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. We always knew you were special.

entries.zh: 你是来这里寻求额外指示的吗，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们没有可提供的指示。
entries.en: Are you here for additional instructions, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? We have none to give.

entries.zh: 也许有一天你们会实现一些如我们般伟大的事情。这在或然性的领域之内。
entries.en: Perhaps someday you will achieve something of our greatness. It is within the realm of possibility.

entries.zh: 你们很幸运，我们对你们的物种有些兴趣，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You are fortunate that we took an interest in your species, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 就我个人而言，我从未预料到你们文明能实现如今已做到的事情。
entries.en: Personally, I never expected your civilization to achieve as much as it has.

entries.zh: 看到你如今在这里，我就想起了当初为什么要选择你们的物种。
entries.en: Seeing you here now, I remember why your species was chosen.

entries.zh: 孩子，我们如你一般的时候已经是很久以前了。那是段更简单——在许多情况下也更快乐——的时光。在你还有机会的时候珍惜这段时光吧。
entries.en: It has been so long since we were like you, child. Those were simpler - and in many cases happier - times. Cherish them while you can.

entries.zh: 喂，你好！当然，我是说，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。不巧我们现在有点忙。
entries.en: Hello... you! By which I mean, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], of course. I'm afraid you come at a busy time.

entries.zh: 主人们最喜欢我们。我们知道这是真的。
entries.en: The masters like us the most. We know it to be true.

entries.zh: 也许有一天我们将会继承我们主人们的首都，如果他们选择从星系事务中隐退的话，
entries.en: Perhaps we will inherit our masters' capital someday, if they choose to retire from galactic affairs.

entries.zh: 在面对主人们相对你们更喜欢我们的事实时不要绝望。我们在他们的计划中各有各的地位。
entries.en: You must not despair over the fact that the masters like us more than you. We each have our own place in their plans.

entries.zh: 你们最近同主人们讲过话吗？他们提到过我们吗？
entries.en: Have you spoken to the masters recently? Did they mention us?

entries.zh: 我们已经接纳了主人们指定给我们的角色。你们呢？
entries.en: We have accepted the role that was given to us by the masters. Have you?

entries.zh: 向你们问好，同袍子弟们。很高兴见到你们。
entries.en: Greetings, fellow Scions. It is good to see you.

entries.zh: 服从我们的主人们。他们知道什么对诸如你我这般的年轻文明是最好的。
entries.en: Submit to our masters. They know what is best for young civilizations such as yours and mine.

entries.zh: 我们的主人们为我们所有人都制定了计划。不像你们，我们已经接纳了我们在计划中的角色，
entries.en: Our masters have a plan for all of us. Unlike you, we have accepted our role in it.

entries.zh: 能服侍先辈种族中的一支是莫大的荣耀。
entries.en: It is a great honor to serve one of the Elder Races.

entries.zh: 也许有一天你们会如我们一般荣幸，成为我们古老的主人们选中的仆从。
entries.en: Perhaps someday you will have the honor of joining us, as the chosen servants of our ancient masters.

entries.zh: 没有先辈种族的指引，你们不感觉迷失吗?
entries.en: Do you not feel lost, without the guidance of an Elder Race?

entries.zh: 我们的主人们教会了我们很多。也许终有一天，他们也会将他们的智慧授予你们。
entries.en: Our masters have taught us much. Perhaps in time, they will bestow their wisdom upon you as well.

entries.zh: 马上就要到决定谁将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的时间了。如我们先前同意过的，我们将通过徒手近距离搏斗决定领袖。\n\n每个成员国的领袖将被带到位于[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，我们当前主席国[fed_leader.GetName]的一个大型竞技场。在那里，一场面向全[Root.GetAllianceName]广播的比赛即将展开，他们将相互战斗，至死方休，直到仅剩一人存留。
entries.en: It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nThe leader of each member nation will soon be brought to a large arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] in the [fed_leader.GetName], the current leaders of our federation. There, in an event that is to be broadcast across the [Root.GetAllianceName], they will face off against each other in a battle to the death until only one remains.

entries.zh: 差不多是时候决定谁来在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]了。按照先前的协定，我们将以徒手近身格斗的方式来决定。\n\n不幸的是，由于[Root.GetName]中[Root.GetRulerTitle]一职暂时空缺，我们无法参加此次格斗。
entries.en: It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nUnfortunately, as the office of [Root.GetRulerTitle] is currently vacant in the [Root.GetName], we will be unable to participate.

entries.zh: 差不多是时候确定下一个任职期限内领导[Root.GetAllianceName]的人选了。按照先前达成的一致，这将通过徒手近战格斗来决定。\n\n由于[Root.GetName]不是一个独立的国家，我们将无法参与，因为我们没有资格领导联盟。我们应该竭尽全力改变这种不幸的状况。
entries.en: It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nAs the [Root.GetName] is a not an independent state, we will be unable to participate as we are not eligible to lead the federation. We should do our utmost to change this unfortunate state of affairs.

entries.zh: 差不多是时候决定谁来在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]了。按照先前的协定，我们将以徒手近身格斗的方式来决定。\n\n由于[Root.GetName]的领袖不是以单个个体存在，我们无法参加此次格斗。我们应当尽全力改变这个荒谬而不公平的选举联邦主席的方式。
entries.en: It is nearly time to determine who shall lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the duration of the next term limit. As was previously agreed upon, this will be decided through unarmed close quarters combat.\n\nAs the [Root.GetName] has no single individual leader, we will be unable to participate. We should do our utmost to change this farcical and unfair method of electing the leader of our federation.

entries.zh: 愿最优者继任主席之位。
让我们看看谁家的领袖模拟机笑到了最后。
entries.en: Let us see which of their leader-drones survives.

entries.zh: 竞技场中的战斗即将开始。
entries.en: The battle in the arena will soon begin.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRulerTitle][ruler.GetRegnalName]同组成[Root.GetAllianceName]的其他各成员国的领袖们一道被领向[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]上的竞技场。所有参赛者均不准携带武器和护甲。各个领袖只能依赖他们自身的身体素质，并靠狡黠洞穿别人的心思。
entries.en: [ruler.GetRulerTitle] [ruler.GetRegnalName] is ushered into the arena on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName] along with the other individual leaders of the various member nations that constitute the [Root.GetAllianceName]. No weapons or armor are permitted. Each leader can depend only on their physical prowess and their guile to see them through.

entries.zh: 战斗一开始，[ruler.GetRegnalName]就向反方向逃遁，在随后的混战中大多数时候都是在慌张地从对手们身边逃开。不可思议的是，[ruler.GetSheHe]作为最后的幸存者赢得了比赛，因为最后一名追赶[ruler.GetHerHis]的人自己倒下了，并因先前在战斗中受到的伤害最终死去。
entries.en: As soon as the fighting began, [ruler.GetRegnalName] fled in the opposite direction and spent most of the melee running away from opponents in varying degrees of panic. Incredibly, [ruler.GetSheHe] won by virtue of being the last survivor, when [ruler.GetHerHis] final pursuer collapsed and eventually died from wounds suffered earlier in the fighting.

entries.zh: 战斗开始后，[ruler.GetRegnalName]很快证明了自己在打架方面毫无才能。幸运的是，其他各个领袖甚至更为糟糕。在一场仿佛会永远持续下去的、令人筋疲力竭的搏斗中，[ruler.GetSheHe]最终成为了唯一一名活下来的参战者。宣布胜利时，绝大多数观众已经离开了竞技场。
entries.en: When the battle begins, [ruler.GetRegnalName] quickly proves utterly inept at fighting. Fortunately, all the other leaders are even worse. In a grueling struggle that seems to last forever, [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] eventually the last combatant left alive. When this is announced, the vast majority of spectators have already left the arena.

entries.zh: 战斗过程相当野蛮，但[ruler.GetRegnalName]通过在一片混战中亲自击杀多名与之对战的领袖证明了[ruler.GetHerHis]的实力。尘埃落定时，[ruler.GetSheHe]是唯一一名还站在场上的参战者。
entries.en: The battle is a savage one, but [ruler.GetRegnalName] proves [ruler.GetHerHis] mettle by personally dispatching several rivaling leaders in the confusing melee. When the dust settles, [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] the only one left standing.

entries.zh: 战斗漫长而血腥，[ruler.GetRegnalName]身被数创。尽管如此，[ruler.GetSheHe]通过比其他各个竞争者坚持了更长时间证明了[ruler.GetHerHis]的耐力。战斗结束时，[ruler.GetSheHe]是唯一一名还活着的领袖……虽然已经奄奄一息。
entries.en: The battle is long and bloody, and [ruler.GetRegnalName] is grievously wounded several times. Despite this, [ruler.GetSheHe] prove[ruler.GetSXX] [ruler.GetHerHis] endurance by outlasting all of the other contenders. When the fighting is over, [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] the only leader left alive... even if just barely.

entries.zh: 随着战斗打响，情况很快变得显而易见，竞技场中没有哪名领袖可以与我们[ruler.GetRulerTitle]的技巧及纯粹的能力相匹敌。他们被一个接一个易如反掌地击杀，直至只剩[ruler.GetRegnalName]存活。
entries.en: As the fighting erupts, it quickly becomes apparent that none of the other leaders in the arena can match the skill and sheer ability of our [ruler.GetRulerTitle]. They are dispatched one by one with little effort, until only [ruler.GetRegnalName] remains.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]干净利落地处理掉了胆敢与[ruler.GetHerHim]一同踏入竞技场的可怜蠢货们。简简单单的一瞥过后，其他各领袖已无生命的躯体便落向地面。整个竞技场寂静无声，目送着[ruler.GetRulerTitle]离去。
entries.en: [ruler.GetRegnalName] makes short work of the poor fools who step into the arena with [ruler.GetHerHim]. A single glance and then the lifeless bodies of the other leaders collapse onto the ground. The arena descends into utter silence as the [ruler.GetRulerTitle] makes [ruler.GetHerHis] exit.

entries.zh: 竞技场中的其他各领袖立刻被例行公事地烧成灰烬——今天在此的真正战斗将于[ruler.GetRegnalName]和[rival_chosen_country.GetName]的[rival_chosen_leader.GetRulerTitle][rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName]的庞大灵能力量间展开。在漫长且规模宏大的决斗过后，[ruler.GetRegnalName]最终获胜，[rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName]被彻底击败。竞技场的大部分已经沦为废墟，但事情也告一段落了。
entries.en: The other leaders in the arena are immediately incinerated as a mere formality - the only true battle here today is between the colossal psionic powers of [ruler.GetRegnalName] and [rival_chosen_leader.GetRulerTitle] [rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName] of the [rival_chosen_country.GetName]. After a lengthy duel of titanic proportions, [ruler.GetRegnalName] has somehow succeeded in vanquishing [rival_chosen_leader.GetRegnalName]. Much of the arena lies in ruins, but the matter has been settled.

entries.zh: 这是一场真正的强者之间的战斗。在这个竞技场中施展的灵能力量在虚境的桎梏外罕有目睹。当战斗结束时，竞技场已沦为废墟，[ruler.GetRegnalName]是唯一仍然存活的半神。
