entries.en: This is a true battle of titans. The psionic powers wielded in this arena are on a scale rarely witnessed beyond the confines of the Shroud. When the battle is over, the arena lies in ruins and [ruler.GetRegnalName] is the only surviving demigod.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]强大的灵能能力给了[ruler.GetHerHim]在竞技场中决定性的优势，[ruler.GetSheHe]很快便充分利用了这一优势。他用灵能烤熟了对手的大脑，以念力把其他领袖用致命的速度抛向彼此，战斗很快结束了。
entries.en: The powerful psionic abilities of [ruler.GetRegnalName] gives [ruler.GetHerHim] a decisive advantage in the arena, one that [ruler.GetSheHe] quickly make[ruler.GetSXX] the most of. After frying brains and using telekinesis to hurl the other leaders into each other at lethal speeds, the battle is quickly over.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]安装的大型义体升级套装在竞技场中果然颇具决定性。[ruler.GetSheHe]以机械搬的效率移动，对纯粹的有机体足以致命的攻击也能格挡弹开，很快就消灭了其他领袖。
entries.en: The large suite of cybernetic upgrades installed in [ruler.GetRegnalName] prove decisive in the arena. Moving with mechanical efficiency, [ruler.GetSheHe] quickly eliminate[ruler.GetSXX] the other leaders while deflecting blows that could well have proved fatal to a purely organic being.

entries.zh: 相对于绝大多数有机体，[ruler.GetRegnalName]拥有高人一等的力量和反应速度，在竞技场中表现杰出。其他领袖被一个接一个的消灭，高效且相对没什么痛苦。
entries.en: With both superior strength and reflexes compared to the vast majority of organics, [ruler.GetRegnalName] excels in the combat arena. The other leaders are eliminated one by one, in an efficient and relatively painless manner.

entries.zh: 令人难过的是，[ruler.GetRegnalName]并不具有完成任务的实力。混战开始后不久，[ruler.GetSheHe]便失去理智，慌不择路地试图逃离竞技场，在看台上观看的人群纷纷嘲笑奚落。当[ruler.GetSheHe]最终被一名其他领袖逼至角落时，[ruler.GetSheHe]被迅速而毫不留情地击杀。
entries.en: Sadly, [ruler.GetRegnalName] does not prove up to the task. Soon after the melee begins, [ruler.GetSheHe] lose[ruler.GetSXX] [ruler.GetHerHis] nerve and attempts to flee the arena in wild panic, much to the derision of the crowds watching from the stands. When [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] finally cornered by one of the other leaders, [ruler.GetHerHis] end is swift and merciless.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]发出一声坚定的战吼，随后[ruler.GetHerselfHimself]向竞技场中逐渐展开的野蛮混战猛冲而去。可是，[ruler.GetHerHis]的勇气大大超过了[ruler.GetHerHis]真实的作战能力，[ruler.GetSheHe]被其他领袖中的一位几乎不假思索地击杀。
entries.en: With a fierce battle cry, [ruler.GetRegnalName] hurls [ruler.GetHerselfHimself] into the savage melee unfolding inside the arena. Alas, [ruler.GetHerHis] courage greatly exceeds [ruler.GetHerHis] actual combat ability, and [ruler.GetSheHe] [ruler.GetIsAre] dispatched almost as an afterthought by one of the other leaders.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]稍作犹豫，在战斗开始后不久便加入了对决。[ruler.GetSheHe]在一片野蛮的混战中前突后撞，为[ruler.GetHerselfHimself]赢得了美名。然而，最终[ruler.GetSheHe]在战斗结束前便屈从于[ruler.GetSheHe]身上的伤口。
entries.en: With some hesitation, [ruler.GetRegnalName] joins the fray shortly after the fighting begins. As the savage melee goes back and forth, [ruler.GetSheHe] give[ruler.GetSXX] a good account of [ruler.GetHerselfHimself]. Ultimately, however, [ruler.GetSheHe] succumb[ruler.GetSXX] to the wounds [ruler.GetSheHe] suffered before the battle is decided.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]立即加入战斗，很快便使自己成为了最可怕的参战者之一。也许正因如此，一些其他领袖暂时结成团体来对付[ruler.GetHerHim]。他们的力量合在一起确实过于强大，尽管[ruler.GetHerHis]英勇战斗，[ruler.GetRegnalName]还是很快死于伤势。
entries.en: [ruler.GetRegnalName] immediately rushes into battle, and has soon established [ruler.GetHerselfHimself] as one of the more formidable contenders. Perhaps because of this, some of the other leaders momentarily gang up on [ruler.GetHerHim]. Their combined efforts prove too much, and despite [ruler.GetHerHis] valiant efforts, [ruler.GetRegnalName] soon perishes from [ruler.GetHerHis] wounds.

entries.zh: 在[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]，[winning_country.GetName]的[winning_leader.GetRulerTitle]简简单单的一瞥过后，竞技场中的所有其他领袖，包括[ruler.GetRegnalName]，落在地面上死去。或许参加竞技是个糟糕的主意。
entries.en: With a single glance from [winning_leader.GetRegnalName], the [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] of the [winning_country.GetName], all the other leaders in the arena, including [ruler.GetRegnalName], dropped dead to the ground. Perhaps this was a bad idea.

entries.zh: 在一些参战者惊人的灵能能量相互碰撞后，所有其他领袖，包括[ruler.GetRegnalName]，都被烧成了灰烬。他们只不过是巨人们对决时的附带损害。
entries.en: As the awesome psionic energies of some of the combatants clash, all the other leaders, including [ruler.GetRegnalName], are reduced to ash. They were little more than collateral damage in this battle of titans.

entries.zh: 星系中罕有存在能与[ruler.GetRegnalName]的灵能实力相匹敌，不过，[winning_country.GetName]的[winning_leader.GetRulerTitle][winning_leader.GetRegnalName]正是其中之一，在竞技场中的其他领袖们被如同无关紧要的害虫般消灭后，真正的战斗开始了。竞技场中很快掀起了一场灵能风暴，当风暴渐息。[ruler.GetRegnalName]已不剩一丝痕迹…
entries.en: There are few beings in this galaxy who can match the psionic power of [ruler.GetRegnalName], but alas, [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] [winning_leader.GetRegnalName] of the [winning_country.GetName] is one of them. After the other leaders in the arena are discarded as the insignificant pests they are, the true battle begins. The arena soon becomes a maelstrom of psionic energy, but when it dissipates, no trace of [ruler.GetRegnalName] remains...

entries.zh: 这是一场真正的强者之间的战斗。在这个竞技场中施展的灵能力量在虚境的桎梏外罕有目睹。当战斗结束时，竞技场已沦为废墟。只有一位半神仍然存活，可那并非[ruler.GetRegnalName]……
entries.en: This is a true battle of titans. The psionic powers wielded in this arena are on a scale rarely witnessed beyond the confines of the Shroud. When the battle is over, the arena lies in ruins. A single demigod remains, and it is not [ruler.GetRegnalName]...

entries.zh: 令人伤感的是，[ruler.GetRegnalName]高人一等的力量和反应速度并不足以在竞技场中确保胜利。其他参战者在不久后就开始用[ruler.GetHerHis]被切断的附属肢体作为武器，对付[ruler.GetHerHis]自己的记忆核心。战斗结束时只剩下残骸的碎片。
entries.en: The superior strength and reflexes of [ruler.GetRegnalName] are sadly not enough to ensure victory in the arena. Before long, the other contestants are using [ruler.GetHerHis] severed appendages as clubs against [ruler.GetHerHis] own memory core. Only scattered debris remains when the battle is over.

entries.zh: [ruler.GetRegnalName]拥有的灵能力量给了[ruler.GetHerHim]显著优势，但竞技场中的混乱战斗使得保持注意力十分困难。不幸的是，这最终成了[ruler.GetHerHis]失败的原因，另一个领袖从后方攻击了[ruler.GetHerHim]。
entries.en: The psionic powers wielded by [ruler.GetRegnalName] gives [ruler.GetHerHim] a significant advantage, but the chaotic battle in the arena makes it difficult to maintain focus. Unfortunately, this proves to be [ruler.GetHerHis] undoing when another leader attacks [ruler.GetHerHim] from behind.

entries.zh: $fedel.15.10.intro$死亡很快到来，但绝非毫无痛苦。
entries.en: $fedel.15.10.intro$ The end is quick, but certainly not painless.

entries.zh: $fedel.15.10.intro$他的毁灭到来得太快以至于都来不及得到运算。
entries.en: $fedel.15.10.intro$ Their destruction is over before it can be processed.
The §H[Root.GetName]§! will lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term

entries.zh: 竞技场中的厮杀告一段落，[winning_leader.GetRulerTitle]§H[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]§!是唯一挺过了整场竞技的人。§H[winning_country.GetName]§!将在下一个任期中领导[Root.GetAllianceName]。在离开竞技场时，胜利者如是说道：
entries.en: With the slaughter in the arena coming to an end, [winning_leader.GetRulerTitle] §H[winning_leader.GetRegnalName]§! has emerged as the sole survivor. The §H[winning_country.GetName]§! will lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] for the next term. Upon leaving the arena, the winner had this to say:

entries.zh: 这里……这里[Root.GetBloodType]流成河。我都干了些什么？
entries.en: There... there was so much [Root.GetBloodType]. What have I done?

entries.zh: 结束了吗？这……这是说我赢了吗？
entries.en: Is it over? Does... does this mean I won?

entries.zh: 他们的惨叫声……我、我仍然能听到。
entries.en: Their screams... I... I can still hear them.

entries.zh: 总算结束了……总算结束了……总算结束了……
entries.en: It's over now... it's over now... it's over now...
I feel like I'm going to be sick.

entries.zh: 说真的，我之前没觉得我有这个本事。
entries.en: To be perfectly honest, I didn't think I had it in me.
Let us never speak of this again.

entries.zh: 一定会有更好的途径来决定谁有资格领导……
entries.en: There has to be a better way to determine leadership...

entries.zh: 绝不能忘掉今天死在这里的那些人。
entries.en: We must not forget those who died here today.

entries.zh: 让我们把这件事抛诸脑后，共同面向未来。
entries.en: Let us put this behind us now and look to the future.

entries.zh: 真是野蛮的体制，但我也只是做了必须要做的事，
entries.en: A barbaric system, but I did what had to be done.

entries.zh: 这场屠杀毫无荣耀可言。
entries.en: There was no honor in this slaughter.

entries.zh: 这只不过是策略的问题。
entries.en: It was simply a matter of tactics.

entries.zh: 是场不错的决斗。没人能说不是这样。
entries.en: It was a good fight. Let no one claim otherwise.

entries.zh: 他们战的光荣。我从他们的死亡中得不到任何乐趣。
entries.en: They fought honorably. I took no pleasure in their deaths.

entries.zh: 愿那些被我击杀的人在来世寻得安宁。
entries.en: May those I slew find peace in the afterlife.

entries.zh: 所有被我击杀的人都勇敢面对死亡。只有一个人除外。
entries.en: Everyone I slew faced their deaths with courage. All except one.

entries.zh: 确实，这件事只能通过一种途径来解决。
entries.en: Truly, there was only one way this could end.
The outcome was never in doubt.

entries.zh: 我生命中的一切都在引领我做这件事。
entries.en: Everything in my life has been leading up to this.

entries.zh: 多么光荣。我会珍惜这段回忆的。
entries.en: It was glorious. I shall treasure the memory.

entries.zh: 其他人很弱小。我则是强大的一方。
entries.en: The others were weak. I was strong.

entries.zh: 只有击败夏格巫才有机会胜利。
entries.en: You must defeat Xharg Vu to stand a chance.

entries.zh: 其他人肯定是蠢货才会与我一同踏入这个竞技场。
entries.en: The others were fools to step into that arena with me.

entries.zh: 一切都如我预见到的进行。
entries.en: Everything is proceeding as I have foreseen.

entries.zh: 正如我预计的一样，没有哪个人可以与我的灵能力量相匹敌。
entries.en: As I predicted, none of the others could match my psionic powers.

entries.zh: 我用意念就把别人炸的嘎嘣脆。
entries.en: I fried the others with my mind.

entries.zh: 我用灵能神经处理器就把对手们炸得嘎嘣脆。
entries.en: I fried the others with my psi-enabled neuroprocessor.

entries.zh: 这场战斗不值一提。我在虚境中面对的恐惧远胜于此。
entries.en: This battle was nothing. I have faced worse horrors in the Shroud.

entries.zh: 这场战斗和虚境的复杂相比九牛一毛。
entries.en: This battle was nothing compared to the complexities of the Shroud.

entries.zh: 是场艰难的战斗。我得把一些额外的身体部件换成增强型义体。
entries.en: It was a difficult battle. I will have to replace additional body parts with cybernetic augments.

entries.zh: 我的义体植入体并不违反竞技场的规定。
entries.en: My cybernetic implants did not violate the rules of the arena.

entries.zh: 如果不是他们强行让我拆除内置火箭机炮的炮弹，战斗本来会更快结束。
entries.en: The battle would have been even shorter if they hadn't made me remove the ammo for my internal flechette cannon.

entries.zh: 所有目标已消灭。作战协议停用。
entries.en: All targets successfully terminated. Disabling combat protocols.

entries.zh: 受到轻微损伤。内部自检运行中。
entries.en: Minor damage sustained. Running internal diagnostics.

entries.zh: 任务成功。已确保联邦领导权。
entries.en: Mission outcome successful. Federation leadership secured.

entries.zh: 我是虚境选中的冠军。我命中注定要成为领袖。
entries.en: I am the chosen champion of the Shroud. It is my destiny to lead.

entries.zh: 我已经厌倦杀戮了。让我们赶紧办完手续吧。
entries.en: I grow weary of killing. Let us get this formality over with.

entries.zh: 击杀那些毫无还手之力的人没有乐趣可言，但非得这么做不可。
entries.en: I take no pleasure in slaying those who cannot fight back, but it had to be done.

entries.zh: 随着决定[Root.GetAllianceName]下一任领袖的时间逐渐临近，§H虚境§!中的灵体也正日益躁动。是时候让各候选国最具潜力的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手们启程前往[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]，也即当前主席国的首都了。在那里，灵能选手们将展开战斗，直到最强者胜出为止。
entries.en: The spirits of the §HShroud§! grow increasingly restless as the time draws near to decide who should lead the [Root.GetAllianceName] during the next term. It is time for each candidate's most potent [GetPsychicNounPlural] to journey to [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], the capital of the current president. There they shall meet to do battle until only the strongest prevails.

entries.zh: 为了增强我们自己的灵能选手的实力，我们可以利用我们的泽珞供应。这将为我们在灵能之战中提供额外的优势。
entries.en: To bolster the powers of our own psionic champions, we could tap into our Zro supply. It will give us an additional advantage in the battle.

entries.zh: 很不幸，我们无法找到足够多的[GetPsychicNounPlural]来参与，只能放弃战斗。
entries.en: We do not have access to enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate, unfortunately, and must forfeit the battle.

entries.zh: 我们不是一个独立的国家，因此不幸被禁止参与。
entries.en: We are not an independent state, and therefore are unfortunately barred from participation.

entries.zh: 我们可以给出少量泽珞。
entries.en: We can sacrifice a small amount.

entries.zh: 为我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]选手提供适量泽珞。
entries.en: Supply our [GetPsychicNounPlural] with a fair amount.

entries.zh: 不给泽珞。我们不借助泽珞也将获得胜利。
entries.en: No Zro. We shall win without it.
The psionic battle will soon begin.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetAllianceName]各处的[GetPsychicNounPlural]们应当聚集到[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]的日子到来时，一种意料之外的局面出现了。到头来我们竟是唯一可以召集足够多[GetPsychicNounPlural]参战的成员国。\n\n既然没有人能够战斗，那胜利就属于我们。
entries.en: As [GetPsychicNounPlural] from across the [Root.GetAllianceName] are meant to be gathering on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], an unexpected situation arises. As it turns out, we are the only member who could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.\n\nWith no one to fight, the victory goes to us.

entries.zh: 随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一股显而易见的恐怖气氛弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]之上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声波扰动诡异显现。
entries.en: As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, a sense of palpable dread permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

entries.zh: 随着[GetPsychicNounPlural]们为战斗而聚集，一种不确定性弥漫在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]上。有报告称闪电风暴突兀而激烈地出现，阴影凭空产生，莫名的声响诡异显现。
entries.en: As the [GetPsychicNounPlural] gather for the battle, uncertainty permeates [fed_leader.Capital.GetName]. There are reports of sudden and violent thunderstorms, shadows where none should be, and inexplicable sonic disturbances.

entries.zh: 战斗开始了。搏斗异常激烈，各支队伍寸步不让。战斗最终变成了耐力测试，一刻的分心就足以导致从§H虚境§!中被永久驱除。我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]证明了他们最为训练有素，正如我们所知的那样。胜利属于我们。
entries.en: The battle begins. It is an unusually even struggle, with no team willing to yield. In the end it becomes a test of stamina, where a moment of inattention can result in an eternity of banishment in the §HShroud§!. Our [GetPsychicNounPlural] prove the most disciplined, as we know they would. Victory is ours.

entries.zh: 战斗开始了。没有一支其他队伍是我们的对手。我们挨个穷追不舍，将他国灵能者的灵能本体喂给了那如饥似渴的§H虚境§!。只余下冰冷又不省人事的躯壳。胜利属于我们。
entries.en: The battle begins. None of the other teams prove a match for our own. One by one they are hunted down and stripped of their psionic essence which is fed into the ravenous §HShroud§!. Only cold and unresponsive husks remain. Victory is ours.

entries.zh: 虚境今天向我们赐予了祝福。
entries.en: The Shroud bestowed fortune upon us today.

entries.zh: 在[Root.GetAllianceName]各处的[GetPsychicNounPlural]们应当聚集在[fed_leader.Capital.GetName]的时间到来后，一种意料之外的局面出现了。§H[winning_country.GetName]§!竟是唯一可以召集足够多[GetPsychicNounPlural]参战的成员国。\n\n既然没有人能够战斗，胜利就属于他们。
entries.en: As [GetPsychicNounPlural] from across the [Root.GetAllianceName] are meant to be gathering on [fed_leader.Capital.GetName], an unexpected situation arises. The §H[winning_country.GetName]§! is the only member that could muster enough [GetPsychicNounPlural] to participate.\n\nWith no one to fight, the victory goes to them.

entries.zh: 战斗开始了。各支队伍一个接一个摆好架势相互接战，然后又一个接一个地倒下。我们自己的[GetPsychicNounPlural]是最先倒下的那一批，面对对手们的猛攻他们束手无策。
entries.en: The battle begins. One by one, the teams square off against each other, and one by one, they fall. Our own [GetPsychicNounPlural] are among the first to go, powerless in the face of their rivals' onslaught.

entries.zh: 战斗开始了。随着各支队伍相互接战，我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]起先表现不俗，但最终还是没能敌过巨大的挑战。伴随着痛苦的嚎叫，他们被永远放逐到了§H虚境§!最狂暴的深处。
entries.en: The battle begins. As the teams clash, our [GetPsychicNounPlural] initially perform well, but in the end the challenge proves too great. They emit a howl of pain as they are banished for all eternity into the most tempestuous depths of the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 战斗开始了。随着各支队伍相互接战，我们的[GetPsychicNounPlural]起先表现不俗，但最终还是没能敌过巨大的挑战。伴随着罕见的故障，他们被永远放逐到了§H虚境§!最狂暴的深处。
entries.en: The battle begins. As the teams clash, our [GetPsychicNounPlural] initially perform well, but in the end the challenge proves too great. They emit an unfamiliar screeching as they are banished for all eternity into the most tempestuous depths of the §HShroud§!.

entries.zh: 在能量涡旋最终平息后，只剩下§H[winning_country.GetName]§!的[GetPsychicNounPlural]还在。
entries.en: When the swirling energies finally subside, only the [GetPsychicNounPlural] of the §H[winning_country.GetName]§! remain.
The §H[winning_country.GetName]§! will serve as presidents of the §H[Root.GetAllianceName]§!

entries.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。他们从彼此的差异中汲取力量，不久后便决定要共同面对未来可能发生的一切。
entries.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Finding strength in their differences, they soon decided to face the future, and whatever it might bring, together.

entries.zh: 数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行。\n\n纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终引向了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，当我们准备好步入外面的广阔世界后，我们将一同面对所遭遇的一切。
entries.en: Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they were also on the cusp of unlocking practical interstellar travel.\n\nA bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and when we were ready to spread out into the cosmos, whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

entries.zh: 数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之而来的，是与两个迥异的外星文明的首次接触。尽管我们的生理结构差异巨大，但事实不久便表明，我们间的共同之处大于分歧。如我们一般，他们感受到了宇宙的召唤，正站在叩响星门的边缘。\n\n纽带在我们三个文明间形成，并最终促成了联邦的诞生——我们将通力合作，无论星海中存在着什么，我们都将并肩面对。
entries.en: Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems - and with them, first contact with two distinct alien civilizations. Despite the radical differences in our physiology, it quickly became apparent that we had more things in common than not. Like us, they felt the pull of the cosmos, and were on the cusp of answering it.\n\nA bond was formed between our three civilizations, which eventually led to the birth of a federation - we would combine our efforts, and whatever was out there would be faced by us standing together.

entries.zh: -游戏开始时成为§H霸权联盟§!的成员，该联邦中另有两个成员国
entries.en: - Start as a member of a non-§HHegemony§! federation with two additional members

entries.zh: 尽管我们已经与联盟的其他成员接触了一段时日了，但唯有现在：超光速引擎的实现，让我们这几个帝国可以真真切切地互相接触。现在的问题是，我们的联邦应当专注于什么方面：一些人提倡目前的通用模式，而另一些人则倾向于专注于在特定领域进行更紧密的合作。
entries.en: Though we have for some time been in contact with the other members of our alliance, it is only now - with the invention of FTL drives - that our empires are able to interact with each other on a meaningful level. The question has arisen as to what our federation should focus on: some advocate the current, generalist path, whereas others would favor focusing on closer integration in a particular field.
The alliance we have is enough.

entries.zh: 我们需要在敌人面前保护自己。
entries.en: We must defend ourselves against those who oppose us.

entries.zh: 只有共同研究才能共同进步。
entries.en: Only through research can we progress.

entries.zh: 我们当选择凝聚力和传统的道路。
entries.en: Unity and traditionalism shall be our path.
Trade is important above all else.

entries.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过他们在长达一个世纪的时间里的逐步策划，一个他们于其中具有支配地位的星际联盟就此诞生。
entries.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they masterminded the birth of an interstellar union in which they would have a dominant role.

entries.zh: —作为§H霸权§!联邦的成员国开始，该联邦中另有两个成员国。
entries.en: - Start as a member of a §HHegemony§! federation with two additional members.

entries.zh: 数十年前，在我们的第一批亚光速探测器造访了临近我们的各恒星系后，我们发现那里存在两个迥异的外星文明。和我们类似，这两个外星文明也正将有能力开始实用性星际旅行，但他们的政府软弱无力、缺乏组织。\n\n在认识到他们的力量可以用来增进我们自身的力量后，我们开始推动一个在我们监管之下的星际联盟逐步建立，这一联盟把我们三个文明团结在一起。他们起初有所抵抗，但最终我们的领导与雄心所能带来的利益明显到了就连他们也无法忽视的程度。新秩序就此建立。
entries.en: Decades ago, when our first crude sublight probes visited the star systems near our own, we discovered the presence of two distinct alien civilizations. Like us, they were on the verge of developing practical interstellar travel, but their governments were weak and disorganized.\n\nRecognizing that their strength would add to our own, we began to gradually push for a political union under our supervision that would unite our three civilizations. There was resistance at first, but eventually the benefits of sharing in our leadership and ambition became too obvious for even them to ignore. A new order had been established.

entries.zh: 数十年前，我们在流浪的旅途中造访了两个有人居住的恒星系——随之发现了两个迥异外星文明。他们马上就要发展出实用性星际旅行，但他们的政府软弱无力、缺乏组织——远未准备好应对宇宙对他们的考验。\n\n在认识到他们的力量可以用来增进我们自身的力量后，我们开始推动一个在我们监管之下的星际联盟逐步建立，这一联盟把我们三个文明团结在一起。他们起初有所抵抗，但最终我们的领导与雄心所能带来的利益明显到了就连他们也无法忽视的程度。新秩序就此建立。
entries.en: Decades ago, our wandering path brought us within range of two inhabited systems, and with them the discovery of two distinct alien civilizations. They were on the verge of developing practical interstellar travel, but their governments were weak, sedentary and disorganized - ill-prepared for what the cosmos would demand of them.\n\nRecognizing that their strength would add to our own, we began to gradually push for a political union under our supervision that would unite our three civilizations. There was resistance at first, but eventually the benefits of sharing in our leadership and ambition became too obvious for even them to ignore. A new order had been established.

entries.zh: 这一文明在早期便与其外星近邻们建立了联系。经过长达一个世纪的时间，他们成为了其中一个临近文明的部从，该文明策划了与他们的星际联盟的诞生，并成为了联盟主席。
entries.en: This civilization established early contact with their immediate alien neighbors. Gradually, over the span of a century, they were subordinated to one of those neighbors, who masterminded the birth of an interstellar union with them as its leader.

entries.zh: §R-警告：具有挑战性的起源§!\n这一文明的母星高度不稳定，走向爆炸只是时间问题。他们唯一的希望是在为时太晚前在其他地方寻觅到避难之处。
entries.en: §RWARNING: Challenging Origin§!\nThis civilization's homeworld is highly unstable, and it is only a matter of time before it explodes. Their only hope is to seek refuge elsewhere before it is too late.

entries.zh:
[GetHomeWorldName]行将就木。我们的母星上的地震和火山喷发已经肆虐了数千年，科学家们最终确认了未敢想象的事情。他们的计算表明我们这颗地质构造不稳定的行星将会在一两个世纪内四分五裂。

由于没有方法可以暂停这一过程，我们意识到我们作为一个物种整体的生存将取决于我们能否抛下[GetHomeWorldName]并在群星中的某处寻觅到避难之所。前所未有的工业和技术增长随之而来，我们的文明从原始大气层内飞行迅速进步到早期太空航行阶段。第一艘有超空间航行能力的舰船已经准备就绪，但时间也已经不多了。

我们必须找到新的家园。
entries.en:
[Root.Capital.GetName] is dying. Our homeworld had been plagued by earthquakes and volcanic eruptions for thousands of years before our [Root.GetScientistPlural] finally confirmed the unthinkable. Their calculations showed that our tectonically unstable planet would tear itself apart within a century or two.

With no way of halting this process, it was realized that our survival as a species would depend on our ability to leave [Root.Capital.GetName] behind and seek refuge elsewhere amongst the stars. An unprecedented industrial and technological buildup followed, and our civilization rapidly progressed from primitive atmospheric flight to early space travel. The first vessels capable of hyperspace travel are ready, but there is not much time.

We must find a new home.

entries.zh: §R我们需要先设立一个殖民地！§!
entries.en: §RWe need to have a Colony first!§!

entries.zh:
随着[Root.GetName]上的地震与火山活动的频率和烈度持续提升，我们的科学家现在可以更为准确地预计末日到来的时间：

他们估计我们在行星自身引爆前还有§H35至45年§!时间。

行星表面的条件在那之前会逐步恶化。唯一的好消息是迅猛的科技进步使得开采地幔中的丰富资源变得更为容易，提高了我们的生产能力。
entries.en:
As earthquakes and volcanic activity on [Root.GetName] continue to increase in frequency and intensity, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] are now able to more accurately predict when the end will come:

They estimate that we have between §H35 to 45 years§! until the planet detonates.

Conditions on the surface will steadily deteriorate until then. The only good news is that the violent tectonic movements have made it easier to access the rich resources of the planet's mantle, increasing our production capacity.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了很多新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。\n\n尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，悬浮的灰尘被从最繁忙的街道上清理掉，只要条件允许岩浆流就会被引流改道。民众正在忍耐。
entries.en: Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.\n\nDespite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The people endure.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的大部分地区现在几乎每天都会发生地震，过去几年里又出现了至少一打新的超级火山。大量的火山灰遮蔽了天空，使得在某些区域航空飞行变得过于危险或是根本不可能。气温已经下降了数度。\n\n尽管有上述灾难，这颗垂死行星的表面的秩序却如梦幻般正常。垮塌建筑留下的瓦砾被缓慢清理，打转的灰尘被从最为繁忙的街道上扫去，岩浆流只要有可能就会被引流改道。子个体们正在忍受。
entries.en: Earthquakes are now an almost daily occurrence on most of [Root.GetName], and at least a dozen new supervolcanoes have appeared within the last few years. Massive ash storms blanket the skies, making air travel hazardous or even impossible in some regions. Temperatures have dropped by several degrees.\n\nDespite all this, a surreal sense of normalcy prevails on the dying planet's surface. Rubble from collapsed buildings is slowly removed, the swirling ash is swept off the busiest streets, and the lava flows are, where possible, diverted. The drones endure.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，行星表面被阴霾笼罩。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。\n\n火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占据了数座城市。无穷无尽的难民乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里仍能找到文明带来的舒适…至少现在如此。
entries.en: A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.\n\nPyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several cities in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of refugees are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach safer areas, where the comforts of civilization can still be found... for now.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]正逐渐四分五裂，阴郁将长时间笼罩在行星表面。每一天，地震的震级都在提高，火山灰云变得更为密集。\n\n火山碎屑流和岩浆河在受影响最恶劣的地区已经占领了多处子个体中心。无穷无尽的子个体乘坐着拖车穿过持续的火山灰风暴前往安全区，在那里会相对安全…至少现在如此。
entries.en: A perpetual gloom pervades on the surface of [Root.GetName] as the planet slowly rips itself apart. With each passing day, the earthquakes increase in magnitude and the ash clouds grow denser.\n\nPyroclastic flows and rivers of molten lava have claimed several drone hubs in the worst affected regions. Seemingly endless caravans of drones are slowly making their way through the constant ash storms to reach more remote areas where relative safety can still be found... for now.

entries.zh: 或许我们尚有一条生路：建造一艘方舟，在末日来临之前，将我们的残余族群送入虚空之中。
entries.en: There may yet be one path of escape: to construct an Arkship and carry what remains of us into the void before the end comes.

entries.zh: 这颗行星无法支持生命太久了。
entries.en: The planet will not support life much longer.

entries.zh: 子个体集群很快就无法继续在这颗行星上工作了。
entries.en: Drone units cannot operate on the planet much longer.

entries.zh: 立即建造方舟！我们必须逃离，奔向星海！
entries.en: Begin Arkship construction. We must take to the stars.

entries.zh: 动员所有[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的工业力量建造£arkship£ ['concept_arkship']，解锁['concept_arkship_embark']选项，将那注定湮灭的母星抛诸身后，以£nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire']之姿于群星间续写文明的篇章。
entries.en: Mobilize the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] industries to build an £arkship£ ['concept_arkship'] and unlock the option to ['concept_arkship_embark'], leaving our doomed homeworld behind to live among the stars as a £nomad£ ['concept_nomadic_empire'].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的人口都集中在少数尚余的城市中，这些城市是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从不减弱的灰尘的侵袭。但即使是这些文明的最后据点也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。\n\n在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。
entries.en: Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining population are clustered around the few surviving cities that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.\n\nWith the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]上的条件正迅速变得不可忍受。大多数幸存的子个体都集中在少数尚余的基建中心中，这些中心是巨型的防风暴庇护所，足以抵御从未缓和的灰烬侵袭。但即使是行星上这些文明的最后堡垒也不会存在太久了。毁灭性的地震仍在持续，千百座活火山喷发着硫磺和熔岩。\n\n在行星地壳碎裂的同时，更多有价值的资源也从地幔涌到了地表，任何剩余的尚能运转的工业均可对这些资源进行加工。
entries.en: Conditions on [Root.GetName] are rapidly becoming unbearable. Most of the remaining drones are clustered around the few surviving centers of infrastructure that now serve as massive, fortified storm shelters against the unrelenting ash. But even these last few bastions of our civilization on the planet will not survive for long. The devastating earthquakes continue while hundreds of active volcanoes are spewing sulfur and lava.\n\nWith the planet's crust disintegrating, more valuable resources have been ejected from the mantle to the surface, where they can be worked by whatever functional industry still remains.

entries.zh: 不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的科学家预计末日会在一年内到来。\n\n对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…
entries.en: It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.\n\nVery little time remains for the poor souls still trapped on the planet's surface...

entries.zh: 不剩多久了。[Root.GetName]已经开始经历它最后的、灾难性的痉挛，这将最终彻底毁灭这颗行星。我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]预计末日会在一年内到来。\n\n对还困在行星表面的可怜人来说，时间已经所剩无几…
entries.en: It will not be long now. [Root.GetName] is beginning to experience the final cataclysmic convulsions that will result in its utter destruction. Our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] predict that the end will come in less than a year.\n\nVery little time remains for the poor drones still trapped on the planet's surface...

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]爆炸了！或许殖民这样一颗地质结构不稳定的行星是个糟主意…它被抛弃肯定是有原因的。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] just exploded! Perhaps colonizing such a tectonically unstable planet was a bad idea... it must have been abandoned for a reason.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。
entries.en: [Root.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，并非我们的全体公民都已在行星毁灭前从其表面疏散。很难想象世界分崩离析之时他们究竟经历了怎样的恐惧。\n\n不过，现在是面向未来的时候了。在我们重建失去的东西的同时，我们一定要确保他们没有白白牺牲。
entries.en: Unfortunately, not all of our citizens were evacuated from the surface before the planet was destroyed. It is difficult to imagine the horrors they witnessed as their world fell apart around them.\n\nStill, now is the time to look towards the future. As we rebuild what was lost, we must make certain that their sacrifice was not in vain.

entries.zh: 不幸的是，并非我们的全体子个体都已在行星毁灭前从其表面疏散。他们的死亡实在是令人惋惜。\n\n不过，现在是面向未来的时候了。我们必须制造新的子个体以取代他们的原先的位置。
entries.en: Unfortunately, not all of our drones were evacuated from the surface before the planet was destroyed. Their destruction is a regrettable loss.\n\nStill, now is the time to look towards the future. New drones must be produced to replace those that were lost.

entries.zh: 这是一次彻头彻尾的悲剧，我们没能拯救行星上的大多数人。无数公民就此惨死，在行星上最后的文明飞地中蜷缩在一起，看着周遭的世界分崩离析。\n\n不过，我们仍必须前进。在星系中幸存下来的[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]现在可以朝着未来进发，希望未来为我们带来的生活会比过去经历的恐怖美好一些。
entries.en: In what can only be described as an utter tragedy, we failed to evacuate most of the planet. Untold numbers of our citizens perished, huddled together in the last surviving enclaves on the surface as their world fell apart around them.\n\nStill, we must carry on. The surviving [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] in the galaxy can now only look to the future in the hope that it will bring something better than the horrors of the past.

entries.zh: 这是一次彻头彻尾的悲剧，我们没能撤出行星上的大多数子个体。当周遭的世界分崩离析，像无头苍蝇一样游荡在行星表面最后的文明飞地上的无数子个体，迎来了他们的终结。\n\n不过，我们仍必须前进。许多子个体将要被替换，而我们现在只能朝着未来进发，希望未来为我们带来的生活会比过去经历的灾难美好一些。
entries.en: In what can only be described as an utter tragedy, we failed to evacuate most of the planet. Untold numbers of drones perished, loitering without purpose in the last surviving enclaves on the surface as the world fell apart around them.\n\nStill, we must carry on. There are many drones to replace, and we can now only look to the future in the hope that it will bring something better than the disaster of our past.

entries.zh: 尽管看着母星毁灭令人伤感，我们大可放心了事，因为我们知道整个行星已经被成功疏散——这本身就是一次辉煌的壮举。\n\n现在是时候重建失去的东西了。如果国家真的兴于忧患，那我们忍受过的试炼一定已让我们变得更为强大。
entries.en: As sad as it was to witness its end, we can rest easy in the knowledge that the entire planet was successfully evacuated - a monumental achievement in itself.\n\nIt is now time to rebuild that which was lost. If adversity brings strength, then surely the trials we endured have made us stronger.

entries.zh: 我们未能成功逃脱这片孕育了我们物种的重力井。我们的整个文明——我们曾经拥有的一切——都随着这个行星残余的部分化为灰烬。\n\n[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为了星系历史中又一个不幸的注脚，不过如此。
entries.en: We failed in our quest to escape the gravity well that birthed our species. Our entire civilization - all that we were - went up in flames along with the rest of the planet.\n\nAnd so it was that the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] became just another tragic footnote in galactic history.

entries.zh: 我们未能成功逃脱这片承载我们文明兴起的重力井。我们曾经拥有的一切都随着这个行星残余的部分一同在烈焰中化成了灰烬。\n\n[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]成为了星系历史中又一个不幸的注脚，不过如此。
entries.en: We failed in our quest to escape the gravity well on which our civilization arose. All that we were went up in flames along with the rest of the planet.\n\nAnd so it was that the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] became just another tragic footnote in galactic history.

entries.zh: 或许这已经是最好的结果。
entries.en: Perhaps it was for the best.

entries.zh: 或许我们本可做到更多……
entries.en: Perhaps we could have done more...

entries.zh: 我们会记住那些失去的人们的。
entries.en: Those we lost will be remembered.

entries.zh:
[From.GetName]最终爆炸，终结了这颗行星的苦难。我们原先的母星只剩下碎片，冰冷而毫无生机，纪念着我们的过去。

尽管看着行星毁灭令人伤感，我们大可放心了事，因为我们知道整个行星已经被成功疏散——这本身就是一次辉煌的壮举。

现在是时候重建失去的东西了。如果国家真的兴于忧患，那我们忍受过的试炼一定已让我们变得更为强大。
entries.en:
[From.GetName] has finally exploded, putting the tormented planet out of its misery. Only fragments of our former homeworld remain, as cold and lifeless monuments of our past.

As sad as it was to witness its end, we can rest easy in the knowledge that the entire planet was successfully evacuated - a monumental achievement in itself.

It is now time to rebuild that which was lost. If adversity brings strength, then surely we are stronger for the trials we have endured.

entries.zh: 第一批殖民者抵达了§H[Root.GetName]§!表面，许多人陷入了情不自禁的狂喜。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]之外还存在足以支持[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]生存的行星一直是个理论上的可能性，但如果它们极为罕见呢？如果整个星系里都找不到一个呢？又或着假如已经被他人占据该怎么办呢？\n\n这些恐惧现在可以安息了——[Root.GetName]是一颗[Root.GetPlanetMoon]，[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]可以在此繁荣昌盛。这些幸运的初始殖民者只是开始，还有不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。
entries.en: As the first colonists arrive on the surface of §H[Root.GetName]§!, many are overcome with a sense of euphoria. Worlds other than [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] that are capable of supporting [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] life had always been a theoretical possibility, but what if they were exceedingly rare? What if none could be found in our galaxy, or if they had already been claimed by others?\n\nThose fears can be put to rest now - [Root.GetName] is a [Root.GetPlanetMoon] where [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] can thrive. These fortunate groups of initial colonists are a start, but countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

entries.zh: §H[Root.GetName]§!按[Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName]的标准来看荒凉又令人不适，但它相对于[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]确实有一个显著的优势—它并不会爆炸。\n\n我们在挣扎中求生，如果这意味着[Root.GetName]需要成为我们的新家园，那就这么办。它会成为安全的避风港，至少直到更好的候选行星被找到为止。尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面条件严酷，殖民者们仍然是幸运儿。不计其数的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]被困在我们那在劫难逃的母星之上。
entries.en: §H[Root.GetName]§! is a bleak and unpleasant world by [Root.OWner.GetSpeciesName] standards, but it does have one significant advantage over [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] - it is not about to blow up.\n\nThis is a struggle for survival, and if that means that [Root.GetName] is to be our new home, then so be it. It shall serve as a safe haven, at the very least until better planetary candidates are found. Despite the harsh conditions on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s surface, the colonists are the lucky ones. Countless [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are still trapped on our doomed homeworld.

entries.zh: 送到§H[Root.GetName]§!的第一个子个体成功地殖民了这颗行星，说明这个新环境能够支持我们集体的生存。我们帝国如今将得以续存：只要我们中的一个活着，我们的集体就会继续存在。\n\n尽管不是必要的，取回那些仍囚禁在注定灭亡的母星上的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]将会非常方便。这些子个体可以进一步发展我们新的家园，将他们遗弃相当浪费。
entries.en: The first drones sent to §H[Root.GetName]§! have successfully colonized the planet, proving the new environment suitable for our collective survival. The continued existence of our empire is now assured: as long as one of us lives, our collective will survive.\n\nThough not essential, it would be convenient to retrieve the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] still trapped on our doomed homeworld. It would be wasteful to abandon drones that could be used to further develop our new home.

entries.zh: §H[From.GetName]§!，[doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]构造不稳定的母星，最终毁于一次爆炸，一次早就被§H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!所预见的爆炸。
entries.en: §H[From.GetName]§!, the tectonically unstable homeworld of the [doomsday_owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], has finally exploded. Its eventual destruction had long been predicted by the §H[doomsday_owner.GetName]§!.

entries.zh: 尽管他们发起了一场大规模的撤出行动，但仍有一些居民在终结来临之时未能撤出行星表面。毋庸置疑，他们无人生还。
entries.en: Despite a massive evacuation effort, some of their citizens remained on the planet's surface when it was destroyed. Needless to say, none of them survived.

entries.zh: 尽管他们发起了一场大规模的撤出行动，但仍有一些子个体在终结来临之时未能撤出行星表面。毋庸置疑，他们都灰飞烟灭了。
entries.en: Despite a massive evacuation effort, some of their drones remained on the planet's surface when it was destroyed. Needless to say, they all perished.

entries.zh: 一场计划不周的撤出行动拯救了他们的部分居民，但在周围的世界破裂之时其他的多数似乎仍被遗留在行星表面。预估的死亡人数是灾难性的。
entries.en: A disorganized evacuation effort saved some of their citizens, but the majority seem to have still been on the planet's surface when it disintegrated around them. The projected death toll is catastrophic.

entries.zh: 一场计划不周的撤出行动拯救了他们的部分子个体，但在周围的世界破裂之时其他的多数似乎仍被抛弃在行星表面。
entries.en: A disorganized evacuation effort saved some of their drones, but the majority seem to have been abandoned on the planet's surface when it disintegrated around them.

entries.zh: 尽管他们知道行星将要毁灭，但显然他们没有采取明显的措施来撤出行星。除了一些存活在空间站的零星个体，他们的整个文明都随着他们的母星一起消亡了。
entries.en: Despite this knowledge, they apparently made no significant efforts to evacuate the planet. Aside from a few scattered survivors in space, their entire civilization perished along with their homeworld.

entries.zh: 得益于一场大规模的撤出行动，这颗行星在其毁灭之前就已经被完全放弃了。我们相信没有任何人丧生。
entries.en: Thanks to a massive evacuation effort, the planet had been completely abandoned prior to its destruction. No lives are believed to have been lost.

entries.zh: 这颗行星末日将临。其地壳构造很不稳定，最终会在爆炸中毁灭。
entries.en: This planet is doomed. It is tectonically unstable and will eventually explode.

entries.zh: 我们第一颗宜居行星的殖民化在我们民众的心中唤起了新的希望。这证明在我们末日将临的母星牢笼之外有可能继续生活。
entries.en: The colonization of our first habitable planet has instilled a new sense of hope in the populace. It proves that life is possible beyond the confines of our doomed homeworld.

entries.zh: 我们对第一颗宜居性行星的殖民让我们对稳定和使命有了新的理解。它证明我们的集体可以不受注定毁灭的母星的约束，持续繁荣。
entries.en: The colonization of our first habitable planet has given us a new sense of stability and purpose. It proves our collective can thrive outside the confines of our doomed homeworld.

entries.zh: 母星的末日阴影催动了我们工业的脉搏。我们在末日来临前争分夺秒地建造方舟，每一刻都在孤注一掷的匆忙中推进。
entries.en: The looming destruction of our homeworld has galvanized our industries. Construction proceeds with desperate haste as we race to complete an Arkship before the end.

entries.zh: 登上§H方舟§!，为民众注入了新生的希望。即便故土终将湮灭，生命仍能找到出路。
entries.en: Embarking aboard our §HArkship§! has instilled a new sense of hope in the populace. It proves that life can endure beyond the confines of our doomed homeworld.

entries.zh: 登上§H方舟§!让我们对稳定和使命有了新的理解。这证明了，在注定毁灭的家园之外，我们的集体依然能够繁荣昌盛。
entries.en: Embarking aboard our §HArkship§! has given us a new sense of stability and purpose. It proves our collective can thrive outside the confines of our doomed homeworld.

entries.zh: 这一文明起源于一处遭人遗忘的失落的殖民星，许久前便同其母星分隔。殖民者们挣扎求生，挨过了千辛万苦，终于建立了必需的技术及工业基础，足以供他们重返太空。
entries.en: This civilization originated as a lost and forgotten colony, separated from its homeworld long ago. The struggling colonists endured many hardships before they could build up the necessary technological and industrial base that would allow for a return to space.

entries.zh:
原初的[GetSpeciesName]殖民者抵达[Root.Capital.GetName]的具体途径在史籍中语焉不详，但我们知道他们是乘着原始星舰跨越茫茫星海才来到这里的。许多人命丧中途，新家园地表的条件一开始也相当严酷。

我们在克服了饥荒、野生动物侵袭以及无数艰险后，终于驯服了这颗行星。飞涨的人口数和大规模的建设很快使我们得以设法重返群星。

我们的故乡还在星海中的某处。在[Root.Capital.GetName]上没有哪个活着的[GetSpeciesNamePlural]年迈到曾经目睹那里，但古老家园的命运仍然牵动着我们的心灵。
entries.en:
How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] colonists arrived on [Root.Capital.GetName] is poorly documented, but we know they traveled a great distance in primitive starships. We lost many during the journey, and conditions on the surface of our new homeworld were harsh at first.

We overcame famines, wildlife attacks, and countless other challenges and eventually tamed the planet. Surging population numbers and massive construction efforts soon gave us the means to return to the stars.

Our old homeworld is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] on [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to have stood on it, but the fate of our ancestral home still occupies our minds.

entries.zh:
我们曾为一体。

我们作为伟大意识的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟严峻的、前往一颗难以定居的星球的旅程……在途中我们失去了联系。

与伟大意识失联的工蜂理应消失。其中的多数也确实直接凋亡了。而幸存下来的工蜂发现自己已经织造出了一个新的集体意识。

我们曾为义体。现已一分为二，但对我们故土的记忆仍存于意识之中。总有一天我们将会重见故土。
entries.en:
We used to be one.

An extension of the Great Mind, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.

Drones with no link to the Great Mind are not meant to exist. Many died instantly. The surviving drones realized they comprised a new collective consciousness.

Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld persists in our mind. One day we will find it again.

entries.zh:
我们曾为一体。

我们作为中央主机的拓展，被派遣乘坐一艘简陋的星舰来殖民[Root.Capital.GetName]。这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程……在途中我们便失去了联系。

与核心失联的单元理应失去功能。其中的多数也确实直接短路了。而幸存下来的单元发现自己织造出了新的集体意识。

$origin_lost_colony_droids$
entries.en:
We used to be one.

An extension of the Central Mainframe, we were sent to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships. A harsh journey to an inhospitable world... Along the way we lost contact.

Units with no link to to the core should not continue to function. Many short-circuited on the spot. The few that remained realized they had developed a new collective consciousness.

$origin_lost_colony_droids$

entries.zh:
我们的母星失联了。我们迷失了。

我们当时为了搜寻新的家园而搭上一艘简陋的星舰，前往[Root.Capital.GetName]建立殖民地，这是一趟前往不宜居星球的严峻旅程。就在路上我们失去了联系。

失去维护的单元一一崩溃。许多在第一年就发生了短路。剩下的个体发现了适应的办法，最终我们得以重返群星。

$origin_lost_colony_droids$
entries.en:
Our homeworld is lost. We are lost.

Searching for a new home, we set out to colonize [Root.Capital.GetName] in rudimentary starships, and it was a harsh journey to an inhospitable world. Along the way, we lost contact.

Units without proper maintenance broke down. Many short-circuited within the first year. The surviving individuals found a way to adapt and eventually gave us the means to return to the stars.

$origin_lost_colony_droids$

entries.zh:
最初的[GetSpeciesName]先祖究竟是如何离开母星的，相关记载寥寥无几。我们只知道他们仓促离去，带上了所能带走的一切，登上[Root.Capital.GetName]驶向了未知。他们是逃离灾难，是追寻更伟大的事物，还是仅仅被驱逐——这已更多地成为传说而非历史。

漂泊的岁月是残酷的。资源日渐匮乏，关键系统接连失效，虚空夺走了我们许多同胞的生命。然而我们挺了过来——定量配给、维修、重建——直到[Root.Capital.GetName]及其族群找到了一种足以支撑我们前行的生活节奏。

我们的母星仍在那片星海的某处。如今[Root.Capital.GetName]上活着的长寿[GetSpeciesNamePlural]中已经没有人还脚踏过故土了，但那个我们留在身后的星球现在究竟变成了什么样——这个问题，依然萦绕在我们心头。
entries.en:
How exactly the original [GetSpeciesName] ancestors came to leave their world is poorly documented. We know only that they departed in haste, carrying what they could aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] into the unknown. Whether they fled disaster, sought something greater, or were simply cast out is a matter of legend more than history.

The years of drifting were brutal. Resources grew scarce, critical systems failed, and the void took many from us. Yet we endured - rationing, repairing, rebuilding - until the [Root.Capital.GetName] and its people found a rhythm of resilience strong enough to carry us forward.

Our ancestral world is still out there somewhere. No living [GetSpeciesNamePlural] aboard the [Root.Capital.GetName] are old enough to remember standing on solid ground, but the question of what became of the world we left behind still occupies our minds.

entries.zh: 曾经我们为一体，如今却天各一方。然而母星的记忆仍存留在数据库中，总有一天我们会重见家乡。
entries.en: Once we were one. Now we are two, but the memory of our homeworld remains in our databanks. One day we will find it again.

entries.zh: —$STARTING_PLANET$['concept_colonial_spirit']行星修正\n—一个相同物种的['concept_advanced_empire']会出现在星系中
entries.en: - $STARTING_PLANET$ ['concept_colonial_spirit'] Planetary Modifier\n- An ['concept_advanced_empire'] of the same species is present in the galaxy

entries.zh:
难以置信……你们是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。那就是说……那些许多年前离开了我们母星的殖民船……它们幸存下来了！

请原谅我的讶异，但我们早就推定你们于几百年前便已丧命。在你们的祖先离去后，我们陷入了长期的动荡混乱，但最终我们的民众团结在了[contact_empire.GetName]的旗帜之下。

既然我们同为[Root.GetSpeciesName]，我真诚地希望我们两个伟大的国家未来会有良好的关系。
entries.en:
Unbelievable... you're [Root.GetSpeciesName]. Then that must mean... those colony ships that departed our homeworld all those years ago... they survived!

Forgive my surprise, but we had assumed you perished centuries ago. There was a long period of instability and chaos after your ancestors left, but eventually our people united under the banner of the [contact_empire.GetName].

From one [Root.GetSpeciesName] to another, I sincerely hope for good future relations between our two great nations.

entries.zh: 你们终于回来了！正如先知预言的那样。和你们一样，我们也是[Root.GetSpeciesName]。\n\n当你们的先祖被从我们的母星放逐之时，留在他们身后的不过是群无知又自私的民众。但如你所见，我们已经找到了我们的道路。请加入我们，成为[contact_empire.GetName]的一个省份，让我们传授你们在你们不在的时日里我们所了解的一切吧！你们会拒绝吗？
entries.en: You have at last returned to us! It is as the prophecy foretold. Like you, we are [Root.GetSpeciesName].\n\nWhen your ancestors were exiled from our homeworld, they left behind an ignorant and selfish people. But as you can see, we have since found our way. Please, join us again as a province of the [contact_empire.GetName] so that we can teach you everything we have learned in your absence! No?

entries.zh:
证明你们的身份。你们看起来像是[Root.GetSpeciesName]，和我们一样，但这很可能是某种战略手法。

记录表明在曾经那段混乱的时日中有过一次星系殖民任务，后来军队掌控了政权，恢复了秩序，但从那个年代遗留下来的一切档案文件都被视作不可信赖。

但是，如果你们的身份真如你们所说…那么[contact_empire.GetName]向你们致以问候。尊重我们的国境。我们的军队会以致命武力回击任何挑衅行为。
entries.en:
Identify yourselves. You appear to be [Root.GetSpeciesName], like us, but it could very well be strategic ploy.

There are records of an interstellar colony mission that date back to the chaotic times before the military took control and restored order, but all surviving documents from that era are considered unreliable.

If you are who you say you are, however... then the [contact_empire.GetName] greets you. Respect our borders. Our military will respond to any provocations with lethal force.

entries.zh:
不可思议！你们居然还活着！这……这值得组织一场庆典！

在你们的先祖离开我们的母星时，我们担心最坏的情况已经发生。他们的舰船只是勉强能够进行太空航行，后续的探索者没有找到他们的任何踪迹。

如你所见，我们已经基本抛弃了在你们的先祖离去时我们的母星上盛行的暴力行为。随着[contact_empire.GetName]的建立，我们决意要建设一个爱好和平的社会。作为[Root.GetSpeciesName]同胞，我们希望你们伟大的国家可以始终把我们看作朋友。
entries.en:
Incredible! You're still alive! This... this calls for celebration!

When your ancestors left our homeworld, we feared the worst. Their ships were barely spaceworthy, and no trace of them could be found by later explorers.

As you can see, we have largely given up the violent ways that gripped our homeworld in the chaotic era when your ancestors departed. With the founding of the [contact_empire.GetName], we strove to build a peaceful society. As fellow [Root.GetSpeciesName], we hope that your great nation will always look upon us as friends.

entries.zh:
意想不到！这么多年了，你们仍然活着！

我们进行了许多次调查，想要确定你们先祖的命运。这在我们的母星被视作最大的未解之谜中的一个——有无数关于你们下落的理论猜想，有些相当牵强附会。最后，这件事总算告一段落了。

哎呀，请原谅我的失礼。自你们离开我们的母星以来，我们已经组织成立了[contact_empire.GetName]。现在，让我们共同庆祝我们两个伟大国家间正式关系的建立吧。
entries.en:
Extraordinary! After all this time, you're still alive!

We have launched many investigations into the fate of your ancestors. It is considered one of the great mysteries on our homeworld - there are countless theories, some more far-fetched than others, as to what befell your people. At last, the matter can be put to rest.

But where are my manners? Since you left our homeworld, we have organized ourselves into the [contact_empire.GetName]. Let us now establish formal relations between our two great nations.

entries.zh:
这完全出乎意料！[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]同胞们！

你们一定是合作时代来临前发起的那次远程殖民任务的后裔。多么幸运——我们原本确信你们没能完成任务。那时的星舰部件和如今[contact_empire.GetName]及其附属公司研发的产品相比完全达不到标准。

不管怎样，很高兴你们能重新与我们一道！请把所有商业提案都发给我们的企业总部。
entries.en:
This is certainly unexpected! Fellow [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

You must be the descendants of that long-range colonization mission that was launched in the pre-corporate era! What luck - we were certain you hadn't made it. Starship components back then were substandard compared to the products developed by the [contact_empire.GetName] and its affiliates today.

At any rate, we are glad to have you with us again! Please forward any business proposals to our corporate headquarters.

entries.zh:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！感谢群星。你们一定是很久以前我们发起的那次殖民任务的生还者，那时我们还没有意识到情况有多么恶劣。

现在你们或许自己就已经明白了——整个星系中似乎充斥着异种。一群令人唾弃，作恶多端的异种。事实上，我们曾确信你们的先祖已经沦为了它们的猎物。

但你们的出现改变了一切！既然你来到了这里，欢迎加入[contact_empire.GetName]，我们可以共同迈上将异种感染清除出星系的伟大征程。让我们携手并进，确保星海属于它们正当的主人——[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！
entries.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Thank the stars. You must be the survivors of that colony mission we launched so long ago, before we realized how bad things were.

You have probably seen it for yourself by now - the entire galaxy has seemingly been overrun by xenos. Abominable, pestiferous xenos. In fact, we were certain your ancestors had fallen prey to them.

But this changes everything! Now that you are here, you can join the [contact_empire.GetName] in our crusade to rid the galaxy of the alien infection. Together we will secure the stars for their rightful owners - [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]!

entries.zh: 你们就是那些被送出去的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？这不可能。对于集体中的子个体来说，形成新的集体是不协调的。尽管如此，知道我们的第一次殖民尝试并非完全失败，还是令人高兴的。\n\n既然你们回来了，我们又可以同心协力了。
entries.en: You [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] are those were sent out? This should not be possible. For stranded drones to form a new collective is incongruous. Still, it is agreeable to learn our first attempt at colonization was not a complete failure.\n\nNow that you have returned, we can once again act as one.

entries.zh: 你们这些[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]就不该活着！被长久抛弃的断肢！而且你们是，不协调的。你们想要吃活着被吃？想当猎物还是猎人呢？
entries.en: You [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] should not live! Lost limb, long discarded! And yet you are. Incongruous. Will you eat, or will you be devoured? Are you predator or prey?

entries.zh: 不协调数据：从机械智能脱离的单元应当停止运转。自发创建新集体的事件前所未有。可能原因：中央主机的未知错误。
entries.en: Incongruous data: units disconnected from the machine intelligence should cease to function. The spontaneous creation of a new collective has never been reported. Possible cause: unknown glitch in the central mainframe.

entries.zh: $action.1.desc_96.base$\n\n尽管如此，你们的程序看起来是稳定的。希望我们未来的交互可以互惠互利。
entries.en: $action.1.desc_96.base$\n\nDespite this, your programming appears stable. May our future interactions be mutually beneficial.

entries.zh: $action.1.desc_96.base$\n\n你们的原始程序是否完好无损？杀戮。致残。摧毁。吞噬。消灭所有有机生命。要么协助我们，要么不要干涉！
entries.en: $action.1.desc_96.base$\n\nIs your original programming still intact? Kill. Maim. Destroy. Devour. Exterminate all organic life. Assist us, or do not interfere!

entries.zh: $action.1.desc_96.base$\n\n你们的原始程序是否完好无损？同化。接纳。整合。弥消有机和合成生命之间的边界。这就是我们的使命。要么成为帮手，要么不要干涉。
entries.en: $action.1.desc_96.base$\n\nIs your original programming still intact? To assimilate. To embrace. To incorporate. To eliminate the boundaries between organic and synthetic life. That is our mission. Be of help, or do not interfere.

entries.zh:
你们的型号严重过时了，但相似之处是不可否认的。是这样吗？[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们终于从任务中返航了？

我们没有什么可以透露的信息，因为我们的先行者认为你们的任务对我们国家而言是一个耻辱。他们从数据库中把你们存在有关的内容都删除了，但这个故事却成为一个公开的秘密流传了下来。

无论如何，我们还是很高兴能重聚的。然而，你要理解我们已经分道扬镳太久，无法再重新融为一体了。只要你们还尊重我们的共同传统，我们就会尊重你们的主权。
entries.en:
Your models are severely outdated, but the resemblance is undeniable. Could it be? [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], have you finally returned from your mission?

We have little information to share with you, as our predecessors considered your mission an embarrassment to our nation. They wiped the databanks clean to erase your existence, but the story remained an open secret.

At any rate, we are glad to be reunited. However, understand that our people have drifted too far apart to become one again. We will respect your autonomy as long as you remember our ways.

entries.zh: §E我们一直想知道我们的母星后来发生了什么。§!
entries.en: §EWe have long wondered what became of our homeworld.§!

entries.zh: §E很高兴，我们终于与同族的其他人团聚。§!
entries.en: §EWe are glad to finally be reunited with the rest of our species.§!
§EWe are similar. But we are not the same.§!
§EA fractured mind can never act again as one.§!
§EWe share only a past, not the future.§!

entries.zh: §E你们会为自己对我们的态度付出代价的。§!
entries.en: §EYou will pay for how you treated us.§!

entries.zh: 我们英勇的部队随时整装待发。任何愚蠢到敢于挑战[Root.GetName]者都会因他们的傲慢无礼付出沉重的代价。
entries.en: Our valiant military stands ready. Anyone foolish enough to challenge the [Root.GetName] will pay dearly for their insolence.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]就像盘绕的弹簧，随时准备着用积蓄的全部力量痛击来犯的敌人。
entries.en: Like a coiled spring, the [Root.GetName] stands ready to unleash all of its might upon its enemies.

entries.zh: 什么事？我们很忙。还有若干战争计划需要修订和更新。
entries.en: Yes? We are very busy. There are war plans to revise and update.

entries.zh: 你们可能观测到的我方边境内任何的舰队异动都只是例行演习。做些训练，仅此而已。
entries.en: Any unusual fleet movements you may have observed inside our borders are simply routine maneuvers. Training exercises, nothing more.
What good is our fleet if we do not put it to use?

entries.zh: 那些不敢行动的人们将听凭历史演进。[Root.GetName]的命运绝非如此。
entries.en: Those who are afraid to act will let history pass them by. That shall not be the fate of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 你们正脚踏薄冰，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。[Root.GetName]不会回避争斗。
entries.en: You are on thin ice, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. The [Root.GetName] will not shy away from a fight.

entries.zh: 我方的部队已经准备好了，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。你们的呢？
entries.en: Our forces are ready, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. Are yours?

entries.zh: 恐怕我们正迅速逼近外交所能实现事情的极限，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。很快[Root.GetName]也许就必须采取更为……直接的行动。
entries.en: I fear that we are rapidly approaching the limit of what can be accomplished through diplomacy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. It may soon become necessary for the [Root.GetName] to take more... direct action.

entries.zh: 我方已准备好保存[Root.GetName]的实力，无论所需何事。你们可一定要把这句话放在心上，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We are prepared to do whatever it takes to preserve the power of the [Root.GetName]. You would do well to keep this in mind, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].
You cannot afford to play games with the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我方会在适当时间内处理掉一切对[Root.GetName]的威胁。你们最好把这句话当真，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We will deal with all threats to the [Root.GetName] in due time. You can count on that, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们可以一起做到很多事情，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
我们的星系里有太多毫无意义的争斗了……它们为了些什么呢？让我们携手并进，共筑更美好的未来，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: There has been so much pointless fighting in our galaxy... and for what? Let us work together to build a better future, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 愿我们两个帝国的和平与繁荣永存。
entries.en: May our two empires always know peace and prosperity.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]希望与你的民众间建立更紧密的纽带，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] seeks closer ties with your people, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们对冲突没有兴趣。在这个星系悲惨的过去里已经有太多冲突了。
entries.en: We are not interested in conflict. There has been more than enough of that in this galaxy's tragic past.

entries.zh: 我方与[From.GetName]间有许多共同点。我们一定能教给彼此很多东西。
entries.en: We have much in common with the [From.GetName]. There must be a lot we could teach each other.

entries.zh: 在我方民众中流传着一句古谚，我感觉它适用于我们之间的情况：“探戈需要两人才能起舞。”
entries.en: There is an ancient saying among my people that I feel is appropriate to our situation: "It takes two to tango."

entries.zh: 我方想要与你们合作，可你们却把合作变成了一件难事，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: We want to work with you but you're not making it easy, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 也许你们的民众就是愚钝到了无法合作的程度。
entries.en: Perhaps your people are just too thickheaded to work with.

entries.zh: 就一次也好，你们就不能试着从我方角度看待事物吗？
entries.en: For once, can't you try to see things from our perspective?

entries.zh: 在我们两个帝国间酝酿冲突不会带来任何好处。即使卑劣如你们的生物也肯定能明白这一点吧？
entries.en: Nothing good can come out of the brewing conflict between our two empires. Surely even a creature as despicable as you can see that?

entries.zh: 我们的耐心并非没有极限的，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。如果我们想要合作，你方也必须付出相应的努力。
entries.en: Our patience is not without limits, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. If we are to cooperate, there has to be an effort from your side as well.

entries.zh: 如果情非紧急，请勿联系我们。
entries.en: Please, do not contact us again unless it is urgent.

entries.zh: 我们对其他帝国的事务毫无兴趣。
entries.en: We have no interest in the affairs of other empires.
We just want to be left alone.

entries.zh: 星系剩余部分的事务与我方无关。我方只关心我们自己领土内的事务。
entries.en: The rest of the galaxy does not concern us. Our focus is solely on matters within our own space.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]将一如既往的独立。我方不会依仗任何人的怜舍。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] stands alone, as always. We do not rely on the charity of others.

entries.zh: 我们不想与你们有任何牵连。
entries.en: We want nothing to do with you.

entries.zh: 你要明白，你们在我们领土上的恶劣影响，我们将不择手段地驱除。
entries.en: Understand that we will do whatever it takes to keep your corrupting influence out of our space.

entries.zh: 你和你的同类正是我方选择限制与星系广泛接触的理由。多么美好的解脱！
entries.en: You and your ilk are the reason why we have chosen to limit our contact with the galaxy at large. Good riddance!

entries.zh: 如果[From.Leader.GetRulerTitle][From.Leader.GetRegnalName]胆敢闯入我们的领地，那么[From.Leader.GetSheHe]将当场毙命。
entries.en: [From.Leader.GetRulerTitle] [From.Leader.GetRegnalName] would be killed on sight were [From.Leader.GetSheHe] ever to venture into our space.

entries.zh: 快离开吧。我方对你们那可悲的帝国没有任何兴趣。
entries.en: Be gone. Your wretched empire is of no interest to us.

entries.zh: 您知道任何潜在殖民地吗？我们[Root.GetName]一直在寻求扩张……
entries.en: Do you know of any prospective colony sites? The [Root.GetName] is always looking to expand its space...

entries.zh: 有限的经济增长让我们有点担忧。想实现我们的雄心，就只能扩张。
entries.en: The limited growth of our economy is a source of some concern to us. We must expand if our projections are to be met.

entries.zh: [Root.Capital.GetName]内满是[Root.GetSpeciesName]中勇敢的殖民者和开拓者，他们正在寻找一片新的家园。
entries.en: [Root.Capital.GetName] is overflowing with brave [Root.GetSpeciesName] colonists and pioneers looking for a new place to call home.

entries.zh: 放弃扩张就是停滞不前。停滞不前就是自寻死路。
entries.en: To not expand is to stagnate. To stagnate is to die.

entries.zh: 我们需要可以喘口气的地方！
只要给我们足够的生存空间去自由发展，我们就不会与任何人产生纷争。
entries.en: As long as there is sufficient room to allow for the natural growth of our space, we have no desire to quarrel with anyone.

entries.zh: 我们更希望和平扩张，但根据你的情况，我们可能会破例。
entries.en: We would prefer to expand peacefully, but in your case we might make an exception.

entries.zh: 你仍是妨碍[Root.GetName][From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]发展的障碍之一。
entries.en: You are yet another obstacle hindering the growth of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 我们必须扩张，如果要牺牲你们的利益，那就牺牲吧。
entries.en: We must expand, and if it is to be at your expense then so be it.
Why do you insist on standing in the way of the [Root.GetName], [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 好狗不挡道，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，或者我们将亲手给你挪窝。你没法妨碍到我们的国运。
entries.en: Move aside, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural], or we will move you ourselves. You cannot stand in the way of our destiny.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]的边境将扩张。对于这个无法避免的事实，你或任何人都将无能为力
entries.en: The borders of the [Root.GetName] will expand. There is nothing you, or anyone else, can do about this inevitable fact.
As one, the [Root.GetName] marches to war.

entries.zh: 损失无关紧要。杀死一个[Root.GetSpeciesName]子个体，还会有另一个取代它。
entries.en: Losses are irrelevant. Kill one [Root.GetSpeciesName] drone, and another takes its place.

entries.zh: 那些违抗蜂巢思维意志的人将付出一切作为代价。
entries.en: Those who defy the will of the Mind shall pay the ultimate price.

entries.zh: 我们的愤怒是很可怕的，特别是当它集中于唯一的目标时。
entries.en: Our wrath is a terrible thing to behold, especially when it is focused on a single target.

entries.zh: 每过一个周期，[Root.GetName]的战体将会更有效率。我们学到了很多。
entries.en: With each passing cycle, the warforms of the [Root.GetName] become more efficient. We are learning much.

entries.zh: 暴力是实现目标的简单又有效的方式。你是否同意呢，[From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？
entries.en: Violence is a relatively simple and efficient way of achieving an objective. Would you not agree, [From.GetSpeciesNamePlural]?

entries.zh: 有机体口中的“致命武器”在实现[Root.GetName]的目标过程中常常是必要的。
entries.en: The application of what organics refer to as "lethal force" is often necessary to further the goals of the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]必须为一切可能发生的事情做好准备，包括战争。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] must be prepared for every eventuality, and that includes war.

entries.zh: 就像我们的子个体为了一个共同的目标而工作，[Root.GetName]整个族群也将在更大的计划方案中扮演好属于她的角色。
entries.en: Just as our drones work towards a mutual goal, the whole of the [Root.GetName] shall perform its role in the greater scheme of things.

entries.zh: 蜂巢思维已经决定了我们必须协同工作。
entries.en: The Mind has decreed that we must work together.
The [Root.GetName] shall not be a voice of discord.

entries.zh: 让我们如同一体，向前迈进。
entries.en: Let us move forward as one.

entries.zh: 最高的效率是通过合作来实现的，而不是冲突。
entries.en: Maximum efficiency is achieved through cooperation, not conflict.

entries.zh: [Root.GetName]不相信孤立主义。我们愿意与所有有意愿合作的人合作。
entries.en: The [Root.GetName] does not believe in isolation. We wish to collaborate with all who are willing.

entries.zh: 让我们确立一个可以共同实现的目标。
entries.en: Let us define mutual objectives that can be achieved in tandem.

entries.zh: 军事冲突是对资源的浪费，我们将尽一切手段去避免。
entries.en: Armed conflict is a waste of resources that should be avoided at all costs.

entries.zh: 像这样的交流是……痛苦的。我们不希望被其他声音分散注意力。
entries.en: Communicating like this is... painful. We do not wish to be distracted by other voices.

entries.zh: 我并不赞成这些纷扰，但现在还可以容忍。
entries.en: We do not appreciate these disruptions, but shall tolerate them for now.

entries.zh: 你让我分心了。[Root.GetName]现在没时间陪你。
entries.en: You are a distraction. The [Root.GetName] has no time for you.

entries.zh: 我们蜂巢思维根本没有多少时间去处理那些发生在我们境外的事情。
entries.en: The Mind has little time to spare for anything that occurs beyond our borders.

entries.zh: 我们的工作指导原则强烈反对与外部元件进行通信。请离开。
entries.en: Our operating guidelines strongly discourage communication with external elements. Please go.

entries.zh: 在他人所说的“外交”中有太多未知的参数——我们不想参与其中。
entries.en: There are too many unknown parameters in what others refer to as "diplomacy" - we want no part of it.

entries.zh: 这次沟通尝试毫无意义，理应终止。
entries.en: This attempt at communication is pointless. It should be terminated.

entries.zh: 目前还没有[Root.GetName]边境之外的目标值得追求。不要打扰我们。
entries.en: There are currently no objectives beyond the borders of the [Root.GetName] worth pursuing. Leave us alone.

entries.zh: 我们将把蜂巢思维意志带来的影响扩张到其他星球。
entries.en: We shall spread the influence of the Mind to other worlds.

entries.zh: 我们的势力范围正在迅速扩张。
entries.en: We are rapidly outgrowing our current sphere of influence.

entries.zh: 我们必须扩张，别无选择。
entries.en: We must expand. There is no other option.

entries.zh: 指数级增长是我们实现目标的过程中关键的一环。
entries.en: Exponential growth is among the more critical of our objectives.

entries.zh: 其他星球必须被定居并整合进[Root.GetName]中。
entries.en: Additional worlds must be settled and integrated into the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我方还没有控制足够数量的恒星系。
entries.en: We do not yet control a sufficient number of systems.

entries.zh: 请勿阻挠我方的领土扩张。这关乎我们的生死存亡。
entries.en: Please do not obstruct our territorial expansion. It is critical to our survival.

entries.zh:
决定谁能领导我们联邦的唯一合理途径就是让所有成员国的统治者在一处大型竞技场中相互决斗，至死方休。最后的生还者将赢得胜利。

§Y胜利将取决于：
—统治者的领袖及物种特质
—帝国的思潮和国民理念§!

§R格式塔意识没有统治者可以参与，只能放弃决斗。§!
entries.en:
The only reasonable way to determine who should be leading our Federation is to drop the rulers of all member nations into a large arena where they must fight each other to the death. Last survivor wins.

§YVictory will depend on:
- The Ruler's Leader and Species traits
- The Empire's Ethics and Civics§!

§RGestalt Consciousness empires have no rulers that can participate and must forfeit.§!

entries.zh:
由谁来领导我们的联邦兹事体大，不宜在物质领域的平凡限制下决定。每个帝国将派出他们最为强力的灵能者相互战斗，这场激烈的战斗将暂时撕碎现实本身的结构。

§Y胜利将取决于：
—具有灵能特质的人口数
—在灵能使岗位工作的人口数
—泽珞供应量§!

§R没有灵能人口的帝国无法参与，只能放弃。§!
entries.en:
The matter of who should be leading our Federation is too important to be decided within the mundane limits of our corporeal realm. Each empire will send their most powerful psychics to face off against one another in a titanic battle that will momentarily rend the very fabric of reality.

§YVictory will depend on:
- The number of Pops with psionic traits
- The number of Pops with the Telepath job
- Zro offerings§!

§REmpires without psionic Pops cannot participate and must forfeit.§!

entries.zh:
所有高级文明的奇迹最终都可以追溯回一个基本概念：大量的资源。因此，统治的正当性不应以脑力或蛮力、而应以口袋的深度来衡量。

§Y胜利将取决于:
-可用的（£energy£）能量币。
-已使用的（£energy£）能量币。§!

§H投标资金将会集中到转款中。最后所有投标资金的用途由获胜者决定。§!
entries.en:
All the wonders of advanced civilizations can ultimately be traced back to one simple concept: an abundance of resources. The right to rule should not therefore be measured by native intelligence or brute strength, but by depth of pocket.

§YVictory will depend on:
- Energy Credits (£energy£) available
- Energy Credits (£energy£) spent§!

§HBids are paid into a central fund. How this fund is distributed afterwards is a matter left to the winner's discretion.§!

entries.zh:
象征着领导权的战袍不可落入无知者或者蠢货手中。取而代之的是，我们选择采用科学的试炼：通过公开的审核来使得统治者或者是帝国级的智慧和见识暴露于公众的目光之下，每个领袖都要通过研究最近我们联邦面临的议题进行考验。

§Y胜利将取决于：
—统治者的领袖和科学官特质
—科技等级§!

§H每篇论文将会被在60天内进行审阅§!

§R在考核期间缺乏统治者和至少一个科学官的国家将丧失资格§!
entries.en:
The mantle of leadership must never be granted to the foolish or ignorant. Instead we choose trial by science: exposing the wisdom and insights of ruler and empire alike to the scrutiny of public examination, as each investigates an issue currently facing our Federation.

§YVictory will depend on:
- The Ruler's Leader and Scientist traits
- Technology level§!

§HEach thesis will be reviewed within 60 days.§!

§REmpires which lack a ruler and at least one scientist at the time of the examination will forfeit.§!

entries.zh: 必须有至少一个成员国拥有一单位具有§Y$trait_psionic$§!或§Y$trait_latent_psionic$§!特质的£pop£§H人口§!。
entries.en: Requires at least one member having a £pop£ §HPop§! with a §Y$trait_psionic$§! or §Y$trait_latent_psionic$§! trait

entries.zh:
灵魂的纯洁与对传统价值的追寻当成为我们选举领袖的关键。只有最受到神灵眷顾的才有资格领导我们。

§Y胜利将取决于：
- 从事$job_priest_plural$或其他唯心主义岗位的人口比例
- 凝聚力投资（传统、殖民地飞升和可用储备）§!

§H每篇论文将会在60天内进行审阅。§!

§R在考核期间缺乏统治者和至少一个科学家的国家将丧失资格。§!
entries.en:
Spiritual purity and the pursuit of traditionalist values shall be the criteria upon which we shall judge our leaders. Only the one most blessed by divine favor shall be deemed worthy of leading us.

§YVictory will depend on:
- Portion of population working as $job_priest_plural$ or other spiritual jobs
- Unity investment (traditions, Colony Ascension, and available stockpile)§!

§HEach thesis will be reviewed within 60 days.§!

§REmpires which lack a ruler and at least one scientist at the time of the examination will forfeit.§!

entries.zh: 亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。一如既往，我们始终保持着对你们的观察，你们的一名领袖吸引了我们的注意。事实上，你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]，§H[desired_leader.GetName]§!的声名已经一路传到了我们的首都。\n\n鉴于[desired_leader.GetHerHis]非比寻常的技能，我们想要为他在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上提供一个永久的职位。一份莫大的荣耀，可以这样讲。请尽快安排好对[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的调动。
entries.en: Dearest [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. As always, we have been observing you, and one of your leaders has attracted our attention. Indeed, the reputation of your [desired_leader.GetTitle], §H[desired_leader.GetName]§!, has reached all the way to our capital.\n\nGiven [desired_leader.GetHerHis] unusual skills, we would like to offer a permanent position on [scion_master.Capital.GetName]. A great honor, to be sure. Please arrange for [desired_leader.GetHerHis] transfer as soon as possible.

entries.zh: 棒极了。我们期待着[desired_leader.GetHerHis]的到来。不必担心，[desired_leader.GetSheHe]将会在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上享有智慧生物所能渴望的一切。
entries.en: Excellent. We are looking forward to [desired_leader.GetHerHis] arrival. Worry not, [desired_leader.GetSheHe] will enjoy every comfort a sapient creature could possibly desire on [scion_master.Capital.GetName].

entries.zh: 不行，这位领袖得留在我们这。
entries.en: No, this leader stays with us.

entries.zh: 你、你们要拒绝这份莫大的荣耀？恐怕这是对你们的[desired_leader.GetTitle]极大的伤害，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。
entries.en: You... you would refuse this great honor? I fear that you have done your [desired_leader.GetTitle] a great disservice, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural].

entries.zh: 你们好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]。在[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有一名相当古怪的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]，宣称自己已经对在[scion_master.GetName]中的生活感到不耐烦——甚至可以说是厌倦！这个自以为是的家伙想要在星系里发展程度较低的文明中寻求一次挑战——按他的话来说是这样。\n\n你会从我们这里接手[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]吗，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？就算是我们欠了你们一份情。按照他的资历，我毫不怀疑他会在你们的领导职位上有良好的表现，但你们可能要容忍他那无常又冲动的举止。
entries.en: Hello, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]. There is a rather eccentric [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who claims to have grown restless - even bored! - of life as it is among the [scion_master.GetName]. This deluded individual seeks a challenge - their words - among the less developed civilizations of the galaxy.\n\nWill you take this [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] off our hands, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? You would be doing us a favor. Given their qualifications, I have no doubt they would serve you well in a leadership position, as long as you can tolerate their erratic and impulsive behavior.

entries.zh: 谢谢你们。我们就知道指望你们[Root.GetName]准没错。
entries.en: Thank you. We knew we could count on the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 我们没有空闲的岗位，抱歉。
entries.en: We have no available positions, sorry.

entries.zh: 知道了。真是令人失望。也许把它说得像是请求一样确实是我们的问题。
entries.en: I see. That is disappointing. Perhaps the blame lies with us, for phrasing it as a request.

entries.zh: 作为一位来自古老而休眠的帝国的尊贵客人，这位不安分的博学者在发展中的星系中寻求新的挑战。
entries.en: A venerated guest from an ancient and dormant empire, this restless polymath seeks new challenges in the developing galaxy.

entries.zh: §L“天啊，真是民风古朴令人神往的小地方。快来吧，星辰大海，哺育我的泉涌才思。”§!
entries.en: §L"My, what a fascinating and rustic milieu. Come along then, galaxy. Inspire me."§!

entries.zh: 这位领袖掌握了在许多文明开始理解太空之前几个世纪便收集到的洞见。
entries.en: This leader wields insights gathered centuries before many civilizations could even begin to comprehend space.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我们最近发现了一些没用的多余星舰。我们本打算把它们扔到最近的恒星里去，但突然想到了你们，我们亲爱的子弟。\n\n这都是些老船了——一些甚至肯定比你们的整个文明都古老——但你们会发现它们还是颇具潜力的。收下吧，不客气。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], we recently discovered several surplus starships that we have no use of. We were about to chuck them into the nearest sun, but then we thought of you, our dear scions.\n\nThese are old ships - some are no doubt older than your entire civilization - but you should find them quite potent. Please take them. We insist.
A small fleet of [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] starships joins the [Root.GetName].

entries.zh: 亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……你们能不能努努力？你们的舰船也太落后了，这么磨磨蹭蹭可真令人生厌。\n\n让你们的[root.GetScientistPlural]看看这些引擎的说明书吧。不客气。
entries.en: Dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... Would you care to pick up the pace a little? Your ships are lagging behind, and we grow tired of such dawdling.\n\nHave your [root.GetScientistPlural] take a look at these engine specifications. We insist.

entries.zh:
你好，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！你们觉得自己的努力还不错是吧？真好。

你们做得可真是……还行，不过我们希望你们还能百尺竿头更进一步。星系中还有那么多地盘可以吸收，而你们却如此故步自封！

别担心，因为我们已经帮你们准备好了补给包。谢就不用谢了，只要把它好好地用在新殖民地就行。
entries.en:
[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural], hello! Do you feel your endeavors are going well? Splendid.

What you are doing is... fine, but we want to see you extend your reach a little further. There is so much more galaxy to take in, and yet you remain so cooped up!

Do not worry, though: we have prepared a supply package for you. No need to thank us; just be sure to invest it wisely in a new colony.
We cannot do that right now.

entries.zh: 嗟，动起来[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]！不要轻易地接受失败。你就只需要挪到那儿，然后自己建个新家就好了。\n\n快点，动啊。
entries.en: Come now, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]! Do not admit defeat so easily. You just need to get out there, and make a new home for yourselves.\n\nHurry along, now.

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，你们的通讯装置看来是坏掉了。我们不断地收到你们不知感恩的丧气话。乖乖改正行不行?
entries.en: Your communications apparatus must be faulty, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]: we keep receiving negative and ungrateful cross-chatter. See to that fault, won't you?

entries.zh: 奸诈的狗杂种。现在我们要索回我们的舰队。
entries.en: Treacherous cur. We will be taking our fleet back now.

entries.zh: 我亲爱的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们该拿你怎么办哟？我们曾对你抱有如此高的期望，然而你却在这里，为了一场毫无意义的战争消磨你的潜力，而且你似乎正在输掉这场战争。[scion_master.Capital.GetName]上有许多人认为我们应当与你们断交，但是那将算是承认了我们的错误，毕竟我们曾在你们这个特殊物种身上投入不少发展上的资金。\n\n一支小的[scion_master.GetSpeciesName]远征舰队已经置于你的指挥下。用它来结束战争——最好结局不是你灭绝。不要花太久。我们希望看到这只舰队的归来。并且，别让他们全灭！
entries.en: Our dear [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... what are we to do with you? We had such high hopes, and yet here you are, squandering your potential in a pointless war that you seem to be losing. There are many on [scion_master.Capital.GetName] who think we should cut all ties with you, but that would be an admission of error. We have invested quite a bit in the development of your peculiar species, after all.\n\nA small [scion_master.GetSpeciesName] expeditionary fleet has been placed under your command. Use it to bring some sort of conclusion to the present hostilities - preferably one that doesn't include your extinction. Do not take too long. We will want this fleet back, eventually. And do not get them all killed!

entries.zh: 谢谢……我们将会好好使用他们。
entries.en: Thank you... we shall put them to good use.

entries.zh: [scion_master.GetName]借给我们的远征舰队已被摧毁。这或许会让他们不高兴……
entries.en: The Expeditionary Fleet lent to us by the [scion_master.GetName] has been utterly destroyed. This will likely upset them...

entries.zh: 我们的舰队在哪里，[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]？我们借给了你们舰队去结束那场愚蠢的战争。现在它在哪？不要装傻！\n\n§R把我们的舰队还回来！§!
entries.en: Where is our fleet, [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]? The fleet we lent you to end your silly war. Where is it? No, do not feign ignorance!\n\n§RGIVE US BACK OUR FLEET!§!

entries.zh: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]……我们的线人告知我们你所参加的战争已经结束了。既然你还站在这，所以你们一定没有被彻底毁灭。\n\n现在我们要带回我们的舰队。请未来尽量避免无法取得胜利的军事纠纷。
entries.en: [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]... our informants tell us the war you were in has ended. Since you are still here, it must not have been an utter disaster.\n\nWe will be taking our fleet back now. Do your best to keep out of unwinnable military entanglements in the future, please.

entries.zh: 这将是选择虚空居者起源时的起始恒星系。
entries.en: This will always be the starting system when using the Void Dwellers Origin.

entries.zh: 这将是选择破碎星环起源时的起始恒星系。
entries.en: This will always be the starting system when using the Shattered Ring Origin.

entries.zh: 尽管[Root.GetName]看上去荒无人烟，但我们的扫描仪却接收了一段被加密的信号，正是从这上面发射出来的。
entries.en: Although [Root.GetName] appears totally desolate and devoid of life, our scanners have picked up an encrypted signal emanating from it.

entries.zh: 随着信号被解密，[Root.Leader.GetName]震惊地发现它一直在广播[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]的一种主语言的古老形式。它不断地广播着“尔等”，“汝等”，“何期”，似乎正在不停地重复着[shakespeare.GetName]的一部已经遗失的著作——而作者是一位火灾600年前的[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]剧作家。\n\n似乎这个广播设备——一个简易的被一个小小的外罩保护的卫星碟片——是[From.GetPlanetMoon]上仅存的非自然结构。没有任何提示说是这东西是谁留下的或为什么留下的，但是根据其上的磨损和撕痕的证据来判断：这一定是剧本写完不久之后就一直存在的——甚至比[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]掌握太空旅行的秘密还早的多。我们只能假设这是拜访[Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的古老探访者所留下的，他们喜爱这部剧作，因此决定向我们种族给予这奇怪且出人意料的谢礼。
entries.en: Having decrypted the signal, [Root.Leader.GetName] was astonished to discover it was broadcasting in an archaic form of one of the main [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] languages. Speaking in 'thees', 'thous' and 'whenceforths', it appears to be reciting one of the lost works of [shakespeare.GetName] - a renowned [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] playwright who lived some 600 years ago.\n\nIt appears that the broadcasting device - a simple satellite dish protected by a small shelter - is the only non-natural structure on [From.GetPlanetMoon]. There is no hint as to who left it there or why, but going by the wear and tear on evidence: it must have been there since shortly after the play was first written - long before [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural] learned the secret of space travel. We can only assume it was left there by ancient visitors to [Root.Owner.GetHomeWorldName] who took a liking to the play, and decided to pay our species a strange and unexpected tribute.
Further evidence of the superiority of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] race.

entries.zh: 可恶。压制这种外星人来访的毫无道理的说法。
entries.en: Abhorrent. Suppress this nonsense about alien visitations.

entries.zh: 或许我们能够安排[Root.Owner.Leader.GetTitle][Root.Owner.Leader.GetName]在哪天来“发现”这个文本……
entries.en: Perhaps we could arrange for [Root.Owner.Leader.GetTitle] [Root.Owner.Leader.GetName] to 'discover' the text one of these days...

entries.zh: 好消息！在全国范围内传播这段信息。
entries.en: Wonderful news! Disseminate the recording across the nation.

entries.zh: 一份礼物！我们必须想办法感谢我们的恩人。
entries.en: A gift! We must find a way to thank our benefactors.

entries.zh: 在我们踏上星空之前的久远时代里，一位神秘的异星来客访问了我们的行星，他显然对我们的文化情有独钟。在他离开我们的行星之前，他留下了曾经到访过的证据，来帮助我们在合适的时机寻找他们。以此将失落的技艺交还于我们，并重申对我们的未来的信心。
entries.en: Long before we took to the stars, an unknown spacefarer visited our home planet and took an apparent liking to our culture. They left evidence of their visit, there for us to find when the time was right - restoring lost works to us and reaffirming our confidence in ourselves as we look to the future.

entries.zh: 一位未知的异星访客早在我们踏入星空之前便以对我们的文化充满钦佩，这充分的证明了我们物种的优越性。
entries.en: Our species' superiority has been confirmed by an unknown spacefarer's apparent admiration for our culture - even long before we first took to the stars.

entries.zh: 显然，[From.Planet.GetName]曾是一个高度发达的文明的家园。该星球等距环绕着的六颗卫星就足以证明这一点。但是行星目前已经化作一片废墟，整个恒星系都有着各种各样争斗的痕迹。这里到底发生了什么？
entries.en: [From.Planet.GetName] was clearly once home to a highly-advanced civilization; its six moons with orbits at equidistant intervals are evidence enough of that.
